A super robot designed and developed by Dr. Juzo
Kabuto.
 At the cry of "Mazin Go!", Mazinger Z emerges
from a sewage treatment plant. Koji's Hover Pilder
then docks with its head (Pilder On), completing
the robot.
 It runs on photon power, and boasts a jumping
ability of 20 meters, a grip strength of 150 tons,
and 650,000 horsepower. Its armor, covered in
Chogokin Z, is extremely sturdy, and ordinary
attacks cannot leave so much as a scratch on it.
 It carries a variety of weapons, including the
'Rocket Punch,' which fires its arms via rocket
propulsion, the 'Breast Fire,' which emits thermal
energy from its chest plate, and the 'Rust
Hurricane,' which blasts a powerful acid-laden wind
from its mouth. But its arsenal did not stop there
- Professor Yumi and his colleagues went on to add
new weapons and enhance its performance again and
again.
 Among its many upgrades, the most famous is the
episode in which it overcame its greatest weakness,
its inability to fly, thanks to the 'Jet Scrander'
flight-assist device. This sequence of 'gaining
wings and flying freely through the sky' embodies a
longing humanity has held since the age of myth,
and it left an extremely strong impression. As a
result, many robot anime since have followed in its
footsteps in one form or another.

A female-form robot developed by Professor Yumi
to serve as Mazinger Z's partner.
 It is the successor to the Aphrodite A, which was
destroyed in battle against a Mechanical Beast, and
it is completed when the large motorcycle 'Scarlet
Mobile,' piloted by Sayaka, combines with its head.
However, unlike the Aphrodite A, which was
originally built for resource mining, Diana A was
designed for combat from the outset, giving it
considerably improved combat capability by
comparison.
 With photon power as its energy source, Chogokin
Z armor, and a combining-type cockpit, it shares
much in common with Mazinger Z, making it a robot
truly worthy of the name 'partner.'

A super robot secretly designed and developed by
Dr. Kenzo Kabuto, based on Mazinger Z.
 Like Mazinger Z, it is completed when Tetsuya's
Brain Condor, launched from a whirlpool with the
shout "Mazin Go!", combines with the head (Fire
On).
 It runs on the same photon power as Mazinger Z,
but its armor, made of Chogokin New Z, surpasses
Chogokin Z and is even sturdier than Mazinger Z's.
 Owing to the circumstances of its development,
many of its weapons are enhanced or developed
versions of those found on Mazinger Z. Its unique
attacks include the 'Mazinger Blade,' a pair of
giant swords stored in its legs, and 'Thunder
Break,' which stores lightning as energy before
unleashing it in a strike.
 It also has the Scramble Dash flight device built
into its back, allowing it to fly at Mach 4. Later,
the 'Great Booster' was completed, a unit that
combines with it to enhance its flight performance.
This booster also doubled as a powerful weapon,
unleashing destructive force comparable to a
hydrogen bomb when rammed into an enemy.

Dr. Kenzo Kabuto secretly designed and developed
this super robot based on Mazinger Z. Like Mazinger
Z, it appears from a whirlpool upon the call of
'Mazin Go!', and is completed when Tetsuya's Brain
Condor combines with its head (Fire On). Its
power source is the same Photon Power Energy as
Mazinger Z, but its armor is made of Super Alloy
New Z, which surpasses Super Alloy Z, making it
even more durable than Mazinger Z. Due to its
development history, many of its weapons were
evolved and strengthened from Mazinger Z's arsenal.
Its unique attack methods include the giant sword
'Mazinger Blade' stored in both legs, and 'Thunder
Break', which stores lightning as energy and then
unleashes it. Additionally, a flight device called the
Scramble Dash is built into its back, allowing flight
at Mach 4. Later, the 'Great Booster', which
combines to improve flight performance, was
completed. It was also a powerful weapon that,
when rammed into enemies, exhibited destructive
power equivalent to a hydrogen bomb. After the war
against the Mycenae Empire ended, it was stored in
the Robot Science Museum alongside Venus A and
Boss Borot. In the theatrical version, there was a
scene where it was seized by enemies there and
fought against Grendizer.

A female-form combat robot developed to support
Great Mazinger.
 It is completed when Jun's small jet, the
'Quinstar,' launched from a waterfall basin, combines
with its head.
 Its overall combat power falls short of Great
Mazinger's, but it carries weapons capable of
standing up to the Battle Beasts, including the
'Photon Beam' fired from both eyes, the 'Finger
Missile' launched from its fingertips, and the
rapid-fire 'Photon Missile' from its chest.
 It initially had no flight capability, but this was
later remedied by the development of the Venus
Scrander.

A giant robot built by the three doctors of the
Photon Lab after Boss pressured them into it.
 Perhaps because it was built from scrap, it seems
to be extremely fragile, and it is beaten to pieces
almost every time it fights. But it also seems easy
to repair for the same reason, and it was operated
solely by Boss and his two friends. Notably, only
its head was built to be sturdy, and it never
broke no matter what happened to it.
 After helping Mazinger Z destroy Dr. Hell's forces,
it joined Great Mazinger in standing against the
ambitions of the Mycenae Empire.
 At first it fought using nothing but the raw
strength that had let it hold its own against
Mechanical Beasts, but this proved useless against
the Battle Beasts. To compensate, Boss and his
friends developed a variety of weapons and
finishing moves through trial and error, contributing
to the fight with attacks such as the 'Drill
Pressure Punch,' built for them by the
American-trained Dr. Tobita, as well as the
'Boroboro Kick' and the 'Borot Spin Kick.'
 Boss Borot is also the only robot to appear in all
three of the original TV series. It even had a
spin-off manga serialized in a children's magazine,
leaving no doubt that it made a memorable
impression in a very different way from the lead
robots.

The form Grendizer takes when combined with its
dedicated saucer-shaped mecha. The saucer-shaped
mecha alone is also called the Spazer.
 It supports Grendizer, which has no flight
capability of its own; once combined, the pair can
fly within the atmosphere at up to Mach 9 and
travel between stars via hyperspace navigation. Like
Grendizer, it runs on photon quantum energy and is
armored in space alloy Guren.
 Although some of Grendizer's own weapons become
unusable, the Spazer's various built-in armaments
were well suited to taking on large numbers of
Minifors at once.
 The enemy later discovered that combining with
the Spazer took six seconds, and began targeting
that window of vulnerability. This crisis was
overcome by combining instead with three
Earth-made Spazers developed by Dr. Umon, but as a
result, the original Spazer saw dramatically less
use in battle afterward.

A super robot developed as the guardian deity of
Planet Fleed.
 It runs on photon quantum energy, which is
dispersed throughout the cosmos, and is protected
by sturdy armor made of space alloy Guren. To
prevent misuse by others, it is equipped with a
self-defense system that unleashes an electric
shock against anyone who tries to board it without
the ring that marks the Fleed royal bloodline.
 Its main weapons include the 'Double Harken,'
which combines the crescent-shaped blades on both
shoulders, and 'Space Thunder,' which fires energy
generated from the horns on its head as an
incandescent beam; combined with its 1.8 million
horsepower, these give it extremely high combat
capability.
 It is powerful even alone, but combining with the
dedicated saucer mecha known as the Spazer
reinforces its aerial combat capability and
interstellar travel range. However, the enemy
discovered that combining with the Spazer took six
seconds, and began targeting that window of
vulnerability. This crisis was overcome by combining
instead with three Earth-made Spazers developed by
Dr. Umon, granting it even greater mobility and
combat capability.

A small saucer designed and developed by Koji
Kabuto at NASA, and Earth's first domestically
produced UFO. Its shape closely resembles the
Adamski-type saucer, the most famous flying saucer
design at the time of the show's original
broadcast.
 It has maneuverability comparable to a Minifor and
a top flight speed of Mach 4, and it can operate
at considerable altitude within the atmosphere.
However, since it was not developed for combat, it
carries only light armament, such as small missiles
and a machine gun.
 Running on photon power, armored in Chogokin Z,
and designed by the Kabuto family, it is, in its
small way, a direct descendant of Mazinger Z. Even
so, whenever it went into battle, it was often
outmatched by Saucer Beasts and took considerable
damage. Despite its different shape, it may be
closer in role to a partner robot like Diana A.

A flying machine developed by Dr. Umon that can
be described as an Earth-made Spazer.
 Built to support Grendizer's flight capability, it
adapts Grendizer for aerial combat when combined
(Combination Cross), reaching a top speed of
Mach 4.
 Its greatest advantage is that the weapons of
Grendizer, which are restricted when combined with
the original Spazer, can be used to their full
potential when combined with the Double Spazer
instead. Piloted by Koji, it also demonstrated high
offensive performance even while separated.
 All of the Earth-made Spazers run on the same
photon quantum energy as Grendizer, but their
armor is made of Chogokin New Z.

The second Earth-made Spazer, developed by Dr.
Umon to enhance Grendizer's underwater combat
capability.
 It is a versatile machine capable of operating in
both air and water even on its own, reaching a top
underwater speed of 40 knots. However, since it
can only dive to a depth of 400 meters, Grendizer
needed to use a different mecha, the 'Ultra
Submarine,' to operate in the deep sea.
 Its greatest benefit is that, when combined with
Grendizer, it can replenish the photon quantum
energy that Grendizer consumes at a sharply
increased rate underwater. It was primarily
operated by Hikaru, and it contributed greatly to
the fight against the Vega Beasts.

The third Earth-made Spazer, built by Dr. Umon to
enable Grendizer to fight underground.
 It can operate in both air and underground even
on its own, reaching a maximum underground speed
of Mach 1. Once combined, its arm-mounted weapons
become unusable, but its 'Drill Attack,' which uses
two large drills capable of effortlessly crushing
solid bedrock, is powerful, giving it some of the
greatest offensive power among the Earth-made
Spazers.
 Koji initially served as its pilot as well, but once
Maria appeared, control was entrusted to her.

A medium-sized saucer of the Vega Star Alliance
forces.
 It is roughly twice the size of the small Minifor
saucer, and it is equipped with a Vegatron Beam
Cannon.
 They swarm Grendizer in a variety of formations,
but are usually wiped out in an instant.

Appeared in Episode 4, 'Young Blood Burns
Crimson,' a Saucer Beast sent to locate Grendizer's
base.
 It indiscriminately destroyed the city with spikes
launched from its saucer section and flames
breathed from its mouth. It was also equipped with
an electromagnetic net, which it used to shoot
down a TFO.

A saucer beast that appeared in Episode 4, 'Young
Blood Burns Crimson', sent to locate Grendizer's
base. It indiscriminately destroyed the city with
spikes that shot out from its saucer section, and
fire and missiles breathed from its mouth. It was
also equipped with an electromagnetic net, easily
shooting down TFOs. However, it was toyed with by
the combination of Grendizer and TFO, which rushed
in, and was scattered by a finishing Space Thunder.

Appeared from Episode 73, 'For This Beautiful
Earth,' the strongest and last Vega Beast, piloted
personally by Lady Gandal.
 It tormented Grendizer with weapons such as a
blinding ray fired from the protrusions on its
chest and scorching flames breathed from its
mouth.

The strongest and final Vega Beast, which
appeared from Episode 73, 'For This Beautiful
Earth', and was piloted personally by Lady Gandal.
It tormented Grendizer with weapons such as a
beam from a protrusion on its chest that robbed
enemies of sight, and high-temperature flames from
its mouth. However, it was destroyed by the
combination of three Spazers and the Double Harken.

Flagship of the united Vega star forces, named
for King Vega himself. Like the TFO, it is believed
to have taken its design motif from the
cigar-shaped UFOs that were famous at the time.
 When the all-out attack on Earth began, King Vega
personally took command and sortied aboard it.

The flagship of the Vega Star Union, bearing the
name of King Vega. Like the TFO, its design is
thought to be based on the cigar-shaped flying
saucers famous at the time. During the total
attack on Earth, King Vega himself took command
and sortied. However, it was defeated by Grendizer
and Cosmo Special, the fourth Earth-made Spazer,
and was scattered along with King Vega's ambitions.

The form completed when the Get Machines combine
in the order Dragon, Liger, and Poseidon. As with
Getter 1, the pilot remains Ryouma Nagare.
 Unlike the old Getter, which was originally built
for space development, this Getter was designed
from the start for combat. With the installation of
a Getter Ray Amplifier, it became capable of
generating over ten times the power of the old
Getter. Its armor, made of Synthetic Element Steel
G, was also made far more durable.
 It excelled in aerial combat, using the 'Getter
Beam' at range and the 'Double Tomahawk' up close,
along with the 'Mach Wing' on its back. It is the
only form that can use Getter's ultimate finishing
move, the 'Shine Spark,' and it defeated countless
powerful foes with it.

Michiru Saotome's new mount, replacing the
Command Machine.
 Being lightweight, it has somewhat limited
durability, but excels in mobility.
 It served in a support role, providing covering
fire with 'Command Missiles,' scouting with its
onboard electronics, and resupplying the Getter
Robo.

A fighter craft of the Hyakki Empire, crewed by
common troops known as Hyakki soldiers.
 It mainly supports Hyakki mechs, though it
sometimes serves as the mainstay of an operation.
A bomber-type variant also exists.

A bomber-type variant also exists.

Appeared from Episode 1, 'Getter Robo Reborn!!,' a
Hyakki mech piloted by Ikkakuki.
 Beyond the giant blade on one arm, its weapons
are varied, including a ray fired from its eyes and
a beam launched from its horn.
 As a vanguard of the Hyakki Empire, it attacked
the Saotome Institute to seize the Getter Ray
Amplifier. Against the Getter Team, who were not
yet accustomed to their new Getter Robo, it
resorted to the cowardly tactic of taking Genki
hostage.

A Mecha Yosaiki piloted by Ikkakuki that appeared
from Episode 1, 'Getter Robo Revives!'. Besides the
giant pincer on one arm, its weapons were varied,
including beams from its eyes and shots from its
horn. As a vanguard of the Hyakki Empire, it
attacked Saotome Research Institute to steal the
Getter Ray amplifier. Against the Getter Team, who
were not yet used to the new Getter Robo, it used
the cowardly tactic of taking Genki hostage.
However, once the hostage was recaptured, it was
easily defeated by a Getter Beam.

Appeared in Episode 2, 'The Fearsome Riddle of the
Hyakki Empire,' a Hyakki mech piloted by Dokuganki.
 It can tunnel through the ground by spinning the
Hook Claws on both hands, and it planned to attack
the Saotome Institute from underground.

Appearing in episode 2, 'The Terror of the Hyakki
Empire's Mystery', this is a Hyakki Machine piloted
by Dokuganki. It advanced through the ground by
rotating the hook claws on both hands, and planned
an attack on the Saotome Research Institute from
underground. However, in underground combat, it was
defeated by the Getter Liger, which had the upper
hand.

Appeared in Episode 16, 'Death Match! A Man's
Path Through the Storm,' a Hyakki mech developed
personally by Tekkouki.
 Having thoroughly studied Getter Robo, its
performance is formidable, and it tormented the
Getter Team greatly with weaponry nearly identical
to Getter Robo's own, including a Tomahawk.

Appearing in episode 16, 'Deadly Battle! The Road
of a Stormy Man', this is a Hyakki Machine
developed by Tekkouki himself. Its performance, said
to have studied the Getter Robo thoroughly, was
powerful, and with weapons closely resembling the
Getter Robo's, such as the Tomahawk, it greatly
troubled the Getter Team. However, in the midst of
battle, it shielded the Getter Robo to block
Hydra's interference and took damage. Even so, it
challenged again, but was defeated before the
Getter Dragon.

Appeared in Episode 35, 'Old Hyakki Soldiers Never
Die,' a Hyakki mech piloted by Gyukenki.
 Beyond his battle-hardened swordsmanship, he
cornered the Getter with techniques such as the
'Hyakki Typhoon' blown from his mouth.

Appearing in episode 35, 'The Old Hyakki Soldier
Never Dies', this is a Hyakki Machine piloted by
Gyukenki. It pressed the Getter not only with
veteran swordsmanship but also with techniques like
the 'Hyakki Typhoon' blown from its mouth. But
when its sword was broken, it realized its defeat
and deliberately took the Shine Spark on its body,
exploding.

Appeared from Episode 20, 'All-Out Attack! Mecha

 It can carry two Hyakki mechs on its left and

Appearing from episode 20, 'Great Attack! Mecha

bombers and 200 fighters. With its overwhelming
firepower, it bombed Tokyo and destroyed the
Saotome Research Institute. But its superiority
ended there, and it was shattered by the newly
completed Shine Spark, becoming the first Hyakki
Machine to be destroyed.

Appeared from Episode 37, 'Crisis Looms in Japan's
Coastal Waters!,' the strongest Hyakki mech, formed

Juppoki.
 It boasts overwhelming power, and can also
separate back into its individual Hyakki mechs after
combining.

Appearing from episode 37, 'Crisis Approaches the
Waters Near Japan!', this is the strongest Hyakki
Machine formed by combining five units - Mecha
Koukakuki, Mecha Yamuchiki, Mecha Rimmaki, Mecha
Raijuki, and Mecha Juuhouki. It boasted overwhelming
power, and even after combining, it could separate
back into Hyakki Machines. But this proved to be
its downfall, as it was picked off one by one
after separating. Incidentally, it was originally
meant to be a combination of six units, but Mecha
Raidenki sortied alone to buy time and was
destroyed by the Getter, resulting in its current
form.

The Hyakki Empire's home base, built using their
own unique science and technology. Its armor is
sturdy enough to repel Getter's attacks.
 It normally floats on the ocean's surface, but its
ability to travel underwater made it difficult to
locate. Inside, Hyakki soldiers are modified and
Hyakki mechs are developed.
 Using the gravity control device left behind by
Dr. Gura, it also gained the ability to fly, and
during the final battle it attacked Tokyo from the
sky.

The headquarters built by the Hyakki Empire using
its own unique scientific technology. It has armor
sturdy enough to repel Getter attacks.
 It normally floats on the sea, but its ability to
navigate underwater made it difficult to discover.
Inside, Hyakki soldiers were being modified and
Hyakki machines were being developed.
 Using a gravity control device left by Dr. Glar, it
was able to fly, and during the final battle it
attacked Tokyo from the air. At first there seemed
to be no opening to strike, but Hayato, who had
been abducted, managed to punch a hole in the
outer wall. There it was hit by Shine Spark and
shattered along with Emperor Bry's ambitions.

A giant robot belonging to Blue Fixer, born of the
combined scientific might of Planet S-1 and Earth.
 Blue Fixer recovered the Pulsavarn after it
drifted ashore on the Moon. They then pooled all
their available technology to modify it so it could
combine with two Earth combat machines, creating
the only machine on Earth's side capable of
subspace combat. Like the Pulsavarn, it can only be
piloted by Marin, an expert in subspace mechanics.
 Combination begins with Marin's call of "Baldios,
charge up!" It is completed when the Pulsavarn
forms the head, torso, and arms, the Baldi Prise
forms the right leg, and the Cat Ranger forms the
left leg.
 It is powered by three engines - a deuterium
fusion engine, an anti-gravity engine, and a
subspace propulsion engine - and by switching
between them, it can operate anywhere. Its speed
within the atmosphere is Mach 25; in space it can
fly at 30% the speed of light, and within
subspace, at infinite speed.
 Its main weapons include the 'Bal Beam,' fired
from the crystal on its forehead, the 'Pulse Saber,'
a sword stored in a chest component, and the
'Thunder Flash,' which fires intense plasma from its
chest.

A giant robot belonging to Blue Fixer, created

to the moon. It was then remodeled with all

 Combination begins with Marin's call of 'Baldios,

forms the left leg to complete the unit.
 It uses three engines for power: a deuterium
fusion engine, an anti-gravity engine, and a
subspace propulsion engine, and by using them
appropriately it can operate anywhere. Its speed in
the atmosphere is Mach 25. In space it can fly at
30% of lightspeed, and in subspace at infinite
speed.
 Main weapons include the beam 'Bald Beam' fired
from the crest crystal, the sword 'Pulse Saber'
stored in the chest part, and 'Thunder Flash' which
fires intense plasma from the chest.
 In Episode 26, it received reinforcement
modifications, and new armaments were added,
including 'Pulse Saber Drinking' using two Pulse
Sabers and '3D-Valdi', an attack that creates
decoys.
 Incidentally, 'Space Warrior Baldios' was broadcast
for only 31 of its 39 episodes, but since all
information about the later episodes has been
released, it is a rare anime whose full story can
be known despite the interrupted broadcast. Many
settings are hidden in the unaired portions, and
'Valdiroizer' is one of them. It was to be Baldios's
final and strongest weapon used in the unaired
Episode 38, a suicidal attack that would destroy
Baldios itself if used.

A spacecraft built to destroy the moon Ganymede,
which the Aldebaron forces had moved into position
between Earth and the Sun. In truth it was not a
spacecraft at all, but a suicide weapon with a 0%
survival rate - its pilot would have no time to
escape before being caught in Ganymede's explosion.
 Because the speed reached the speed of light
when the launch boosters were jettisoned in space,
piloting it required subspace-mechanics knowledge
and piloting skill equal to Marin's own.
 Knowing full well she would never survive, Marin
volunteered as pilot. But David, who had been
assigned to Blue Fixer as a candidate pilot for the
New Pulsavarn, also volunteered, and in the end he
was the one chosen.

A spaceship built for the purpose of destroying
the satellite Ganymede, which was transported
between Earth and the Sun by the Aldebaron army.
But in reality it is not a spaceship at all; it is
a suicide weapon with a 0% survival rate, as the
pilot is caught in Ganymede's explosion with no
time to escape.
 When the launch booster is separated in space, its

knowledge of subspace dynamics and piloting skill
equal to Marin's.
 Despite knowing there was absolutely no chance of
survival, Marin volunteered as pilot. But David,
assigned to Blue Fixer as a candidate for the New
Palsaveren pilot, also volunteered, and in the end
he was chosen.
 Showing piloting skill that made Marin say he was
'better than myself', David charged while murmuring
the name of his beloved Quinnstein, and succeeded
in destroying Ganymede, fulfilling his mission.

The main combat fighter of the Aldebaron forces.

 It is used for every kind of mission, from
reconnaissance to interception. Countless units have

 When combining into God Sigma, it forms the parts

 Its weapons include the 'Rivet Gun,' which fires a

Shock,' which discharges electricity from its

A super robot developed by Dr. Kazami.
 KuRaiOh forms the upper body, KaiMeiOh the right
leg, and RikuShinOh the left leg; Big Wing then

completing the super robot God Sigma, which runs
on Trinity Energy as its power source.
 Normally the three pilots of KuRaiOh, KaiMeiOh,
and RikuShinOh remain in control as-is, but it is
also possible for the pilot of KuRaiOh alone to
operate it. In that case, however, the power of
KaiMeiOh and RikuShinOh cannot be fully utilized,
which is a drawback.
 Its armament includes the 'Finger Needle,' which
fires energy bolts from its fingertips, the 'God
Tomahawk,' which can be thrown or wielded by hand,
and the 'Spin Saucer,' a spiked disc thrown with a
sidearm motion. Its finishing move is a series of
swordsmanship techniques using the 'Musouken'

'Bamboo Splitter,' 'Reverse Diagonal Cut,' 'Cross
Cut,' 'Helmet Splitter,' 'Horizontal Cut,'
'Double-Edged Thrust,' 'Double-Edged Return Cut,'
'Two-Handed Cut,' 'Lightning Cut,' and 'Straight
Cut,' among others - a truly varied repertoire.

 Its armaments include the 'Finger Needle,' which

using the 'Musouken' stored in Big Wing. The

 Later, to counter the Cosmo Zaurus coated with

A super robot completed when Banjo seized a
prototype Megaborg developed on Mars by Souzou
Haran and modified it.
 It has a three-stage transformation mechanism,
able to change into the heavy fighter-bomber
Daifighter and the heavy tank Daitank. It houses
the small variable fighter Mach Attacker inside, and
that unit's cockpit block moves through the
machine's body to become Daitarn 3's pilot seat.
 Its main weapons include the beam-bladed sword
'Daitarn Zanbar,' the fan-shaped 'Daitarn Fan,'
which can also be used as a shield, and the
'Daitarn Web,' whose arm-mounted cross transforms
into a shuriken. Beyond these, it carries numerous
other weapons built into its whole body, including
missiles, cannons, and snappers.
 Its ultimate finishing move, the 'Sun Attack,'
fires a bolt of light from the sun disc on its
forehead with the call, "Lend me the power of the
sun - now, my finishing blow, Sun Attack!" Other
variations of this call also exist, and on occasion
the call was made without the attack actually being
fired.

A super robot completed when Banjo seized a

Other patterns of this call existed, and there were
also times when it was called out but never fired.
 Incidentally, piloting it seemed to be very simple,
as Garrison, Beauty, Reika, and even Toppo all
operated it.

call, "Change, Daitarn!"

The machine completed when Kei's beloved mount,
the Bronco II, was severely damaged and, during
repairs, was reinforced and modified using Emaan
technology.
 The Bronco II's legs were kept as they were,
while its arms were replaced at Kei's request, since
he had liked the handling of the M.Lover's arms
when he piloted it. Furthermore, by adding a psycho
system along with three inertial control systems,
two anti-gravity levitation devices, and a nuclear
reactor with output approaching 500,000 horsepower,
it came to surpass the performance of the old
Drifand despite being a hastily assembled machine.
Thanks to its high performance, a mass-production
model was later developed as well.
 Beyond its robot form, the Orgaroid, another major
feature is its shape-shifting capability (VARIABLE
GEOMETRY), which lets it take four forms as the
situation demands: Flyer, GERWALK, and Tank.
 When it was completed, there was a scene in which
the members of the Factory discussed what to call
the new Bronco II, with everyone freely proposing
names like 'Valhalla' and 'Gammon.' In the end, it
was named 'Orguss,' after the name of a god of
war from the world Jabby came from. Incidentally,
'Nebulard,' one of the proposed names, was the
show's working title during its planning stage.

 Where Maaie's unit is close to the standard type,

armament. Though ill-suited to high-mobility combat,

such as a large Missile Gun pod, a grenade

 The Moraba is also equipped with the sympathetic

directly to the machine, it allows reflexive
movement even in situations where mechanical
piloting alone could not react in time. Thanks to
this system, even an inexperienced pilot can manage
a certain degree of combat.

mecha hangars and workshops capable of repair and
assembly.

A third-generation combat device developed by the
Chiram military to establish a new weapons system
suited to the chaos-torn world. Model number
MBG-21D-2.
 It is a legged fighter of the type commonly called
Gerwalk in Chiram weaponry, and it appears to be
produced in enormous numbers as a mainline unit. It
incorporates the new anti-gravity system
technology, which, while limiting its top speed,
greatly improves its mobility.
 Its firepower is formidable, combining a

ultra-thick steel plating used on the front of its
legs serves double duty, both for inertial
maneuvering and as a blunt weapon in close combat.

A large Walker Machine created by the Innocent, a
high-performance unit capable of movement nearly
indistinguishable from a human's. It conceals a
separation-and-combination mechanism linking two
mecha, as well as a transformation function into a
linked car form.
 Its outstanding mobility and output, along with its
wide array of optional weaponry, all far surpass
those of conventional Walker Machines.
 Its drawback is poor maintainability stemming from
the complexity of its mechanisms. Even Cattset's
skill reportedly struggled with it - there were
malfunctions where, after transforming, the head
would get stuck and fail to emerge.
 Two units existed. One had its wings destroyed by
Jiron, rendering it unable to transform, and it was
thereafter operated as the Sub Xabungle. It was
later destroyed in battle against the Greta Gully.

The first of three landships built to the Iron
Gear type. Its greatest feature is its ability to
transform into Walker Machine form.
 Provided by the Innocent to Elchi's father, Kyarin,
it possesses overwhelming combat power. On the
other hand, it is something of a prototype vessel,
with lingering issues in fuel efficiency and
maintainability, frequently breaking down and

 The original Iron Gear was badly damaged in battle

battle, and by capturing the Greta Gully and
repainting it, it has been put into service as the

the culmination of the know-how cultivated in the

carrying a wingman on its back. Later, the
installation of the Bio-Sensor, a simplified
psycommu, gave it the ability to follow Kamille's

inexplicable phenomena not included in the
specifications were also confirmed, such as
interfering with enemy mobile suit movements and
stopping them.

A machine reinforced and modified from the Gundam
Airmaster after it was heavily damaged in battle
with the New Federation Forces. It is the
crystallization of facilities and materials provided
by General Lee of the Republic of Estard, combined
with the ideas and skill of Kid, who was "moved"
by seeing them.
 At a glance, the change in the machine's color
from red to blue draws the most attention, but
this refit actually focuses on improving the
firepower that was the Airmaster's greatest
weakness. In particular, replacing the nose Vulcan
with a beam cannon allows it to display high combat
power in flight mode.
 Large boosters at the wingtips also improved its
thrust, to the point that it can now carry the
Gundam Leopard riding on top while flying, whereas
before it had to carry it by lifting it.
 By design, combining with the G Falcon could
theoretically produce output exceeding that of a
cruiser-class warship, but this was never put to
use in actual combat.

down numerous Septems and Daughtress Neos.

A mass-production mobile suit developed by
improving the Earth Alliance Forces' Strike Dagger.
 It inherits the Strike Dagger's greatest feature,
the 'Striker Pack' weapon-swapping system. This
allows it to achieve high versatility by switching
between packs such as the Jet Striker Pack, which
enables atmospheric flight, and the Doppelhorn Pack
for long-range attacks, depending on the situation.
 A differently colored variant, the Dark Dagger L,
also exists.

A mass-production mobile suit developed by
improving the Earth Alliance Forces' Strike Dagger.
 It inherits the Strike Dagger's greatest feature,
the 'Striker Pack' weapon-swapping system. This
allows it to achieve high versatility by switching
between packs such as the Jet Striker Pack, which
enables atmospheric flight, and the Doppelhorn Pack
for long-range attacks, depending on the situation.
 A differently colored variant, the Dark Dagger L,
also exists.

A fighter-type space mobile armor developed by
the Earth Alliance Forces.
 The successor to the Moebius Zero, it is equipped
with four of the wired-type 'Gun Barrel' units,
armed with beam cannons and beam edges. This is a
weapon that only someone with exceptional spatial
awareness can handle, but its pilot, Neo, wields it
as naturally as his own limbs, holding his own
without any trouble even against Shinn and Ray
simultaneously.

A fighter-type space mobile armor developed by
the Earth Alliance Forces.
 The successor to the Moebius Zero, it is equipped
with four of the wired-type 'Gun Barrel' units,
armed with beam cannons and beam edges. This is a
weapon that only someone with exceptional spatial
awareness can handle, but its pilot, Neo, wields it
as naturally as his own limbs, holding his own
without any trouble even against Shinn and Ray
simultaneously.

The Earth Alliance Forces' mainstay
mass-production mobile suit, succeeding the
Dagger-L.
 It is highly mobile thanks to large thrusters
mounted on its shoulders, back, and legs. Because
it can make use of the 'Striker Pack System' from
the Dagger-L, the generational transition was able
to proceed smoothly.
 In addition to the Jet Striker Pack, which enables
flight even under gravity, there also exists a Multi
Striker Pack equipped with nuclear missiles.

The Windam is the successor to the Dagger L and
the Earth Alliance's main mass-production mobile
suit. It is highly mobile due to the large thrusters
mounted on its shoulders, back, and legs. Since the
Strike Pack system from the Dagger L can be used
with it, this facilitated a smooth generational
transition. In addition to the Jet Striker Pack,
which allows flight under gravity, a Multi Striker
Pack equipped with nuclear missiles also exists. Its
base specs are high, but perhaps because it is
often shown being shot down by the Minerva's
mobile suit team, which surpasses it, no scenes of
it in action were seen.

Neo Roanoke's personal Windam, colored purple
unlike standard units.
 While the unit's base performance is unchanged
from a standard model, its Jet Striker Pack is a
special limiter-removed specification, giving it a
substantial boost in thrust.
 Since it lacked weaponry that could take
advantage of Neo's true forte - his spatial
awareness - it saw no particularly flashy exploits,
but it nevertheless held its own, and more, against
both Shinn and Athrun.

This is Neo Roanoke's personal Windam unit. Unlike
the standard units, it is painted in a purple color
scheme.
 The basic performance of the unit is no different
from the standard models, but the Jet Striker pack
is a special specification with the limiters removed,
greatly increasing its thrust.
 Because it was not equipped with weapons that
could make use of Neo's true specialty, his spatial
awareness ability, it did not have any flashy
achievements, but even so it fought on par with or
better than Shinn and Athrun.
 In the battle at Berlin, it was shot down by Kira,
who pierced the flight unit along with both arms.
At the time it was flying at a considerable
altitude, but the impact of the crash did not cause
the machine to explode, so its impact resistance
appears to be quite high.

A mobile suit developed as one of ZAFT's
new-generation high-performance 'Second Stage
Series' units.
 One of three new-model Gundams stolen from the
military PLANT Armory One by the Earth Alliance
Forces' special unit Phantom Pain. Because of this,
it carries designation numbers from both ZAFT
(ZGMF-X24S) and the Alliance (RGX-01).
 With large thrusters on its back and waist, it is
a unit specialized for combat in open space,
capable of independent flight even within the
atmosphere using that same output. Its mobility
increases further after morphing into mobile armor
form.
 Its distinctive armament includes Mobile Armament
Pods based on an improved DRAGOON System, which
allow it to carry out an All-Range Attack. Using
this, it instantly wiped out two GuAIZ R units
from the Minerva that had been sent in pursuit
from Armory One.

A mobile suit developed as part of ZAFT's
new-generation high-performance 'Second Stage
Series.'
 It is one of three new Gundams stolen from the
military plant Armory One by the Earth Alliance
special forces unit Phantom Pain. Due to that
history, it carries model numbers from both ZAFT
(ZGMF-X24S) and the Alliance (RGX-01).
 The large thrusters on its back and waist make it
a machine specialized for space combat, and within
the atmosphere it can use that output for
independent flight. After transforming into mobile
armor form, its maneuverability improves even
further.
 Its distinctive armament includes mobile weapon
pods that improve on the DRAGOON system, enabling
all-range attacks. Using these, it instantly
destroyed two GOUF Ignited units launched from the
Minerva in pursuit from Armory One.
 However, those were about its only notable
achievements. Afterwards it was cornered by Athrun
and others at Junius Seven, defeated by Kira off
the coast of Crete, and shot down by Orb's
Murasame squadron in Berlin.

A mobile suit developed as one of ZAFT's
new-generation high-performance 'Second Stage
Series' units.
 One of three new-model Gundams stolen from the
military PLANT Armory One by the Earth Alliance
Forces' special unit Phantom Pain. Because of this,
it carries designation numbers from both ZAFT
(ZGMF-X31S) and the Alliance (RGX-02).
 A highly versatile unit usable in a variety of
battle conditions, it performs at its absolute best
in underwater combat. When it morphs into its
uniquely shaped mobile armor form, it can swim
freely underwater like a fish returned to water. It
once toyed with Ray's and Lunamaria's ZAKUs
simultaneously and sank the submarine carrier
Nilagongo, among other feats.

A mobile suit developed as part of ZAFT's
new-generation high-performance 'Second Stage
Series.'
 It is one of three new Gundams stolen from the
military plant Armory One by the Earth Alliance
special forces unit Phantom Pain. Due to that
history, it carries model numbers from both ZAFT
(ZGMF-X31S) and the Alliance (RGX-02).
 It is a highly versatile machine that can be
deployed in a variety of combat situations, but it
displays its maximum performance especially in
underwater combat. When it transforms into its
uniquely shaped mobile armor form, it can swim
through the water with complete freedom, like a
fish in water. It toyed with both Ray's and
Lunamaria's ZAKUs simultaneously and also sank the
submarine carrier Niragon Goh, among other
achievements.
 However, it is ironic that its end came when it
was pierced by the Blast Impulse Gundam on the
water's surface - its own favored field.

A mobile suit developed as one of ZAFT's
new-generation high-performance 'Second Stage
Series' units.
 One of three new-model Gundams stolen from the
military PLANT Armory One by the Earth Alliance
Forces' special unit Phantom Pain. Because of this,
it carries designation numbers from both ZAFT
(ZGMF-X88S) and the Alliance (RGX-03).
 Following in the design lineage of the BuCUE and
LaGOWE, it can morph into a four-legged beast-type
mobile armor form. Specialized for ground-based
melee combat, its basic tactic is to close the
distance on enemies using its mobility and agility,
then cut them down with its wing-shaped beam
blades.

A mobile suit developed as part of ZAFT's
new-generation high-performance 'Second Stage
Series.'
 It is one of three new Gundams stolen from the
military plant Armory One by the Earth Alliance
special forces unit Phantom Pain. Due to that
history, it carries model numbers from both ZAFT
(ZGMF-X88S) and the Alliance (RGX-03).
 Following in the lineage of the BuCUE and LaGOWE,
it can transform into a four-legged beast-type
mobile armor form. It specializes in melee combat
on land, using its mobility and maneuverability to
close in on enemies and slice them in two with its
wing-shaped beam blades as its basic tactic.
 In battle, it fought on par with or better than
Lunamaria and Shinn, and also shot down Heine.
However, Stella, lacking mental stability, sortied
alone on her own authority and was shot down as a
result.

A mobile suit developed as one of ZAFT's
new-generation high-performance 'Second Stage
Series' units.
 One of three new-model Gundams stolen from the
military PLANT Armory One by the Earth Alliance
Forces' special unit Phantom Pain.
 This unit was recovered by ZAFT after being
disabled in combat against the Saviour Gundam and
the Impulse Gundam. During its transport back to
PLANT, the Clyne Faction apparently pulled some
strings, and it ended up being sent to the Eternal
instead. It was subsequently repainted in a coloring
reminiscent of the LaGOWE and became Waltfeld's
personal unit.

A mobile suit developed as part of ZAFT's
new-generation high-performance 'Second Stage
Series.'
 It is one of three new Gundams stolen from the
military plant Armory One by the Earth Alliance
special forces unit Phantom Pain.
 This is the unit that ZAFT recovered after it
was rendered inoperable in battle against the
Saviour Gundam and Impulse Gundam. During
transport to PLANT, the Clyne faction apparently
intervened by some means, and it was sent to the
Eternal. Afterwards it was repainted in a color
scheme reminiscent of the LaGOWE and became
Waltfeld's personal machine. However, since Waltfeld
needed to serve as captain of the Eternal, it was
almost never used.

A mobile suit developed as one of ZAFT's
new-generation high-performance 'Second Stage
Series' units. It was entrusted to Athrun by
Durandal when he was appointed to FAITH.
 Specialized for aerial combat, it gains even
greater mobility by morphing into mobile armor form,
which also enables long-range cruising. It served as
a mainstay unit for the Minerva, which fought
frequently at sea.
 In battle, it can use hit-and-run tactics that
exploit its high mobility, as well as attacks that
vary in speed to confuse the enemy.

A mobile suit developed by ZAFT as part of the
'Second Stage Series' of new-generation
high-performance machines. It was entrusted to
Athrun by Durandal when he was appointed to
FAITH. The unit is specialized for aerial combat,
and by transforming into mobile armor mode it gains
even greater mobility and is capable of long-range
cruising. It served as the mainstay of the Minerva,
which saw much combat over the sea. In battle, it
could employ hit-and-run tactics using its high
mobility, and confound enemies with attacks that
varied in speed. Later, it engaged Kira's Freedom
Gundam after a difference of opinion led them into
conflict, but found itself at a disadvantage in
basic performance against a unit equipped with a
Neutron Jammer Canceller, and struggled.
Furthermore, Kira's manifestation of SEED proved
decisive, and the Saviour was sliced apart by beam
sabers.

ZAFT's most advanced mobile suit, developed to
bring a decisive end to the war against the Earth
Alliance Forces.
 As Shinn's abilities grew rapidly, Durandal came to
believe that the Impulse Gundam could no longer
make full use of his talent, and had fine
adjustments made to the unit, effectively making it
Shinn's personal machine.
 It is equipped with the 'Hyper Deuterion,' a power
plant that combines a nuclear engine with the
Deuterion Beam Transmission System, and can
generate wings of light from its wing parts to
achieve tremendous mobility.
 It combines all the strengths of the Impulse
Gundam's three configurations, successfully
achieving both a varied arsenal effective at any
range and outstanding maneuverability. Further
equipped with unique systems such as palm-mounted
beam cannons and a Mirage-Colloid-based Double
function, it realizes the concept of a single unit
capable of handling any battle situation.

ZAFT's most advanced mobile suit, developed to
bring a decisive end to the war with the Earth
Alliance. As Shinn grew rapidly, Durandal judged
that the Impulse Gundam could no longer fully
utilize his talents, and had this unit finely tuned,
effectively making it Shinn's personal machine. It is
equipped with the 'Hyper Duetrion' power system,
which combines a nuclear engine with the Deuterion
Beam energy transmission system, and can generate
Wings of Light from its wing parts to achieve
tremendous mobility. It combines the strengths of
all three Impulse Gundam forms, successfully
reconciling a versatile arsenal effective at any
range with outstanding maneuverability. Furthermore,
unique equipment such as palm beam cannons and a
afterimage function applying Mirage Colloid was
added, realizing the concept of a single unit
capable of handling any combat situation. However,
the lack of armament on the legs proved to be its
undoing; during a melee exchange of kicks with
the Infinite Justice, its right leg was destroyed by
the Griffon Beam Blade, and it fell to the lunar
surface.

The most advanced mobile suit, an evolution of
the Providence Gundam developed in the closing days
of the previous war.
 It was originally intended to be given to Athrun,
from whom great things were expected, but when
Athrun himself attempted to defect from ZAFT,
Ray, who pursued him, ended up piloting it instead
- and it became his machine from then on.
 The 'DRAGOON System' mounted on its back has
improved response thanks to an upgraded quantum
interface, allowing it to be used regardless of the
pilot's spatial awareness. In outer space, it shows
its true worth by detaching from the main body to
carry out an All-Range Attack. Within the
atmosphere, it remains attached and instead adjusts
its angle, enabling multiple attacks across all 360
degrees.

A state-of-the-art mobile suit developed as an
evolution of the Providence Gundam, which was built
near the end of the previous war. Initially, it was
intended to be given to Athrun, whose performance
was highly anticipated, but when Athrun attempted
to defect from ZAFT, Ray, who was pursuing him,
boarded the unit instead, and it became his favored
machine. The 'Dragoon System' mounted on the back
has improved response through refinements to the
quantum interface, and can be used without being
limited by the pilot's spatial awareness. In space,
it displays its full potential by deploying all-range
attacks with separated units. Within the
atmosphere, it can adjust the angle of the units
without separating them to deliver multiple attacks
in all 360 degrees. It fought on equal terms
against Kira's Strike Freedom Gundam, who opposed
Durandal. However, Ray was shot down when he was
caught off guard by a momentary distraction caused
by Kira's words. Notably, at the end of the
previous war, a decisive battle was fought between
the Freedom Gundam and Providence Gundam, the
forerunners of these two units. The fact that the
pilot of the Providence Gundam at that time was
Rau Le Creuset, a being extremely close to Ray,
also speaks to their deep-seated connection.

A mobile suit developed by ZAFT in the closing
days of the previous war and entrusted by Lacus
to Kira. It was heavily damaged in battle against
the Providence Gundam during the final battle of
that war, but was secretly repaired in Orb and
kept in strict storage deep within an underground
shelter.
 Though an older machine, it is equipped with a
Neutron Jammer Canceller, technology now banned
from installation in mobile suits. Because it uses a
nuclear fusion engine for power, it has no limit on
operating time, giving it performance that can
overwhelm current-generation units. Kira, who wished
to avoid further fighting, kept it sealed away, but
was ultimately forced to pilot it again in order to
protect Lacus and those around her from an
assassination squad. Since then it has operated
together with the Archangel, used only to strip
enemies of their mobility and combat capability.

A mobile suit developed by ZAFT near the end of
the previous war and entrusted to Kira by Lacus.
It was heavily damaged during the final battle of
that war against the Providence Gundam, but was
secretly repaired in Orb and stored deep within an
underground shelter. Although it is an older
machine, it is equipped with a Neutron Jammer
Canceller, the installation of which is now
prohibited on mobile suits. Powered by a nuclear
fusion engine, it has no operational time limit and
possesses performance capable of overwhelming
current-generation units. It was sealed away by
Kira, who did not desire conflict, but he was
forced to pilot it to protect Lacus and those
around him from an assassination squad. Thereafter,
it accompanied the Archangel, and was used solely
to reduce the mobility and offensive capability of
opponents. It was defeated and destroyed beyond
recognition by Shinn, who, burning with rage over
Stella's death, launched unpredictable multi-layered
attacks.

The most advanced mobile suit, developed alongside
the Infinite Justice Gundam at the 'Factory,' the
base of the anti-Durandal Clyne Faction.
 It has a gold frame housing a new type of power
plant, the laser fusion engine, giving it output
several times that of the Freedom Gundam. Its
newly added 'Super DRAGOON Mobile Weapon System'
allows the mobility-enhancing wing sections to
detach and be used as wirelessly guided beam
weapons. In its first sortie, it made a spectacular
debut using this new weapon, disabling a combined
total of twenty-five ZAKUs and GOUFs in just two
minutes.
 Its armor has also been changed to VPS Armor,
and it even has a built-in beam shield, making it a
unit with no weak point to exploit in either
offense or defense. If it has any single flaw, it is
that its performance is so high that no one but
Kira can handle it.
 Its official name is 'Strike Freedom Gundam,' but
Kira consistently called it simply 'Freedom.'

A state-of-the-art mobile suit developed alongside
the Infinite Justice Gundam at the 'Factory,' a
stronghold of the Clyne faction opposing Durandal.
It features a gold frame and mounts a new laser
nuclear fusion engine, boasting several times the
output of the Freedom Gundam. The newly equipped
'Super Dragoon Mobile Weapon System' allows the
wing components, which enhance mobility, to
separate and be used as wire-guided beam weapons.
In its first sortie, it made a brilliant debut by
using this new weapon to disable a total of 25
Zaku and GOUF units in just two minutes. Its armor
has also been changed to VPS Armor, and it even
incorporates a beam shield, making it a machine
with no gaps in offense or defense. If there is a
single drawback, it is that its performance is so
high that no one other than Kira can handle it. Its
official designation is 'Strike Freedom Gundam,' but
Kira consistently called it 'Freedom.' Unlike the
Freedom Gundam, which was heavily damaged at the
end of the previous war, this unit finished the
conflict in near-perfect condition. It is a main
unit more deserving of the title than the one that
bears the program's name in its invincibility.

The most advanced mobile suit, developed alongside
the Strike Freedom Gundam at the 'Factory,' the
base of the anti-Durandal Clyne Faction.
 An evolution of the Justice Gundam that Athrun
piloted during the previous war, it also
incorporates technology from ZAFT's 'Second Stage
Series.' It carries a laser fusion engine within a
silver frame, and its greatest feature, the
combined thruster-and-weapon unit 'Fatum-01,' has
also received major reinforcement and improvement.
 Both the unit itself and Fatum-01 are equipped
with numerous close-quarters melee weapons, and
when used as an assault weapon it dealt a fatal
blow to the Minerva's propulsion system. In the
final battle it was used against the interior of
Requiem, successfully destroying it.

The latest mobile suit developed at the 'Factory',
the stronghold of the Clyne faction opposing
Durandal, alongside the Strike Freedom Gundam. It
is a development of the Justice Gundam that Athrun
piloted in the previous war, and incorporates
technology from ZAFT's 'Second Stage Series'. It is
equipped with a laser nuclear fusion engine in its
silver frame, and its signature thruster and
armament unit, the 'Fatum-01', has been greatly
enhanced and improved. The main body is loaded
with numerous melee weapons, and in its use as a
shock weapon it dealt fatal damage to the
Minerva's propulsion system. In the final battle, it
was used inside Requiem and succeeded in destroying
it. Unlike the Justice Gundam, which left no
prototype after being self-destructed in the
previous war, this unit finished the fight in almost
perfect condition except for the 'Fatum-01'.
Perhaps this too is an indicator of Athrun's
growth.

A mobile suit left to Cagalli by Uzumi Nara Athha,
Orb's former Chief Representative.
 Development had been underway since the previous
war, but because the latest technology was
incorporated at every stage, it was ultimately
completed as a high-performance unit that rivals
current-generation mobile suits.
 The Oowashi (Golden Eagle) Equipment is
optimized for operation within the atmosphere, with
an attached flight unit enabling independent flight.
High-energy beam cannons mounted on either side
give it strong long-range attack capability.
 Its dazzling golden body is the 'Yatanokagami,' an
anti-beam defense and reflection system that
absorbs beams fired at the unit, locks onto the
attacking enemy, and reflects the beam back at
them. This grants it high defensive power as well
as the ability to turn an opponent's own attack
directly into a counterattack. However, it has the
weakness of being unable to fully guard against
solid projectile weapons.

A mobile suit left to Cagalli by Uzumi Nara Athha,
former representative of Orb. Development had
progressed since the previous war, but because the
latest technology was incorporated each time, it
was completed as a high-performance machine
rivaling current mobile suits. The Oowashi pack is
specialized for use in the atmosphere, and with its
equipped flight unit it can fly independently. It
carries high-energy beam cannons on both sides,
giving it high long-range attack capabilities. Its
dazzling gold body is the anti-beam defense and
reflection system 'Yatanokagami', which absorbs
beams fired at the unit and reflects them after
locking onto the enemy. This provides high
defensive power and allows the enemy's attacks to
be used for counterattacks. However, it cannot
fully block physical weapons, so when hit by the
Destiny Gundam's Flash Edge 2, its left arm was
severed.

A mobile suit left to Cagalli by Uzumi Nara Athha,
Orb's former Chief Representative.
 When it was taken up into space, Neo took over
as pilot in place of Cagalli, who had to remain in
Orb.
 The Shiranui Equipment is optimized for operation
in space, and its greatest feature is the 'Guided
Mobile Beam Turret System,' an adaptation of the
DRAGOON System designed so that anyone can use
it. Neo, who already possessed superior spatial
awareness, handled it with complete freedom - on
offense, destroying numerous enemy mobile suits at
once, and on defense, linking the beam turrets
together to form a barrier.

A mobile suit left to Cagalli by Uzumi Nara Athha,
former representative of Orb. When going into
space, Neo (Mu), taking over for Cagalli who had
to remain in Orb, became its pilot. The Shiranui
pack is specialized for space use, and its greatest
feature is the 'Guided Mobile Beam Turret System',
an improvement on the DRAGOON system that anyone
can use. Neo (Mu), who originally had excellent
spatial awareness, used it freely, destroying many
enemy mobile suits at once on offense and
deploying barriers by linking the beam turrets on
defense. In the final battle, he thrust his machine
between the Archangel's bridge and an incoming
barrage. In the same situation during the previous
war, the unit was destroyed while stopping the
attack, but at this second opportunity, he
succeeded in enduring it.

Orb's next-generation mass-production mobile suit,
developed by Morgenroete. It is the successor to
the M1 Astray and retains traces of its
predecessor's design in the shape of its head.
 Designed with carrier-based operation in mind, it
can take either a general-purpose mobile suit form
or a high-mobility fighter jet form. Despite being a
mass-production unit, its base performance is by no
means low, and it is a well-balanced machine
overall. Thanks to the resolve and unity of the
Orb forces, it performed beyond its specifications.

The next-generation mass-produced mobile suit of
the Orb military, developed at Morgenroete. It is
the successor to the M1 Astray, and its heritage
can be seen in the design of its head. As it is
intended for carrier operations, it can take a
general-purpose mobile suit form and a high-mobility
fighter form. Although it is a mass-produced unit,
its basic performance is by no means low, and it is
a well-balanced machine overall. Through the
determination and unity of the Orb military, it
performed beyond its specs, cornering the Minerva
and shooting down the Chaos Gundam.

Andrew Waltfeld's personal Murasame.
 It is distinguished by its yellow coloring, though
its performance is the same as a standard unit.
 It sortied in the Battle of the Dardanelles Strait,
where Waltfeld, quipping "I'm not as good as Kira,"
shot down numerous Murasames with it.

A Murasame customized for Andrew Waltfeld. Its
yellow coloring is distinctive, but the machine's
performance is the same as the standard units. It
sortied in the Battle of the Dardanelles, and
Waltfeld, who claimed to be 'not as skilled as Kira',
shot down many Murasames. After Waltfeld returned
to the Eternal, Kisaka took his place and sortied
in the Orb defense battle.

A prototype mobile armor developed by the Earth
Alliance Forces.
 Its crab-like silhouette and sheer size overwhelm
anyone who faces it. Indeed, the Minerva's bridge
crew - Arthur in particular - were considerably
shaken the first time they laid eyes on it.
 It possesses mobility unimaginable for its massive
frame, and can attack in all directions using its
claws and beam cannons. It is also a formidable
unit capable of deploying a positron reflector on
its front to bounce back even the Minerva's
Tannhauser cannon. However, to make full use of
its capabilities, it requires a crew of three - a
captain, a helmsman, and a gunner.

Zamza-Zah was a prototype mobile armor developed
by the Earth Alliance. Its crab-like silhouette and
enormous size gave those who faced it an
overwhelming sense of intimidation. In fact, the
Minerva's bridge crew, especially Arthur, were quite
shocked upon seeing it for the first time. Despite
its massive frame, it possessed unexpected mobility
and could attack in all directions with its claws
and beam cannons. Furthermore, it could deploy
positron reflectors on its front and was a powerful
unit capable of repelling even the Minerva's
Tannhauser. However, to make full use of its
performance, it required three crew members: a
commander, a helmsman, and a gunner, in addition to
the pilot. The initial type deployed pushed the
Impulse Gundam to the brink of being shot down,
but that became the trigger for Shinn's SEED to
awaken. It was overwhelmed by his dramatically
improved movements after the awakening and was
ultimately pierced through the cockpit and
destroyed.

A prototype developed by the Earth Alliance,
combining the upper body of a mobile suit (a
Strike Dagger) with the lower body of a mobile
armor.
 Its Positron Reflector grants it high defensive
power, and it was deployed mainly for base defense.
Unlike the Positron Reflector used by the
Zamza-Zah, this one deploys to the front, allowing
for quick switching between offense and defense.
 It also carries a wide array of ranged weapons,
making it unmatched in long-range combat.

Gells-Ghe was a prototype unit developed by the
Earth Alliance that possessed the upper body of a
mobile suit, the Strike Dagger, and the lower body
of a mobile armor. It boasted high defensive
capabilities thanks to its positron reflector, which
was primarily deployed for base defense. Unlike the
Zamza-Zah's reflector, its positron reflector was
deployed toward the front, allowing for rapid
switching between offense and defense. It was also
well-armed with ranged weapons and displayed
unmatched strength in long-range combat. However,
on the other hand, it could not adequately respond
to close-quarters combat, and after being closed in
on by the Saviour Gundam, it was easily shot down.

A mass-produced giant mobile armor developed by
the Earth Alliance.
 It lacks the visual impact of the Zamza-Zah or
Gells-Ghe, but its large beam cannon and Positron
Reflector give it a good balance of offense and
defense, along with excellent mobility. However, it
carries no armament suited for close combat,
leaving it weak at close range.

A mass-produced giant mobile armor developed by
the Earth Alliance.
 It lacks the visual impact of the Zamza-Zah or
Gells-Ghe, but its large beam cannon and Positron
Reflector give it a good balance of offense and
defense, along with excellent mobility. However, it
carries no armament suited for close combat,
leaving it weak at close range.

A giant mobile suit that the Earth Alliance and
LOGOS had developed by Adukarf Mechano-Industry.
The listed overall length covers only the unit
itself; including the back-mounted weapons unit,
its size exceeds 50 meters.
 The overwhelming firepower of its numerous
full-body armaments, its thick armor, and the
Positron Reflectors mounted on both arms let it
maintain a high standard of both offense and
defense. In its mobile armor mode, in which the
back-mounted weapons unit covers the upper body,
it is also capable of low-altitude flight.
 It is a machine exclusive to Extended pilots.
Stellar boarded the first unit built and engulfed
cities across western Eurasia, including Berlin, in
flame. The five units built afterward were
committed to the battle at Heaven's Base, where
Sting and others piloted them and inflicted massive
damage on the ZAFT fleet.

The Destroy Gundam was a massive mobile suit
developed by the Earth Alliance and LOGOS at the
Adukaf Mechano Industries company. Its stated
total length covered only the main unit, and
including the rear weapon unit, its size exceeded
fifty meters. It maintained a high standard in both
offense and defense through the overwhelming
firepower of its numerous weapons mounted across
its body, thick armor, and the positron reflectors
equipped on both arms. In its mobile armor form,
where the rear weapon unit covered its upper body,
it was also capable of low-altitude flight. It was a
unit designed exclusively for Extenders, and Stella
piloted the initial production model, engulfing cities
across western Eurasia, including Berlin, in flames.
The five units produced afterward were deployed in
the battle at Heaven's Base, where Sting and the
others piloted them and inflicted tremendous damage
on the ZAFT fleet. However, all units were
destroyed through the combined efforts of Shinn,
Ray, and Lunamaria.

ZAFT's newest warship, built to operate and
coordinate with the 'Second Stage Series' units. It
is equipped with catapults compatible with the
Silhouette System and a Deuterion beam transmission
system.
 It can move at high speed regardless of
environment, whether in space, on land, or at sea.
Its armament is equally abundant: the positron
cannon 'Tannhauser', beam cannons, solid rounds,
Gatling cannons, and a wide variety of missiles for
space, ground, interception, and torpedo use, among
a great deal more. In addition, the bridge -
traditionally a warship's greatest weakness - is
shielded during combat, making this an all-purpose
warship that can fight without worry.

The Minerva was the latest ZAFT warship built
with the goal of operating and coordinating the
Second Stage Series units. It was equipped with a
catapult compatible with the Silhouette System and
the Deuterion Beam transmission system. It could
move at high speed regardless of location, whether
in space, on the ground, or at sea. Its armaments
were also abundant, including positron cannons, beam
cannons, solid rounds, gatling cannons, and various
missiles for space, ground, anti-aircraft, and
torpedo purposes. Moreover, the bridge, which had
been a warship's greatest weakness, was shielded
during combat, making it an all-purpose battleship
that could head into battle without concern.
Although it set sail without a proper launching
ceremony, it continued to achieve significant
results in various locations even before the war
began, making its name famous as ZAFT's strongest
force. However, during the final battle at Messiah,
it was defeated by the Archangel and rendered
combat-incapable.

A special warship operated by Phantom Pain, a
special forces unit of the Earth Alliance. Talia
referred to it as 'Bogey One' during pursuit.
 It is equipped with Mirage Colloid, banned by
treaty, and excels at stealth operations using it.
The ship also contains a maintenance room for
Extended pilots, allowing mental conditioning and
memory manipulation to be carried out at any time.
 It was used in the seizure of the new Gundams at
Armory One, and fulfilled that role admirably.

The Girty Lue was a special warship operated by
Phantom Pain, a special forces unit of the Earth
Alliance. Talia referred to it as Bogey One during
the pursuit. It was equipped with Mirage Colloid,
which was prohibited by treaty, and excelled in
stealth operations using it. The ship also contained
a maintenance room for Extenders, where
psychological adjustments and memory manipulation
could be performed at any time. It was used to
seize the new Gundams at Armory One and fulfilled
that role perfectly. It was also used when Djibril
escaped from the Daedalus base on the Moon, but
its bridge was crushed by the Legend Gundam's
Beam Spike, and the ship was sunk.

A special assault carrier built for mobile suit
operations, constructed at the neutral colony
Heliopolis by Orb's Morgenroete at the request of
the Atlantic Federation during the previous war.
 After the previous war ended, it was repaired
with Cagalli's support and hidden on the seabed off
Orb. But with the return of a chaotic era, its
former crew were gathered once more and it took
to the skies again. At the time, Murrue - with the
battle-hardened veteran Waltfeld aboard - proposed
giving up the captain's seat, but in the end the
entire bridge crew agreed that Murrue should remain
in command.
 Equipped with Laminated Armor, positron cannons,
and numerous other powerful systems, it still
displays high combat capability even two years
after its construction. Its appearance has changed
little, but it has gained submersion capability and
had its various electronic systems upgraded. Living
conditions aboard have also been improved, the
crowning example being, of all things, a hot spring.
One cannot help but wonder what would happen if it
attempted another barrel roll in its current state.

A ZAFT-developed ship dedicated to operating the
Freedom Gundam and Justice Gundam. Many former
ZAFT crew members are aboard, including Lacus, the
symbol of the Clyne Faction, Captain Waltfeld, and
Dacosta and Meyrin.
 Though it is outgunned by the Archangel, it
possesses enough speed to easily outrun ZAFT's
fast Nazca-class ships. It also carries the Freedom
Gundam and Justice Gundam's weapons unit, the
'METEOR', mounted on its bow; the unit detaches
when the two Gundams make use of it, but
otherwise serves as a gun battery.

A high-speed combat vessel of ZAFT.
 A considerable number have been deployed since
the previous war, with emphasis placed on mobility
and mobile suit operation rather than firepower.
 The Voltaire, flagship of the Joule Team led by
Yzak, is also a Nazca-class vessel.

A large space carrier of ZAFT, the
Gondwana-class.
 Equipped with four mobile suit decks, sixteen
catapults, and mobility sufficient for fleet
operations, it is the ship that forms the core of
ZAFT's space combat forces.

A large space carrier of ZAFT, the

 Equipped with four mobile suit decks, sixteen

A small space warship of the Earth Alliance.
 Originally an escort vessel, it was refitted into a
mobile-suit carrier by adding catapults and a
hangar, and now serves a wide variety of purposes.
 Variants equipped with a reflector shield on the
bow have also been confirmed.

A space carrier of the Earth Alliance.
 Originally designed as a carrier for mobile armors,
it boasts one of the largest mobile suit capacities
among all ships in Alliance service.

A space carrier of the Earth Alliance.
 Originally designed as a carrier for mobile armors,

An Overman that Duke Medaiyu kept hidden at
Domepolis Wulgusk, disguised as a work of art.
 When Gainer activated it, he combined his own
name with the title 'King', earned as a game
champion, to name it 'King Gainer'.
 Its weapons include the Chain Gun, usable as both
a sword and a gun; the Needler, wielded like a
dagger; and buckshot grenades that scatter
numerous bomblets. Spare units of each are carried
in a pouch on the left thigh, allowing it to fight
dual-wielding two Chain Guns, among other tactics.
 Its Overskill, 'Acceleration', lets it move at such
tremendous speed that it leaves afterimages.

At Domepolis Wulgusk, this Overman was stored by
Duke Medaiyu under the guise of an art object.
 The Gainer who activated it combined the game
champion title 'King' with his own name to call it
'King Gainer'.
 Its weapons include the Chengan, which can be
used as both a sword and a gun, the Needler
wielded like a dagger, and scatter grenades that
release large numbers of bombs. Spare rounds for
each are kept in the pouch on its left thigh,
allowing tactics such as dual-wielding two Chengan
blades.
 With the Overskill 'Acceleration', it could move at
super speed that created afterimages, but this was
only a fraction of its power.
 In the battle against the fully awakened
Overdevil, King Gainer activated its true Over
Skills: 'Overfreeze' (the cessation of all motion,
the same ability as the Overdevil) and its
opposite, 'Over Heat' (the activation of all
motion). It drove off the Overdevil with these.
Because of this ability, it is speculated that King
Gainer may be an Overman created as a servant of
the Overdevil, or as one designed to oppose the
Overdevil.

A Silhouette Machine used by the Gauli Squad.
 Operated with defense rather than offense as its
purpose, it is unusual among both Overmen and
Silhouette Machines in carrying a shield, giving it
high defensive performance.
 It mounts a 12.7mm machine gun on its body and
carries a 60mm Rivet Gun as a handheld weapon.
Though it lacks a decisive finishing blow, its
well-balanced overall performance makes it seem
quite easy to handle.
 Later, Mamadou developed an anti-Silhouette
Machine weapon that uses electromagnetic waves to
interfere with the startup of Muscle Engines, giving
the Panther more opportunities to shine offensively
as well.

A Silhouette Machine piloted by Gain.
 It was developed with sniping in mind, using a
76mm rapid-fire cannon with excellent range and
power. Its mobility allows it to fire while on the
move, quickly relocate to terrain suited for sniping,
and brace itself on both arms to serve as a fixed
gun platform.
 Its eye-catching, oversized left arm belongs to
the legendary Early Overman, Brunhilde, granting it
monstrous strength that surpasses even other
Overmen.

A silhouette machine piloted by Gain.
 It was developed with precision sniping in mind
using its 76mm rapid-fire cannon, which is
impeccable in both range and power, and it could
fire while moving using its mobility, move quickly to
terrain suited for sniping, or support its body with
both arms to serve as a fixed gun emplacement.
 Its eye-catching large left arm comes from the
legendary early Overman Brunhilde. For this reason,
it boasts monstrous strength that even surpasses
that of an Overman.
 When it was attacked by the Desert Netta, Gauli
sortied alone in it and was absorbed, resulting in
it being caught in the self-destruction and heavily
damaged. Even then, the left arm remained
unscathed.

A patchwork Overman assembled by combining
Gachiko with parts from various other Overmen.
 Its name carries on that of an Overman Gain once
used as his personal machine, and is thought to
contain the meaning of 'Emperor'.
 Its main armament is a 76mm rapid-fire cannon and
the Brunhilde left arm carried over from Gachiko.
That arm in particular has had its abilities
analyzed and properly reconnected, making the
'Gravity' Overskill usable.

A patchwork Overman built by combining Gachiko
with parts from various other Overmen.
 Its name carries on from the Overman Gain once
used as his beloved machine. It is thought to
contain the meaning 'Emperor'.
 Its main armaments are a 76mm rapid-fire cannon
and Brunhilde's left arm reused from Gachiko. In
particular, with the left arm, because its abilities
had been analyzed and properly connected, the
Overskill 'Gravity' became usable.
 In the battle against the Overdevil, it donned
Planeta's coat and worked to persuade Gainer.
However, before achieving its goal, it was pierced
by a spear of ice and fell.

The Siberian Railway Guard's mainstay Silhouette
Machine.
 Designed primarily to chase down People, it
emphasizes mobility with features such as hover
locomotion and lightweight armor.
 However, it has many operational shortcomings,
such as poor durability and the need for two
operators - one for weapons control and one for
mobility. Because of this, the Dobeck was later
developed as a successor.

An upgraded Silhouette Machine based on the
Dogozzo.
 Though its mobility falls short of the Dogozzo's,
nearly all of the earlier machine's shortcomings
have been improved, including increased armor and
firepower and a switch to single-seat operation.
 A transformation mechanism also lets it switch
between a normal 'Turtle Mode' with its upper
section closed and a firing mode with the upper
section deployed for its 200mm rocket-assisted
cannon.
 After Adette stole a large number of units from
the Siberian Railway Guard's secret base, the
Dobeck Squad that was originally meant to be
formed and deployed had its scale drastically
reduced.
 Units belonging to the Siberian Railway Guard are
painted light blue.

A Silhouette Machine upgraded from the Dogozzo.
 Procured as a fighting force by Adette, who
became the leader of a vigilante group formed by
the People of Domepolis Gangaran.
 The unit Adette pilots is a high-performance
variant with improvements such as hover boosters,
and is colored red.

 Procured as a fighting force by Adette, who

 Procured by Adette, who became the leader of a

 The performance of the units piloted by members
of Adette's squad remains unchanged from the time

An Overman of the Siberian Railway Guard.
 Its Overskill, 'Time Stop', halts the passage of
time for anything touched by the Stop Beam fired
from its hand. Yassaba wielded this Overskill with
great skill, using it to stop bullets fired at
himself, to freeze weather phenomena like storms or
avalanches on snowy mountains in order to lure
enemies in, and to release the stop effect at the
perfect moment to create an opening. Wearing a
dedicated Stop Coat allows it to fire the Stop
Beam over an even wider area.
 Attacks from the four twin-barrel launchers
mounted on both hands and the superheated
flamethrower 'Bellows' drove King Gainer into a
desperate situation.

An Overman of the Siberian Railway Guard.
 Its Overskill 'Time Stop' stops the time of
anything touched by the stop beam released from
its hands. Yassaba used this Overskill skillfully,
such as stopping bullets fired at it, halting
weather phenomena like storms or avalanches on
snowy mountains to guide enemies, and releasing the
stop at an exquisite timing to create openings. By
wearing a special stop coat, it could release the
stop beam over a wider area.
 It cornered King Gainer with attacks from four
twin launchers on both hands and the
ultra-high-heat flamethrower 'Bellows', but a single
bullet fired by Gain proved decisive, and it was
defeated. After coming into the hands of Yapan's
Ceiling, it seems to have been used as repair parts
for King Gainer.

A mass-produced Overman of Saint Reigan, and a
simplified version of the Golem. Its distinctive
flight form, sitting cross-legged, resembles a great
Buddha statue.
 Being a simplified model, its appearance seems
poorer than the Golem's, but its powerful Overskill,
'Shockwave', lets a pair of units combine to unleash
an ultra-vibration shockwave called the 'Mach Band
Shaker'.
 Since it cannot use its Overskill alone, it is clear
that this machine only shows its true worth when
operated in numbers.

An Overman used by Saint Reigan.
 It possesses the Overskill 'Hardening', which can
dramatically increase the strength of its full-body
armor.
 A pure combat type equipped with two Hand Guns
and a chakram-like Disc Harpoon. The Disc Harpoon
is a versatile weapon that can change size, extend
spikes to increase its power, and even be used as
a close-combat weapon. It can also make use of an
anti-Overman rifle.
 Wearing a Power Coat unlocks the 'Superhuman
Strength' Overskill, power strong enough to lift the
ceiling of Yapan. However, it was discovered to
hinder mobility and close-combat capability, and was
eventually cast off mid-battle.
