An Overman owned by the Siberian Railway Guard,
referred to together with Desnetta Lionnetter as a
'Psycho Overman'.
 Its Overskill, 'Mind Voice', can release a person's
surface thoughts as speech, leaving their mind's
contents laid bare to everyone around them.
Kashmar used this to instigate conflict between the
ceiling of Yapan and the People of Gangaran.
 In combat, it also demonstrated the offensive use
of reading an enemy's thoughts in advance, showing
combat ability high enough to fend off attacks
even from Gain and Gainer working together.

An Overman owned by the Siberian Railway Guard,
also called a Psycho Overman together with the
Desert Netta and Lion Netta.
 The Overskill 'Telepathy' releases a person's
surface consciousness as a voice, so one's thoughts
become openly known to those around. Kashmar used
this to incite conflict between Yapan's Ceiling and
the people of Gangaran.
 In combat, it also used the ability offensively to
read the enemy's thoughts beforehand, displaying
combat prowess that even Gain and Gainer together
could not penetrate with their attacks. However,
when Gainer focused all his nerves on exposing his
feelings for Sara, Kashmar lost concentration and
stopped the Overskill. King Gainer exploited that
opening and destroyed it.
 When Gainer used Overfreeze, Gain draped Planeta's
coat over the Emperanza, and it served the role of
conveying everyone's inner voices.

An Overman of the Siberian Railway Guard.
 Its only real weapon is an electric shock orb
fired from its whisker-like appendages, but it
possesses the Overskill 'Illusion', which conjures up
whatever false images the pilot wishes one after
another. This lets it appear to split into multiple
copies of itself, or project phantom images to
confuse the enemy.

An Overman used by the Siberian Railway Guard.
Its main weapon is only an electric shock ball fired
from its beard-like parts, but it possesses the
Overskill 'Phantom', which creates one illusion after
another as desired by the pilot. With this, it could
appear to divide itself, or project phantoms to
confuse enemies. Kejinan used this not only to put
on a comedy typical of him, but also to corner
King Gainer at one point. However, because the
illusions were annihilated at a speed faster than
they could be created, the main body was exposed
and destroyed.

An Overman with the Overskill 'Theft', capable of
stealing any matter, regardless of size, across
space.
 Its original owner was Duke Pirwitz, lord of
Polichev, but Asuham made blackmail-like demands to
seize it in what amounted to theft - a fitting
origin, given the machine's own ability.
 In battle it stole a Rivet Gun from the Panther,
and even stole bullets and the artificial muscle
from King Gainer's shoulder.

An Overman possessing the Overskill 'Theft', which
could steal any substance, regardless of size,
across space. Its original owner was Duke Pilwitz,
the lord of Policev, but Asuham took it over in a
near-theft manner with extortionate demands, and
it can be said that its origin was fitting for such
an ability. In battle, it stole a rivet gun from
Panther, and even stole bullets and the artificial
muscles of the shoulders from King Gainer, but it
could not steal Anna's heart and tears. Then
Asuham, who was too fixated on Gain, was left
open, and the unit was defeated by King Gainer.

An Overman given by Overdevil to Sara after she
was Overfrozen by Gainer.
 Having gained the Overskill 'Theft', which can
steal any matter across space, Sara attempted to
steal the very lives of the people of the ceiling
of Yapan.

An Overman given by the Overdevil to Sara, who
had been Overfrozen. Sara, gaining the Overskill
'Theft', which could steal any substance across
space, attempted to steal the lives of the people
of Yapan's Ceiling. However, she was stopped by
Adette's Dobeck, had the pouch that was the
source of her Overskill destroyed, and was shot
down.

An Early Overman of the Siberian Railway Guard.
 It possesses the Overskill 'Change', which lets it
curl into a sphere, transform parts of its body
into a sword or shield, increase its own volume,
and even fire off that increased volume as
projectiles - a truly anything-goes versatility.
 Combined with the astonishing ability of its pilot,
Cynthia, it demonstrated performance powerful
enough to single-handedly wipe out Saint Reigan's
Asuham Boone special forces unit.

An Early Overman of the Siberian Railway Guard.
It possessed the Overskill 'Change', and could
become spherical, change parts of its body into
swords or shields, and also increase its volume or
fire the increased volume outward as projectiles,
showing off a transformative versatility that
allowed almost anything. Thanks to the
extraordinary ability of its pilot, Cynthia, it
demonstrated enough performance to annihilate the
Asuham Boone special forces unit of St. Reigan with
a single unit. After Cynthia withdrew with wounds
to her heart, Asuham piloted it, and a second unit
that Kizz had hidden also appeared.

A mass-produced Overman based on the Dominator.
 Though simplified, it retains transformation
capability and can also use the Overskill 'Shock'.
 It was deployed to the Kizz Munt royal guard.

A mass-production type Overman based on the
Dominator. Although simplified, it retains
transformation capabilities and can also use the
Overskill 'Electric Shock'. Deployed to the Kizz
Munt guard corps, it fought against the Overdevil
and King Gainer, but almost all units were shot
down.

A mysterious being said to have been sealed away
by the first Miia.
 It possesses a will of its own, and holds the
hidden ability to open the ice gate known as the
'Icing Gate'.
 Its body had been broken apart into separate
pieces, but Kizz, upon learning of its existence,
secretly gathered them within the Agato Crystal.
 Its Overskill, 'Overfreeze', is a terrifying ability
that halts not only the movement of matter, but
also growth, evolution, portions of emotion such as
conscience, and even black holes - stopping
anything, tangible or intangible, without exception.

Overdevil is a mysterious being said to have been
sealed by the first Meeya. It possesses its own
will and holds the ability to open the ice gate
known as the 'Icing Gate.' Though its body parts
had been scattered, they were secretly gathered
and stored inside a crystal of Agato by Kizz, who
had learned of its existence. Its Overskill,
'Overfreeze,' is a terrifying ability that halts not
only the movement of matter but also growth,
evolution, conscience, and other emotions, and even
a black hole - stopping anything, tangible or
intangible, without exception. With this power, it
manipulated the hearts of Cynthia and Gainer, using
them as pawns, and brought the world to the brink
of freezing. However, its body was pierced by the
Over Heat of King Gainer, piloted by Gainer after
he broke free from its control, and it fell to the
earth as rain.

The form Gainer took after being Overfrozen,
growing to giant size and becoming an Overman.
 What Gainer wears is the Overcoat of the Overman
Black Mail, a machine that never appeared in the
game, materialized by Overdevil.

The form Gainer took after being Overfrozen,
growing to giant size and becoming an Overman.
 What Gainer wears is the Overcoat of the Overman
Black Mail, a machine that never appeared in the
game, materialized by Overdevil.

A black Megadeus piloted by Roger Smith.
 When Roger shouts, "Big O, Showtime" into the
wristwatch on his left arm, it rises from
underground to stand against the enemy at his
side.
 When Roger boards it, the words "CAST IN THE
NAME OF GOD, YE NOT GUILTY" are displayed on the
front monitor.
 It is normally housed beneath Roger's mansion. But
once Roger issues the call, it races through
disused underground transit lines aboard its
dedicated transporter, the 'Prairie Dog', and is
carried to its destination.
 It conceals built-in weapons such as the eye beam
'Arc Line' and the 'Cannon Party' and 'Missile
Party' fired from its chest and abdomen, but its
ultimate finishing move is the one-hit-kill strike
'Sudden Impact', delivered by driving its arm's
Strike Pile into the target.
 From time to time, Big O has taken independent
action as though possessed of its own will. When,
where, and by whom Big O was built - not even
Roger, its own pilot, knows the answer.

Big O is a black Megadeus piloted by Roger Smith.
It appears from underground when Roger shouts 'Big
O, Showtime' into the wristwatch on his left arm,
and stands against enemies alongside him. When
Roger is aboard, the front monitor displays the
spell 'CAST IN THE NAME OF GOD, YE NOT GUILTY.'
Normally, it is housed beneath Roger's mansion. But
once summoned by Roger, it races through disused
underground transit systems via the dedicated
transporter 'Prairie Dog' to its destination. It is
armed with internal weapons such as the eye-beam
'Arc Line' and the chest and abdomen-launched
'Cannon Party' and 'Missile Party,' but its greatest
finishing move is 'Sudden Impact,' a one-hit killing
blow that drives the arm's strike pile into the foe.
The three units Big O, Big Duo, and Big Fau are
beings called 'The Big'; by appearance, Big O is
called the Black Big, Big Duo the Red Big, and Big
Fau the White Big. In the final phase of the battle
with Big Fau, Dorothy, who functioned as Big O's
interface, caused each part to deploy and fired a
high-output beam from the chest, activating the
ultimate move 'Big O Final Stage.' At times, Big O
acted on its own as if it possessed a will. When,
where, and who manufactured Big O - even Roger,
its pilot, did not know.

A bandage-wrapped Megadeus that appeared at the
ruins of John F. Kennedy International Airport.
 It controls the bandages covering its body and
fires a beam from its eyes.
 It bound Big O with its bandages, but was
engulfed in flame after taking a direct hit from a
missile fired by Big O.

Mummy is a bandaged Megadeus that appeared at
the site of the former John F. Kennedy
International Airport. It manipulates the bandages
covering its whole body and fires beams from its
eyes. It bound Big O with its bandages, but was
hit directly by missiles fired by Big O and engulfed
in flames. From beneath that blaze, the Red Big -
that is, Big Duo - emerged.

A flying red Megadeus discovered by Schwarzwald.
 If Big O is the Big of the land, then Big Duo
could be called the Big of the sky.
 It deploys main wings from both arms, transforms
its four fingers into propellers, and flies using the
afterburners of its powerful engines.
 Its armament includes the eye beam Arc Line,
Gatling missiles fired from its chest, and megaton
missiles stored in both lower legs. It can also spin
its four fingers to grind down an opponent.

Big Duo is a flying red Megadeus discovered by
Schwarzwald. If Big O is the Big of the land, Big
Duo possesses performance that could be called the
Big of the sky. It deploys main wings from both
arms, transforms its four fingers into propellers,
and flies using the afterburner of its powerful
engines. Its armaments include the eye-beam Arc
Line, gatling missiles fired from the chest, and
megaton missiles stored in both lower legs. It can
also rotate its four fingers to grind away the
enemy. When it confronted Big O at the Central
Dome, it tormented Big O with bombing from the
air. However, Roger's quick thinking turned the
tables, and it was destroyed. Afterwards, it
reacted to Dorothy's presence, advancing on its
own without a pilot as if pursuing her, and
eventually came to a halt.

The heavily damaged Big Duo, reinforced and
remodeled by Paradigm Corporation's science division.
 It retains flight capability as before its
remodeling, and now wears a face guard while
flying.
 Beyond its more menacing design, several changes
to its performance can be seen, such as the
hollowing out of its Gatling missile ports. As new
weaponry, its fingers can now transform into knife
edges, and its left eye has been equipped with the
Artemis Arcline.
 Its cockpit employs the same
interface-substitution technology Beck once used,
linking Alan into the machine through countless
cables and connectors.

Big Duo Inferno is a heavily modified version of
the destroyed Big Duo, rebuilt and enhanced by the
science division of Paradigm Corporation. It can fly
as before the modification, and now wears a face
guard during flight. Not only was its design made
more menacing, but several performance changes
were made, such as hollowed-out gatling missile
launch ports. As new weapons, its fingers can
transform into knife edges, and the left eye is
equipped with an Artemis Arcline. The cockpit uses
the interface substitution technology that Beck
employed, integrating Alan through countless cables
and connectors. As if responding to the will of
Schwarzwald, who had already lost his body, it
began acting on its own without accepting Alan as
its pilot, absorbed Alan, and vanished into the sky.

The white Big, piloted by Alex.
 Discovered in a foreign land with its body
scattered in pieces, Alex requested that the Union
recover it. Its parts were loaded into three
separate Megadeuses, which carried them to
Paradigm City.
 It was assembled at Paradigm Corporation's
underground factory using every technique the
science division could bring to bear, but because
its core memory was missing, it ran amok on its
first outing and fell into malfunction.
 Its weapons include tentacle-like beam cannons
extending from its back, cannon guns that extend
from its shoulders, and the Corkscrew Punch, which
attacks by spinning the rotors on its arms. By
using those rotors as screws, it can also move
freely underwater.

A white Big Fau piloted by Alex. It was discovered
in pieces in a foreign land, so Alex asked the
Union to recover it. The parts were loaded onto
three Megadeuses and transported to Paradigm City.
 It was assembled at the Paradigm Corporation's
underground factory using the best technology the
science division had, but because its core memory
was missing, it ran out of control and
malfunctioned during its first battle. However,
after the memory circuit extracted from Dorothy
was installed to serve as the core memory, Alex
was able to handle Big Fau completely.
 Its weapons include a tentacle-like beam cannon
extending from its back, cannons that emerge from
its shoulders, and a corkscrew punch that attacks
by spinning the rotors on its arms. By using the
rotors as screws, it can move freely through the
sea.
 For a time it overwhelmed Big O, but it lost half
its body to the 'Big O Final Stage' and was then
destroyed by the suddenly appearing Big Venus.

A Megadeus used by T-Bone and Dove to break
Beck out of prison, also known as 'Super Beck'.
 It was built using Heavy Metal unit parts stolen
from the Wise Company.
 Its weapons include missiles stored in both sides
of its chest and a beam fired from its fingertips.
The beam has enough power to cut through the
chain of the Moby Dick anchor, but when it struck
Big O's head crystal, it was deflected.
 It is notable for its fast retreat speed and the
ability to rotate its upper body 180 degrees, a
feature it used to catch Big O off guard on one
occasion.

A Megadeus used by T-Bone and Dove to break
Beck out of prison, also known as 'Super Beck'.
 It was built using Heavy Metal unit parts stolen
from the Wise Company.
 Its weapons include missiles stored in both sides
of its chest and a beam fired from its fingertips.
The beam has enough power to cut through the
chain of the Moby Dick anchor, but when it struck
Big O's head crystal, it was deflected.
 It is notable for its fast retreat speed and the
ability to rotate its upper body 180 degrees, a
feature it used to catch Big O off guard on one
occasion.

A three-unit combining Heavy Metal unit deployed
by Beck, which combines with the shout, "Final
Together!" Beck's sports car, the 'Beck Mobile',
forms the head; Dove's construction vehicle forms
the chest and arms; and T-Bone's trailer forms
the lower body. Beck handled the design, while
Yoshifura Yakamoto Industries handled
manufacturing.
 Its weapon is a crescent-moon-shaped sword
formed by combining the blade-like parts on both
shoulders, engraved at its center with the single
character for 'Slash'. It struck a dedicated
finishing pose complete with its own theme music in
front of Big O, but was riddled with holes by the
merciless O Thunder attack and defeated without
much of a real fight.

A three-unit combining Heavy Metal unit deployed
by Beck, which combines with the shout, "Final
Together!" Beck's sports car, the 'Beck Mobile',
forms the head; Dove's construction vehicle forms
the chest and arms; and T-Bone's trailer forms
the lower body. Beck handled the design, while
Yoshifura Yakamoto Industries handled
manufacturing.
 Its weapon is a crescent-moon-shaped sword
formed by combining the blade-like parts on both
shoulders, engraved at its center with the single
character for 'Slash'. It struck a dedicated
finishing pose complete with its own theme music in
front of Big O, but was riddled with holes by the
merciless O Thunder attack and defeated without
much of a real fight.

The prototype form of a Megadeus, buried deep
within Paradigm City's underground passages in the
ruins of a pavilion-like shrine. It was discovered
by Schwarzwald, who had descended underground in
search of the truth.
 It awakened in response to Dorothy's sudden
appearance before it, and began operating in
pursuit of her memory.
 It toyed with Big O using agile movements and
electric shocks fired from its head, but in the end
was destroyed by a direct hit from Big O's Missile
Party.

The prototype form of a Megadeus, buried deep
within Paradigm City's underground passages in the
ruins of a pavilion-like shrine. It was discovered
by Schwarzwald, who had descended underground in
search of the truth.
 It awakened in response to Dorothy's sudden
appearance before it, and began operating in
pursuit of her memory.
 It toyed with Big O using agile movements and
electric shocks fired from its head, but in the end
was destroyed by a direct hit from Big O's Missile
Party.

A form created by combining six parts taken from
three foreign Megadeuses that had been destroyed
by Big O.
 The Union revived it as a warning directed at
Alex.
 After one-sidedly attacking the disabled Big O, it
attempted to bring down Paradigm Corporation's
headquarters, but was destroyed by Big Fau, piloted
by Alex.

A form created by combining six parts taken from
three foreign Megadeuses that had been destroyed
by Big O.
 The Union revived it as a warning directed at
Alex.
 After one-sidedly attacking the disabled Big O, it
attempted to bring down Paradigm Corporation's
headquarters, but was destroyed by Big Fau, piloted
by Alex.

A robot built by Sandman for use against the
Zeravire.
 With Gran Kaiser as its core, four Gran Diva
units unite with it to form God Gravion.
 It is equipped with the Ergo Form system, which
circulates gravitons to form a graviton field around
itself, multiplying the power of its weapons many
times over. While Ergo Form is active, tremendous
strain is placed on both weapons and pilot, making
extended use impossible.
 However, since Gran Kaiser itself bears no
graviton burden, it has no GravCrit either.

A robot built by Sandman for use against the
Zeravire. By uniting the Gran Kaiser as the core
with the four Grandivas, God Gravion is completed.
 It is equipped with an Ergo Form system that
forms a graviton field around itself through
graviton circulation, multiplying the power of its
weapons severalfold. While Ergo Form is active, the
weapons and pilot are placed under enormous strain,
making prolonged use impossible. When Eiji, burning
with rivalry against Tokai, boarded it without
permission, he was severely injured by the Ergo
Form's backlash. This shows both its power and its
danger.
 However, since the Gran Kaiser itself is not
burdened by gravitons, it has no graviton critical
limit.

A super robot developed by Sandman for use
against the Zeravire.
 It is completed when four Gran Diva units unite
with the core Gran Kaiser: G-Attacker as the
right leg, G-Striker as the left leg, G-Driller for
both arms, and G-Shadow for the chest and head.
 Through the effect of the Ergo Form system, it
can resonate the pilot's G-Factor with the
gravitons to multiply the power of its weapons
many times over. However, the unite state has a
time limit called GravCrit; exceeding it would
destroy each Gran Diva, so the union is forcibly
released just before critical, a built-in weakness.
 For attacks, it draws on the various weapons built
into each Gran Diva: the highly homing 'Graviton
Missile' from G-Attacker, the laser-like whip
'Graviton Viper' from G-Striker, the 'Graviton
Tornado Punch', launched by spinning G-Driller, the
'Gravity Crescent', thrown from G-Shadow's wings,
and the 'Graviton Arc', which releases graviton
energy from the chest, among others.

A super robot developed by Sandman for use
against the Zeravire.
 It is completed by the four Grandivas - the G
Attacker as the right leg, G Striker as the left
leg, G Driller as both arms, and G Shadow as the
chest and head - uniting with the core Gran
Kaiser.
 Through the Ergo Form system, the pilot's G
Factor is made to resonate with gravitons,
multiplying weapon power severalfold. However, the
union has a time limit called the graviton critical
point. If this is exceeded, the Grandivas will be
destroyed, so the union is forcibly cancelled just
before reaching criticality - a weakness.
 For attacks, it uses various weapons built into
each Grandiva. From the G Attacker comes the
highly homing 'Graviton Missile', from the G Striker
the laser whip 'Graviton Viper', the 'Graviton
Tornado Punch' which spins and fires the G Driller,
the 'Gravity Crescent' which throws the G Shadow's
wings, and the 'Graviton Arc' which releases
graviton energy from the chest.
 The 'Choujuuken' (Super Heavy Sword) brought
by Sandman in episode 13 is the strongest sword,
capable of cutting its target along with the space
around it. Besides slashing, it can also be used to
seal the enemy's movements with an Ergo Storm
before cutting. However, it is originally a weapon
for Sol Gravion.

A super robot developed by Sandman in preparation
for the coming showdown with his adoptive brother,
Hugue.
 It is completed when four Sol Gran Diva units
unite with the core Gran Kaiser: Geo Caliber as
the right leg, Geo Stinger as the left leg, Geo
Javelin for both arms, and Geo Mirage for the
chest and head.
 The Ergo Form system amplifies the pilot's
willpower, allowing it to unleash gravitons in an
explosive release. In theory, it holds power enough
not merely to destroy a planet, but even to create
one. Because piloting it demands commensurate skill
from its Gran Knights, Sandman kept it hidden at a
lunar base until they had grown into warriors
worthy of that power.
 Its main weapons include the 'Sol Graviton Cannon'
mounted on both shoulders, the 'Sol Graviton Arc'
fired from the chest, the 'Sol Graviton Nova', which
concentrates the two, and the 'Sol Graviton
Bringer', a charging attack made by spinning the
drill on its left arm. The 'Choujuuken' that God
Gravion wielded is, in fact, originally a weapon of
Sol Gravion.

A super robot developed by Sandman in preparation
for the coming final battle against his
brother-in-law Hyugi.
 It is completed by the four Sol Grandivas - the
Geo Caliver as the right leg, Geo Stinger as the
left leg, Geo Javelin as both arms, and Geo Mirage
as the chest and head - uniting with the core
Gran Kaiser.
 Through the Ergo Form system, it amplifies the
pilot's mental energy and explosively releases heavy
gravitons. In theory, it possesses the power to not
only destroy a star but even create one.
Consequently, the Grand Knights who pilot it must
be of commensurate ability, so Sandman kept it
hidden at a lunar base until they grew into
warriors worthy of that power.
 Its main weapons include the 'Sol Graviton Cannon'
on both shoulders, the 'Sol Graviton Arc' fired
from the chest, the 'Sol Graviton Nova' which
concentrates those two, and the 'Sol Graviton
Bringer' which charges with the left arm drill
spinning. The 'Choujuuken' used by God Gravion is
also originally a Sol Gravion weapon.
 By performing the most sinister union with God
Sigma Gravion, it can become the strongest final
form, 'Ultimate Gravion'.

A super robot completed when Gran Divas unite
with the star-creation unit Gran Sigma, a machine
capable of creating even stars, developed by a
young Sandman to save his homeland of Rambius.
Unlike God Gravion's blue, its color scheme is black,
matching Gran Sigma.
 Despite uniting with Gran Divas running on the
Phantom System, it displayed performance on par
with God Gravion. This is an achievement made
possible only by Gran Sigma's own unfathomable
capabilities, and above all, by Sandman's own
strength and skill.
 Its main weapon is the 'Graviton Lancer', formed
by joining swords drawn from its waist into one.
Sandman used it to effortlessly cut down a
Zeravire that stood in his path with the 'Sigma
Slash', a strike whose blade traces the shape of a
sigma.

A super robot completed by the Grandivas uniting
with the Souseiki Gran Sigma, a machine capable
even of creating stars, which the young Sandman
developed to save his homeland of Lambias. Its
color scheme is black to match Gran Sigma, unlike
God Gravion's blue.
 Despite uniting with Grandivas that operate on
the Phantom System, it displayed performance
rivaling God Gravion. This feat was only possible
through the immeasurable performance hidden within
Gran Sigma and, above all, Sandman's own power and
skill.
 Its main weapon is the 'Graviton Lancer', formed
by combining swords drawn from the waist. With it,
Sandman used the 'Sigma Slash', whose blade's
trajectory traces a sigma, to easily dispatch the
Zeravire that stood in his way.
 In the final battle against the Zeravire homeworld
Goma, it performed the most sinister union with Sol
Gravion to become 'Ultimate Gravion', stunning
viewers.

The mainstay weapon of the Earth Federation
Authority (EFA), a machine that could be called
a mass-produced Gravion. Five units were built, all
assigned to the Gran Trooper Squad. The squad
leader Faye's unit is marked with red coloring in
several places.
 In addition to a highly combat-capable humanoid
form, it can also transform into a highly mobile
fighter-jet form.
 Each Gran Trooper carries different armament;
Faye's unit has two: the 'Gravity Lang', formed
by combining and throwing the parts on both
shoulders, and the 'Gravity Arrow', which fires
countless beam rounds. By drawing energy from
every Gran Trooper unit, it can also use the
'Lightning Detonator', a weapon with 1.5 times the
destructive power of the Graviton Arc.

The Gran Trooper is the main battle machine of
the Earth Federation Administration (EFA), and
can be called a mass-production version of Gravion.
It was developed based on Gravion data sent by
Mizuki. Five units were manufactured, and all were
assigned to the Gran Trooper squad. The unit
piloted by the squad leader, Faye, has red coloring
applied in various places.
 In addition to a humanoid form with high combat
capability, it can also transform into a fighter
form with high mobility.
 Each Gran Trooper is equipped with different
armaments; Faye's unit has two: the 'Gravity
Lang', which combines and throws the shoulder
parts, and the 'Gravity Arrow', which fires
numerous beam shots. Furthermore, by receiving
energy supply from each Gran Trooper, it can use
the 'Lightning Detonator', which has 1.5 times the
destructive power of the Graviton Arc.

The smallest class of Zeravire, the Soldier
Zeravire, roughly 5 to 10 meters in overall length.
 Zeravire are classified by size into
'Soldier-class', 'Warrior-class', and
'Destroyer-class'. The Soldier-class serves roles
such as escorting and scouting for the
Warrior-class and Destroyer-class.

The smallest class of Zeravire, the Soldier
Zeravire, roughly 5 to 10 meters in overall length.
 Zeravire are classified by size into
'Soldier-class', 'Warrior-class', and
'Destroyer-class'. The Soldier-class serves roles
such as escorting and scouting for the
Warrior-class and Destroyer-class.

The Zeravire that first invaded Earth, appearing
in Episode 1, 'The Castle Where the Giant God
Dwells'. Its official name is 'Sword God of Purging,
Dicreel'.
 It was once damaged by an attack from God
Gravion, but healed itself and returned, having
evolved.

The Zeravire that first invaded Earth, appearing
in Episode 1, 'The Castle Where the Giant God
Dwells'. Its official name is 'Sword God of Purging,
Dicreel'.
 It was once damaged by an attack from God
Gravion, but healed itself and returned, having
evolved.

A Zeravire appearing in Episode 6, 'Touga's Day
Off'. Its official name is 'Perceiving God of the
Demon Eye, Juettal'.
 It was created to investigate God Gravion's
capabilities, and its combat ability is lower than
that of other Zeravire.

A Zeravire that appeared in episode 6, 'Touga's
Day Off'. Its official name is 'Demon Eye Shikigami
Juettal'.
 It was created to investigate the performance of
God Gravion, and its combat capability is lower
than other Zeravires. Therefore, it was scattered
by Touga and Eiji, who were roused to protect
their friends.

A Zeravire built specifically to counter God
Gravion, appearing in Episode 13, 'Silver Fang'. Its
official name is 'War God of the Duel, Hudwell'.
 It has resistance to every weapon it has
previously encountered, and gave God Gravion a hard
fight.

A Zeravire that appeared in episode 13, 'Silver
Fang', created for fighting God Gravion. Its official
name is 'Duel War God Hudwell'.
 It had resistance to all weapons previously used,
and drove God Gravion into a corner. However, it
was destroyed by a single strike from the
Choujuuken, which united the hearts of the Gran
Knights.

A Zeravire appearing in Episode 3, 'Heated Battle!
The Gurabi Hot Spring!!'. Its official name is
'Dragon God of the Flame Prison, Magguard'.
 It lurked within a magma layer and stirred
volcanic activity into greater activity.

A Zeravire that appeared in episode 3, 'Fierce
Battle! Gurabi Hot Springs!!'. Its official name is
'Flame Prison Dragon God Magguard'.
 It hid within the magma layer and activated
volcanic activity, but was defeated by God Gravion,
spurred on by the passionate cheering of the
maids.

A Zeravire appearing in Episode 7, 'The Shattered
Goddess'. Its official name is 'Servant God of the
Broken Vow, Zalogros'.
 It exploited a brief opening during the unite
sequence to seize Gran Kaiser, then cornered Touga
with a psychic attack and heavily damaged
G-Driller.

A Zeravire that appeared in episode 7, 'The
Shattered Goddess'. Its official name is 'Broken
Precept Slave God Zalogros'.
 It exploited a slight opening during Unite,
capturing Gran Kaiser. Afterwards, it cornered
Touga with a mental attack, but due to Eina's
suicide attack, it lost Gran Kaiser, though it
heavily damaged the G Driller. Subsequently, it was
destroyed by Gran Troopers that appeared suddenly.

The strongest Zeravire, first appearing in Episode
11, 'The Star-Making Machine.' It conceals within
itself the energy of the long-vanished planets
Ranbias and Serias. Its formal name is 'Karmic
Demon God Zeravion.'
 It possesses what seems to be limitless
self-regenerative power, and drove even Sol Gravion
to the brink of defeat.

The mightiest Zeravire to appear from episode 11
'Souseiki', holding within it the energy of the
long-extinct planets Lambias and Celia. Its official
name is 'Gyomashin Zeravion'. It possessed what
seemed to be infinite self-regeneration ability, and
even drove Sol Gravion into a corner. However, its
programming that prevented it from attacking Leele
was exploited in reverse, and the opening created
when it halted was seized upon to destroy it with
the Choujuuken.

The planet that served as the Zeravire's home
base, introduced in Episode 12, 'Anthem of Souls.'
When Hyugi and Zeravion fell in battle, the planet
itself transformed into a Zeravire and fell into a
rampaging state.

A planet that appeared in episode 12 'Anthem of
Souls', serving as the home base of the Zeravire.
With Hyugi and Zeravion defeated, it transformed
itself into a Zeravire and ran wild. It was
completely destroyed by the Choujuu Enouzan of
Ultimate Gravion.

Twelve thousand years ago, Apollonius created it
as a mechanical angel to fight the Shadow Angels.
It is sometimes called the Mythical-type Aquarion.
 By combining three Vector Machines, it can
transform into three different forms. The order of
combination greatly changes the resulting form's
abilities. This form is completed when Vector Sol
forms the upper body, Vector Mars the lower body,
and Vector Luna the back unit - it is Aquarion's
strongest form.
 It is characterized by a red-based color scheme
and a head modeled after the sun, with power
stones on both shoulders and shins that amplify
bio-energy and higher-dimensional quantum force.
 While it boasts armor resistant to physical
attacks and tremendous output, it also demands
immense Element ability from its pilot, making it a
form used almost exclusively by Apollo. Deploying
the Solar Wings on its back allows it to unleash
even greater power.
 Its main armament is its fist itself, and its
destructive power is strong enough to crush a
Cherubim Soldier in a single blow without even using
a named technique. Most of its finishing moves are
also fist-based, such as the life-risking punch
that reaches the moon, 'Infinite Punch,' and 'United
Light and Shadow Fist,' unleashed in perfect unison
by Apollo and Silvia after they finally recognized
their true feelings for one another.
 Note that when Lena serves as the main pilot, it
instead takes on the silver-gleaming form 'Silver
Aquarion.'

A mechanized angel built by Apollonius 12,000
years ago for use against the Shadow Angels. It is
sometimes called the Mythological-Type Aquarion. By
combining three Vector Machines, it can transform
into three different forms; the order of assembly
greatly changes the resulting form and abilities.
This is Aquarion's strongest form, completed with
Vector Sol forming the upper body, Vector Mars the
lower body, and Vector Luna the back. It is
characterized by its red-based coloration and
sun-motif head, with power stones on both
shoulders and both shins that amplify bio-energy
and higher-dimensional quantum power. While its
armor resists physical attacks and it possesses
enormous output, it also demands powerful Element
abilities from its pilots, making it almost
exclusively Apollo's form. Deploying the solar wings
on its back allows it to bring out even greater
power. Its main armament is its 'fists' themselves,
whose destructive force is so strong that even
without using a special technique it can shatter a
Cherudim Soldier in one blow. Its special moves are
mostly fist-based as well, including the 'Mugen
Punch', a desperate punch that reaches the moon,
and the 'Kouei Gou Ikkken', delivered in unison by
Apollo and Silvia after they realized their true
feelings for each other. Incidentally, when Reena is
the main pilot, it takes on a silvery gleam and
becomes 'Silver Aquarion'. Initially, Apollo, who held
the past life of Apollonius, was believed to be the
'Solar Wing' who would be the savior. But Toma,
alias Toma, revealed that the true 'Solar Wing' was
in fact the Aquarion that Apollonius had built with
his own wings.

Twelve thousand years ago, Apollonius created it
as a mechanical angel to fight the Shadow Angels.
It is sometimes called the Mythical-type Aquarion.
 By combining three Vector Machines, it can
transform into three different forms. The order of
combination greatly changes the resulting form's
abilities. This form is completed when Vector Mars
forms the upper body, Vector Luna the lower body,
and Vector Sol the back unit - a form excelling in
mobility.
 It is characterized by a blue-based color scheme
and a head modeled after a star, with the longest
legs of the three forms.
 In terms of performance, it boasts the greatest
mobility of the three forms, with speed exceeding
the sound barrier and impressive jumping power, and
it resists energy attacks. Since it demands
excellent athletic ability from its pilot, Sirius or
Pierre most often serve as its head.
 Its main armament, the StarSwd, becomes a
formidable weapon even wielded alone by Sirius, who
possesses superb swordsmanship. Depending on the
situation, variations exist as well, such as
dual-wielding or the 'Fire Saber,' which combines it
with Pierre's power over flame. Many of its
finishing moves also make use of the StarSwd,
including 'Jealousy Sword,' in which Sirius turned
his jealousy of Apollo into a whirlwind, and 'True
Self-Discovery Sword,' unleashed in his quest for
his true self.

Twelve thousand years ago, Apollonius created it
as a mechanical angel to fight the Shadow Angels.
It is sometimes called the Mythical-type Aquarion.
 By combining three Vector Machines, it can
transform into three different forms. The order of
combination greatly changes the resulting form's
abilities. This form is completed when Vector Mars
forms the upper body, Vector Luna the lower body,
and Vector Sol the back unit - a form excelling in
mobility.
 It is characterized by a blue-based color scheme
and a head modeled after a star, with the longest
legs of the three forms.
 In terms of performance, it boasts the greatest
mobility of the three forms, with speed exceeding
the sound barrier and impressive jumping power, and
it resists energy attacks. Since it demands
excellent athletic ability from its pilot, Sirius or
Pierre most often serve as its head.
 Its main armament, the StarSwd, becomes a
formidable weapon even wielded alone by Sirius, who
possesses superb swordsmanship. Depending on the
situation, variations exist as well, such as
dual-wielding or the 'Fire Saber,' which combines it
with Pierre's power over flame. Many of its
finishing moves also make use of the StarSwd,
including 'Jealousy Sword,' in which Sirius turned
his jealousy of Apollo into a whirlwind, and 'True
Self-Discovery Sword,' unleashed in his quest for
his true self.

Twelve thousand years ago, Apollonius created it
as a mechanical angel to fight the Shadow Angels.
It is sometimes called the Mythical-type Aquarion.
 By combining three Vector Machines, it can
transform into three different forms. The order of
combination greatly changes the resulting form's
abilities. This form is completed when Vector Luna
forms the upper body, Vector Sol the lower body,
and Vector Mars the back unit - a form that
excels at long-range combat and armed
reconnaissance.
 It is characterized by a green-based color scheme
and a head modeled after the moon, and is the only
one of the three forms with its cockpit located in
the head.
 In terms of performance, while it has the weakest
physical output of the three forms, it boasts
strong resistance to mental attacks. It also has
excellent empathic sensitivity, so it is mainly
piloted by female Elements such as Reika or Silvia.
 Its armament includes weapons suited for ranged
combat, such as the 'Lunatic Archery,' which fires
arrows from a giant bow nearly as tall as the unit
itself, and the 'Light Wave Shuriken,' which throws
glowing ring-shaped shuriken. Its finishing moves
are mostly unleashed from the Lunatic Archery,
such as the 'Moonsault Attack,' which Silvia fired
to bridge dream and reality, and the 'Ravenous
Burst Arrow,' said to be usable only by one
consumed by hunger. Beyond that, it can also use
martial-arts-based techniques, such as the 'Shoryu
Tenrai' performed by Reika.

A new-model Aquarion jointly developed by the New
United Nations Forces and DEAVA, using Futaba, a
wing of paired Shadow Angel wings. Known as the
Assault-type Aquarion, a considerable number have
been produced in series. Because it is piloted by
an Element who has likewise had these wings
transplanted, a single pilot can control all of its
functions (the other two units, in contrast, are
equipped with control units that use ordinary Fallen
Angel Wings).
 It reaches completion when Vector Alpha serves as
its head, forming this combined state. It carries
the massive Impact Cannon that stood out even in

left arm, when in use it loads a Fallen Angel Wing

 When Glen, who had fallen into a coma, had a

this unit.
 Additionally, as a form not found in the original,
the Assault-type Aquarion can also transform into
'Assault Walker Mode,' which enables high-speed
ground movement and retains flight capability, or
'Armageddon Mode,' a multi-legged gun-platform
form.

The world's oldest LFO, developed by the
Federation from an Archetype (a humanoid relic
that serves as the base unit for LFOs) that it
excavated. Because it forms the foundation for
every LFO that followed, it is called 'Nirvash type
ZERO.' LFO stands for 'Light Finding Operation,'
referring to rechargeable humanoid mobile machines.
 It has various features found in no other unit,
such as its left-right two-seat cockpit and its
ability to move without a Compac Drive installed. It
also appears to choose its own pilot and can act
autonomously at times, so piloting it well depends
less on operating skill than on achieving mutual
understanding with the machine.
 By setting the Amita Drive into the Compac Drive,
it links with the Satori Program, triggering the
'Seven Swell Phenomenon,' which causes an abnormal
outbreak of Trapar before making it vanish
completely.

The form into which Nirvash evolved of its own
will, in step with the changes in Eureka and
Renton. Its formal designation should be 'Nirvash
type ZERO spec2' (Spec 2), but Eureka and the
others continue to simply call it "Nirvash."
 Because the very shape of the Archetype serving
as its base had changed, it was almost entirely
rebuilt from scratch at the Tresor Institute. Its
greatest feature is that, in addition to its
previous humanoid mode and Vehicle mode, it can
now transform into a high-speed Flight mode. With
this renewal, Renton became the main rider, while
Eureka took on the sub role and piloting duties for
the high-speed Flight mode.
 The area around the cockpit also changed, bringing
the two pilots closer together, and space was even
prepared in the rear for the children to ride. It
looks just like a family car.
 As with the type ZERO, its lift board was made
by Thurston Garage, crafted by Axel's own hand.

 With power that transcends the very concept of

An LFO that mainly serves on the front line for
Gekkostate. Its formal name is 'Terminus type
R606.'
 The second unit officially adopted in the Terminus
line. It achieved improved mobility and extended
operating time by sacrificing the airframe strength
meant to support its various mounts and equipment,
resulting in a lighter overall build.
 As its fighter-plane-like shape suggests, its
cockpit is a two-seat, front-and-back
configuration. In combat, the most common
arrangement was Matthieu riding up front as rider,
with Stoner in back taking photographs. In everyday
use, it is also commonly used for shopping and
hauling supplies.

 Hilda mainly rides it, supporting and being

The most advanced LFO in Gekkostate's possession.
Its formal name is 'Terminus type R909.'
 It was originally officially adopted by the
Federation's special mobile unit. It achieved
outstanding mobility through weight reduction
surpassing even the R606, along with long operating
time and high firepower through power-saving
improvements that fixed the R808's weakness. By
removing its limiter, it can even make use of the
'Compac Feedback System,' giving it the highest
performance in the series.
 However, it became correspondingly harder to
handle, and its production cost rose as well.
Combined with the fact that no further improvement
in performance could be expected, it became the
machine that put an end to the Terminus line. Since
no one in Gekkostate besides Holland can pilot it,
it has effectively become his personal machine.

The most advanced LFO owned by Gekkostate. Its

 Originally, this unit was adopted for regular use

long operating time and high firepower through
improved power saving that corrects the R808's

Feedback System' can also be used, making it the

 However, on the other hand, handling became
considerably more difficult, and production costs
also rose. Additionally, for the reason that no
further improvement in unit performance could be
hoped for, it became the unit that brought the
Terminus series to an end. Since no one in
Gekkostate other than Holland can master it, it has
effectively become his personal machine.
 During the second encounter with Anemone, he
fought the End alone, but was grabbed by its claw
and torn apart.

An LFO developed at the Federation's Tresor
Institute. As its name, 'Terminus type B303,'
indicates, it is the earliest unit in the Terminus
line. Given its shape, it is said to possibly be a
transitional machine born somewhere between the
type ZERO and the End.
 It was an experimental unit never officially
adopted, and traces of that remain in its movable
Long Range Laser Cannon mounted on its back and
in its transformation mechanism, which was
ultimately omitted.
 Its greatest feature is that its 'Compac Feedback
System' has no limiter installed. In exchange for
the astonishing agility this grants, it places an
extraordinary physical and mental burden on its
rider. Because of this, administering drugs that
heighten the nervous system's responsiveness is
mandatory before boarding.
 Because of its aggressive shape and performance
that could even kill its own rider, it bears the
nickname 'Devil Fish.' Holland, having lost the R909,
piloted it and achieved great results in battle, but
the devil gradually ate away at his body.

The mobile mothership that serves as Gekkostate's
base.
 Originally the newest-model cruiser developed by
the Federation, Holland stole it when he staged his
mutiny, and has used it ever since.
 It possesses ultra-high-speed cruising ability from
its cutting-edge, high-output engine, along with the
transport and storage capacity of a mothership
able to carry four LFOs. In terms of combat
capability, it is armed with six main guns, pulse
laser cannons, and heat-seeking missiles. It is
further equipped with the stealth system 'Compac
Interferencer,' which cancels out residual Trapar
waves against radar waves to evade military
detection networks, allowing it to respond to
virtually any operation.
 On top of all this, it also functions as a living
space complete with private quarters for its
members, a shop, and even a large bathhouse - an
all-purpose ship that satisfies every need in a
single vessel.
