Toniya Malme is the
communications officer of
the Freeden. She is 17
years old.
 She has a bright and
friendly personality, and
she serves as the mood
maker not only on the
bridge but throughout the
entire Freeden.
 She was bound by a deep
friendship with Ennil,
whom she met during their
journey, and her inherent
brightness became a major
catalyst for thawing
Ennil's closed heart.
However, her blunt way of
speaking sometimes hurt
others, and she once made
a careless remark about
Witz's photograph,
touching on a deep wound.
 But that incident became
a turning point, and she
gradually grew closer to
Witz. Then, before the
final battle, they had
become close enough that
he gave her a ring along
with his feelings.

 His appearance is plain,

somewhat lacking. However,
his skill at the helm is
first-rate, making him an
indispensable presence on
the Freeden. When he
first went to space, he
demonstrated a masterful
feat by handling the helm
of the Freeden II after
merely reading the manual.
 While at anchor, he also
handles various
miscellaneous duties, and
when Garrod, who had
infiltrated the Freeden,
was put in a cell, he
served as the guard.

Witz Sou is a mobile
suit pilot hired by the
Freeden. He is 17 years
old.
 He has a manly
personality in every
sense, and he is the type
who acts before he
speaks. His language is
also quite rough.
 He was originally a
freelance mobile suit
pilot, and the Gundam Air
Master was a keepsake
from a Vulture who had
taken care of him in the
past. Initially, he gave
the impression of a
money-grubber who fought
only for pay, but that
was all to make life
easier for his family back
home.
 His father had been
killed by a mobile suit
pilot in the past, and
while he agonized over
not being able to reveal
his job to his mother,
who hated that
profession, he possessed
the kindness to keep
fighting for his family.
 He eventually signed an
exclusive contract with
the Freeden, with which
he had various
connections. Witz
rationalized it by saying
that the Freeden was
suitable as a hiding place
for the gold he earned,
but it is thought that
one of the reasons was
that he wanted to be
near Toniya, for whom he
had secretly developed
feelings.

Roybea Loy is a mobile
suit pilot employed by
the Freeden. 18 years old.
As a freelance mobile
suit pilot, he maintains a
carefree and
self-indulgent attitude,
saying 'I hate things
that are too ideological.'
However, when the
Freeden, which had
previously employed him,
fell into crisis, he rushed
to its aid, and as he
himself says, he is
'actually a good guy.' He
eventually signed an
exclusive contract with
the Freeden, which he had
various ties to, and
began to act alongside it.
At that time, he tried to
set up a relaxation room
on the ship and collect
membership fees from the
crew. However, under
Sara's conditions, women
were free, and no money
could be collected from
children (under 15), so
Garrod and Tiffa were
also free, and after
losing a billiards match,
Tex was free as well,
meaning he ended up
providing the room for
free to almost everyone
who would use it. He is
flirtatious and frivolous,
skilled with both his
hands and his tongue, and
his hobby is seducing
women. He has lovers in
various places, and he is
diligent enough to find
time to visit them under
the pretext of aftercare.
However, the woman he
truly loved has already
passed away, and his
beloved Gundam Leopard is
her memento. His current
true love is Sara. He
seems to harbor
surprisingly sincere
feelings for her and
constantly makes advances
on her.

mobile suit pilot whose
beloved machine is always
painted blue. 19 years
old. Using her skill and
beauty, she has survived
alone in the postwar
world. Because she has
lived a harsh life driven
by mere survival, she has
built a wall that keeps
others from getting close
to her heart. She met
Garrod when he took the

she came to cooperate
with Garrod as well.

saved by the Freeden, and
she subsequently came to
cooperate with Garrod as
well. In the epilogue,
though the circumstances
are unknown, she appeared
in Witz's hometown
together with Roybea, and
together with Toniya, the
two of them toyed with
the menfolk.

Kid Salsamill is the
chief mechanic of the
Freeden. As the youngest
crew member at 12 years
old, he serves as chief,
which shows that his
mechanical skill and
knowledge rival those of
an adult. Besides
maintaining mobile suits,
he is quite versatile,
creating simulators for
Bit attacks and adjusting
the combination mechanism
of the G-Falcon. Jamil
never interferes with his
work, indicating that he
places great trust in him.
He constantly hoards
useful parts and ideas,
and it was his handiwork
that powered up the
various Gundam units,
including the Gundam X,
the Airmaster, and the
Leopard.

Kid is the chief
mechanic of the Freeden.
As can be seen from the
fact that he serves as
chief at the young age
of 12, the youngest of
the crew, his mechanical
skills and knowledge rival
those of adults. He is
quite versatile, handling
mobile suit maintenance of
course, but also creating
simulators for bit attacks
and adjusting the
combining mechanisms of
the G Falcon. Jamil never
interferes with his work,
which suggests he places
great trust in Kid. He is
constantly stockpiling
useful parts and ideas,
and it was his handiwork
that powered up the
various Gundams, including
the Gundam X, the
Airmaster, and the
Leopard. After the
Freeden fulfilled its role,
he began running a junk
shop called 'Freeden III'
together with Shingo,
Pala, and his subordinate
mechanics.

Tex Farzenberg is the
exclusive physician of the
Freeden. 36 years old. His
ability as a doctor is
extremely high, and he
handles all kinds of work,
from internal medicine to
surgery, as well as
psychological care. As the
oldest crew member, he
possesses deep experience
and the composure of an
adult. Jamil trusts him
deeply and often
consulted with him. He is
a voracious reader and
once recited the contents
of 'Lorelei' by the
German poet Heine. His
hobby is billiards, and his
skill in that area is
considerable, as he won
decisively in a match
against Roybea with the
usage fee for the
relaxation room at stake.
Later, when most of the
crew went out for
supplies, he tried to take
the opportunity to do
secret training, but was
flustered when Sara and
Toniya witnessed the
scene, revealing an
unexpectedly childlike
side.

Tex is the Freeden's
dedicated physician. He is
36 years old. His ability
as a doctor is extremely
high, and he handles all
kinds of work, from
internal medicine to
surgery, and even mental
care. As the oldest of
the crew, he possesses
deep experience and the
composure of an adult.
Jamil also trusts him
deeply, and he often
served as a sounding
board for Jamil's
concerns. He is quite a
bibliophile, and once
recited the contents of
'Lorelei' by the German
poet Heine. His hobby is
billiards, and his skill at
this is also
considerable; in a match
with Roybea wagering the
usage fee for the
relaxation room, he won a
splendid victory. Later,
when most of the crew
went out for supplies, he
tried to conduct secret
training, thinking it was
a good opportunity, and
was seen by Sara and
Toniya, panicking -
showing an unexpectedly
childlike side. After the
Freeden was disbanded, he
served at a field
hospital. He offered a
cup to two enemy soldiers
arguing with each other
and said, 'Most problems
can be solved in your
heart while drinking one
cup of coffee. The rest
is just a matter of
whether you can put it
into action,' showing his
adult composure to the
very end.

Pala Sys is a pilot of
the G-Falcon, belonging to
the resistance
organization Satelicon
against the Space
Revolutionary Army. 15
years old. She lost both
parents, who were space
refugees, soon after her
birth. Having grown up in
an environment surrounded
by men, her language is
rough, and she often
blurts out things like
'That's lame.' Her
personality is also as
masculine as possible, but
when Satelicon was
destroyed, tears of
sorrow, and after
achieving the destruction
of the colonial laser that
was her true goal, tears
of joy streamed down her
cheeks. At that moment,
her face was that of a
girl her age. She hit it
off with Garrod when she
saved him from a pinch in
space, and they came to
fight together.
Afterwards, when she
joined the Freeden, she
got along well with Kid,
who was a kindred spirit.

Pala is a G Falcon pilot
belonging to Saterikon, a
resistance organization
against the Space
Revolutionary Army. She
is 15 years old. Her
parents, who were space
refugees, died soon after
she was born. Having
grown up in an
environment surrounded
only by men, she blurts
out rough words like
'that's lame' and her
speech is crude. Her
personality is also
extremely boyish, but
when Saterikon was
annihilated, tears of
sadness, and after
achieving the destruction
of the Colony Laser, her
true aspiration, tears of
joy flowed down her
cheeks. Her face at that
time was that of a girl
her age. She hit it off
with Garrod when she
helped him out of a pinch
in space, and they came
to fight together.
Afterwards, when she
became a member of the
Freeden, she got along
with Kid, who was a
kindred spirit. After the
war ended, she seems to
have found a new place
for herself at the junk
shop 'Freeden III' that
she started with Kid,
Shingo, and the others.

Shagia Frost is the
elder of the notorious
Frost brothers, free
mobile suit pilots. He is
19 years old. His
appearance as a free
mobile suit pilot is a
cover; his true identity
is an agent of the New
Federation's intelligence
agency. He possesses the
telepathic ability 'Twins'
Synchronity,' which allows
him to communicate with
his fraternal twin brother
Olba without words. This
enables them to avoid
danger for each other and
to conduct operations
even from distant
locations. However,
despite such abilities,
they were not recognized
under the supremacy of
Newtypes and were
branded with the
'Category F' label. As a
result, he came to hate
Newtypes and everything
in the world that
acknowledged their
existence. His personality
is cruel and ruthless, and
he stops at nothing to
achieve his goals. He
killed his targets of
revenge and those who
had outlived their
usefulness one after
another, sometimes with
his beloved Gundam
Virsago and sometimes by
directly pointing a gun at
them. He was always calm
and composed, able to
accurately assess the
surrounding situation and
the tide of battle. He
often admonished Olba,
whose blood would rush to
his head and lose sight
of the situation.

An infamous freelance
mobile suit pilot. The
elder of the Frost
brothers. 19 years old.
His career as a freelance
mobile suit pilot was a
cover; in truth, he was
an agent of the New
Federation military
intelligence agency. He
possessed the telepathic
ability 'Twins
Synchronity,' which
allowed him to
communicate with his
fraternal twin brother
Olba without speaking a
word. This allowed them
to avoid danger for each
other and to carry out
operations even from
distant locations.
However, despite
possessing such abilities,
he was not recognized
under Newtype supremacism
and was branded with the
mark of 'Category F.' As
a result, he came to hate
Newtypes and all of the
world that acknowledged
their existence. His
personality was cruel and
vicious, and he stopped
at nothing to achieve his
goals. He killed his
targets of revenge and
those whose use had
expired one after
another, sometimes with
his beloved Gundam
Virsago and sometimes by
pointing a gun directly at
them. He was also always
calm and collected, able
to accurately assess his
surroundings and the tide
of battle. He frequently
chided Olba, who would
lose his head and lose
sight of the situation,
but during the final
battle with Garrod, he
forcibly fired a satellite
launcher that was
insufficiently charged,
despite Olba's attempts
to stop him. After the
war ended, he was seen in
a corner of a certain
town, pushing Olba's
wheelchair while watching
Garrod and Tiffa set out
on their journey.

Olba Frost is the
younger of the notorious
Frost brothers, free
mobile suit pilots. He is
19 years old. His
appearance as a free
mobile suit pilot is a
cover; his true identity
is an agent of the New
Federation's intelligence
agency. He possesses the
telepathic ability 'Twins'
Synchronity,' which allows
him to communicate with
his fraternal twin brother
Shagia without words.
This enables them to
avoid danger for each
other and to conduct
operations even from
distant locations.
However, despite such
abilities, they were not
recognized under the
supremacy of Newtypes
and were branded with
the 'Category F' label. As
a result, he came to hate
Newtypes and everything
in the world that
acknowledged their
existence. His personality
is cold and heartless, and
he stops at nothing to
achieve his goals. But
that was only his outward
face; hidden within his
refined features was a
passion beyond
imagination. He was often
restrained by Shagia when
his blood rushed to his
head and he lost sight of
the situation.

An infamous freelance
mobile suit pilot. The
younger of the Frost
brothers. 19 years old.
His career as a freelance
mobile suit pilot was a
cover; in truth, he was
an agent of the New
Federation military
intelligence agency. He
possessed the telepathic
ability 'Twins
Synchronity,' which
allowed him to
communicate with his
fraternal twin brother
Shagia without speaking a
word. This allowed them
to avoid danger for each
other and to carry out
operations even from
distant locations.
However, despite
possessing such abilities,
he was not recognized
under Newtype supremacism
and was branded with the
mark of 'Category F.' As
a result, he came to hate
Newtypes and all of the
world that acknowledged
their existence. His
personality was cold and
heartless, and he stopped
at nothing to achieve his
goals. But that was only
his outward face; within
him lay a fierce passion
unimaginable from his
refined features. He was
often admonished by
Shagia when he lost his
head and lost sight of
the situation. However,
during the final battle
with Garrod, a rare scene
was seen where he
stopped Shagia, who tried
to forcibly fire an
insufficiently charged
satellite launcher. After
the war ended, in a
corner of a certain town,
there was his figure
pushing Shagia's
wheelchair while watching
Garrod and Tiffa set out
on their journey.

Lancerow Dawell is the
captain of the Space
Revolutionary Army's
training battalion, with
the rank of colonel. He is
34 years old. During the
7th Space War, he was a
Newtype who fought
evenly with Jamil, but
after the war ended, he
lost that ability. Even 15
years later, he remains
with the Revolutionary
Army and is highly
favored by President
Seidel. However, he is
aware that this is
because, as a former
Newtype, he holds value
to the populace as a
symbol of the future and
to the military as a
means to boost morale.
Even without his Newtype
powers, his mobile suit
piloting skills are
top-notch. When he
clashed with Garrod, who
went to space for Tiffa,
he overwhelmed him with
ease, as if twisting a
baby's arm. Eventually, he
learned that Jamil was
fighting to protect
Newtypes, came to
understand his actions,
and lent aid to Jamil and
his group when they were
struggling against the
Frost brothers.

The captain of the
Space Revolutionary
Army's training battalion.
His rank was colonel. 34
years old. He was a
Newtype who fought on
equal terms with Jamil
during the 7th Space War,
but after the war ended,
he lost that ability. Even
15 years later, he still
belonged to the
Revolutionary Army and
was highly favored by
Supreme Leader Seidel.
However, he was aware
that this was because his
former status as a
Newtype made him useful
to the public as a symbol
of the future and to the
military as a means of
boosting morale. Even
without his Newtype
powers, his mobile suit
piloting skills were
top-class. When he
engaged Garrod, who had
gone into space for
Tiffa's sake, he won a
complete victory with
ease. Eventually, he
learned that Jamil was
fighting to protect
Newtypes, came to
understand his actions,
and aided Jamil and his
group when they were
struggling against the
Frost brothers. After the
war ended, as one of the
leaders of the Space
Revolutionary Army, he
shook hands in friendship
with Jamil, who had
become a member of the
peace council.

Katock Alzamille is a
soldier belonging to the
New Federation. His
abilities as a soldier are
high enough to serve as
captain of a special unit,
but he is also a man who
causes trouble in various
places, such as disobeying
orders and firing at
superiors. He infiltrated
the Freeden disguised as
a fisherman, intending to
capture it, but failed and
was instead taken
prisoner. Later, amid the
chaos of battle, he
seized the bridge and
achieved his objective,
but meeting Tiffa brought
a change to his heart.
When Garrod sought to
rescue Tiffa, who had
been captured by the New
Federation, he cooperated
without regard for his
own interests. Though he
claimed to dislike it, he
often spoke of his dead
wife whenever something
happened, revealing the
depth of his feelings for
the family he had lost in
the war.

A military officer
belonging to the New
Federation. His abilities
as a soldier were high
enough to serve as the
captain of a special
forces unit, but he was
also a man who caused
trouble in various places
through insubordination
and firing on his
superiors. He infiltrated
the Freeden disguised as
a fisherman, plotting to
capture it, but failed and
was captured himself
instead. Later, taking
advantage of the
confusion of battle, he
seized the bridge and
accomplished his goal, but
meeting Tiffa brought
about a change in his
heart. He cooperated with
Garrod, who sought to
rescue Tiffa from the
New Federation's capture,
without regard for his
own interests, but in the
end, he died shielding
Garrod and Tiffa from
gunfire. Although he
claimed to be bad with
such things, he spoke of
his deceased wife at
every turn, revealing the
depth of his feelings for
the family he had lost in
the war.

Seidel Rasso is the
president of the Space
Revolutionary Army. He
advocated the ideology of
Newtype supremacy,
holding that 'humanity is
truly established as
Newtypes only through
space transforming them,'
and sought to lead
humanity living in space.
However, these claims
were nothing more than a
pretext to maintain his
own power, and he did not
truly need Newtypes. For
that reason, he
stubbornly refused to
acknowledge Tiffa, a
naturally occurring
Newtype born and raised
on Earth. While he was in
the midst of a decisive
battle on the Moon to
destroy the New
Federation and obtain the
power of Newtypes, he
was led to D.O.M.E. and
came into contact with
its true essence.

The supreme leader of
the Space Revolutionary
Army. He advocated the
Newtype ideology that
'humanity is first
established as a Newtype
when space transforms
them,' and sought to lead
humanity living in space.
However, these claims
were merely slogans to
maintain his own power,
and he had no real need
for true Newtypes. For
that reason, he not only
refused to acknowledge
Tiffa, a naturally
occurring Newtype born
and raised on Earth, but
even sought to eliminate
her. While in the midst of
the decisive battle on
the Moon to destroy the
New Federation and obtain
the power of Newtypes,
he was led to D.O.M.E.
and came into contact
with its true nature.
However, he could not
accept the fact revealed
there that 'Newtypes do
not exist.' Clinging to his
Newtype ideology and
attempting to continue
the fight, he was shot by
the Frost brothers and
vanished into space along
with his ambitions.

The supreme commander
of the New Federation
Forces. He feared that
with the rise of
Newtypes, all people
including himself would be
branded as old humanity.
He was flattered by the
Frost Brothers as 'one
destined to become the
new leader of the world,'
and eventually, guided by
them, he would engage in
a decisive battle with the
revolutionary army on the
Moon.

The supreme commander
of the New Federation
Forces. He feared that
with the rise of
Newtypes, all people
including himself would be
branded as Oldtypes. He
was lifted up by the
Frost Brothers as 'one
who would become the new
leader of the world,' and
eventually, guided by
them, he fought a
decisive battle against
the Revolutionary Army on
the Moon. Later, through
contact with D.O.M.E., he
touched upon the true
nature of Newtypes, but
even so, he did not stop
the war. When escaping
from D.O.M.E., his
insistence on Newtypes to
the very end incurred the
wrath of the Frost
Brothers, and he was
blown away along with his
ship.

A fifteen-year-old boy
serving as the leader of
the self-defense corps in
the regional city of Fort
Severn. He was an
artificial Newtype so
excellent that Mayor
Nomoa called him 'my
greatest masterpiece.' He
himself possessed absolute
confidence in his own
power, and had the ability
to match it. He repelled
the Gundam X with his
beloved Vertigo, but the
existence of Tiffa, a
natural Newtype who
should not have existed,
and his defeat at the
hands of the revived
Garrod caused him to lose
his sense of purpose.
Finally, when he tried to
take his own life, Garrod
saved him, and that event
opened his heart.
Afterwards, his power was
exploited by Nomoa, who
was actually Dorat, and
he destroyed the city
with the Patulia. After
Dorat was defeated by
Garrod and the others, he
resolved to devote
himself to rebuilding the
city as atonement. Later,
as a unit commander
leading a force of the
anti-New Federation
organization, he saved the
crew of the Freeden from
a crisis. Furthermore,
when they needed a means
to reach space, he even
provided a space
battleship.

A boy who served as the
leader of the
self-defense corps of the
local city Fort Severn. 15
years old. He was an
artificial Newtype so
excellent that Mayor
Nomoa called him 'my
greatest masterpiece.' He
himself had absolute
confidence in his own
power, and possessed
corresponding ability. He
used his beloved Vertigo
to drive off the Gundam
X, but the existence of
Tiffa, a natural Newtype
who should not exist, and
his defeat by a revived
Garrod caused him to lose
his sense of purpose.
Finally, when he was
about to take his own
life, Garrod saved him,
and that became the
catalyst for him to open
his heart. Afterwards, his
power was exploited by
Nomoa, in truth Dorat,
and he destroyed the city
with Patulia. After Dorat
was defeated by Garrod
and the others, he
resolved to devote
himself to the city's
reconstruction as
atonement. Later, as a
unit commander leading
one force of the
anti-New Federation
organization, he saved the
crew of the Freeden from
crisis. Furthermore, when
they needed a means to
go into space, he even
arranged a space
battleship for them. For
a while after the war
ended, he apparently
traveled with Garrod and
Tiffa. But his tact in
departing alone, saying, 'I
cannot keep getting in
the way of you two
forever,' was worthy of
the name of a Newtype.

A former Federation
forces educational officer
and instructor in charge
of the Flash System. She
was Jamil's superior
during his military days,
but to him she was a
woman of greater
significance than that. In
the final stages of the
great war, her hatred of
battle and her wish for
peace grew too strong,
causing her to suffer a
mental breakdown. The
Federation Forces,
noticing her Newtype
abilities and her hatred
of fighting, used her as
the core of the L
System, which could
disable the electronic
equipment of weapons.
However, the L Operation
that was supposed to
employ it was ultimately
cancelled. The L System
later lay at the bottom
of the sea, but it was
discovered and recovered
during the salvage of the
G Bits that had sunk
alongside it. The Lucile
within was not completely
unconscious; she
appeared before Jamil
using Tiffa's body and
saved the Freeden from
an attack by the Sea
Barchew. She also lent
her power to Jamil, who
had lost his Newtype
abilities, and assisted in
controlling the G Bits.
After the battle ended,
she was reunited with
Jamil.

An educational officer
of the Old Federation
Forces, in charge of
instructing the Flash
System. She was Jamil's
superior during his
military days, but to him,
she was a woman who
meant more than that. At
the end of the great
war, her hatred of battle
and her wish for peace
became too strong,
causing her to suffer a
mental breakdown. The
Federation Forces,
noticing her Newtype
abilities and her hatred
of war, used her as the
core of the L System,
which halted the
electronic equipment of
weapons. However, the L
Operation that was to
use it was ultimately
canceled. Afterwards, the
L System lay at the
bottom of the sea, but it
was discovered and
recovered during the
salvage of the G Bits
that had sunk at the
same time. Lucille within
was not completely
unconscious; borrowing
Tiffa's body, she
appeared before Jamil and
saved the Freeden from
an attack by the
Seaburch. She also lent
her power to Jamil, who
had lost his Newtype
abilities, assisting in the
control of the G Bits.
After the battle was
over, when she was
reunited with Jamil, at
her own request, she sank
deep into the sea along
with the L System.

The intelligence chief of
the Government Rebuilding
Committee. He was the
man who had the Gundam
Double X developed on
Zonder Epta Island. He
focused on Newtypes,
plotting to gain their
power and take control of
the committee. He believed
he was manipulating the
Frost Brothers to suit
his own purposes, but in
reality he was merely
being used by them.

The intelligence
coordinator of the
Government Reconstruction
Committee. The man who
had the Gundam Double X
developed on Zonder Epta
Island. He focused on
Newtypes, plotting to
obtain their power and
take control of the
committee. He believed he
was manipulating the
Frost Brothers to suit
his own convenience, but
in reality, he was merely
being used by them in
turn. In the end, during
the escape from Zonder
Epta, he was shot dead
by Shagia.

A military officer
belonging to the New
Federation Forces, with
the rank of lieutenant.
He was originally a skilled
pilot, but during combat
with Garrod he awakened
the Newtype abilities he
had latent potential for,
and used Bit mobile suit
tactics to drive Garrod
and the others into a
corner.

A soldier belonging to
the New Federation
Forces, with the rank of
lieutenant. Originally a
skilled pilot, he blossomed
his latent Newtype
abilities during combat
with Garrod, using Bit
Mobile Suit tactics to
corner Garrod and the
others. However, when he
temporarily withdrew due
to damage, he was struck
down by a bullet from
Shagia, who hated
Newtypes.

Shinn Asuka is a mobile
suit pilot assigned to the
Minerva. He is 16 years
old.
 Born and raised in Orb,
he lived peacefully with
his family, unaware of
war. However, during the
Earth Alliance's invasion
of Orb in the previous
war, he lost both his
parents and his younger
sister before his very
eyes. Shortly thereafter,
at Todaka's suggestion,
he relocated to PLANT,
and, believing that 'power
is necessary to protect
what is precious,' he
joined ZAFT. He graduated
from the academy with
excellent records and
rose to wear the red
uniform, the mark of an
elite pilot. Given this
background, while his
nature is cheerful, he has
a very sensitive side, and
his aggression often
comes to the surface.
 His hidden potential was
recognized by Durandal,
and he was chosen as the
pilot of the Impulse
Gundam, the latest mobile
suit. When the three
Second Stage Gundams
were stolen, he sortied
to take them back.
Initially, due to a lack
of combat experience, he
achieved little, but
eventually, his rejection
of the repeated battles
and deaths caused him to
awaken SEED. From then
on, he fought with
unparalleled vigor and
grew into a top ace.
While he respected
Athrun, he often vented
his anger at Athrun's
indecisive attitude.
 His chance encounter
with Stella, and their
reunion amid battle, led
him to see the shadow of
his younger sister in her.
When Stella was taken
prisoner, he risked his
own life to let her
escape, but even so, she
could not be saved from
her cruel fate.

Shinn Asuka is a mobile
suit pilot assigned to the
Minerva. He is 16 years
old. Born and raised in
Orb, he lived peacefully
with his family, knowing
nothing of war. However,
during the Earth Alliance
invasion of Orb in the
previous war, he lost

sister before his very
eyes. Shortly thereafter,

emigrated to PLANT, and
believing that 'power is
necessary to protect
what is precious,' he
joined ZAFT. He graduated

excellent results and
earned the right to wear
the red uniform, the mark
of an elite pilot. Given
this background, while he
is cheerful at heart, he
has a very sensitive side

strong aggression.
 Duraldul, perhaps seeing
promise in his hidden
potential, chose him as
the pilot of the Impulse
Gundam, the latest model.
When the three
second-stage Gundams
were stolen, he sortied
to take them back.
Initially, due to a lack
of combat experience, he
achieved little, but his
repeated exposure to
battle and death
eventually caused him to
awaken SEED. From then
on, he fought with
remarkable skill and grew
into a top ace. While he
respected Athrun, he
often vented his anger at
Athrun's indecisive
attitude.
 His chance encounter
with Stella, and their
reunion in battle, led him
to see in her the image
of his late sister. When
Stella was taken prisoner,
he risked his own safety
to help her escape, but
she could not escape her
cruel fate. When he met
Stella again after she
lost her memories due to
re-adjustment, he tried
to persuade her and
restore her heart, but
his wish went unfulfilled,
and she died. Consumed by
anger and hatred, he shot
down Kira, who had
delivered the killing blow
to Stella, and also shot
down Athrun, who had
defected from Durandal.
This became the catalyst
for him being given the
Destiny Gundam and
appointed as a member of
the special forces FAITH,
steadily turning him into
Durandal's vanguard.
 During the final battle,
he listened to Athrun's
persuasion but stubbornly
continued to fight. In his
frenzy, he nearly
attacked even Lunamaria,
with whom he had shared
a connection, but at the
last moment he was shot
down by Athrun and
reunited with Stella in a
vision. He awoke on
Lunamaria's lap, shedding
tears as the war came to
its end.
 In the epilogue added in
'Final Plus,' he visits the
memorial in Orb and meets
Kira for the second time.
They shake hands, vowing
to continue fighting
together to maintain
peace.

Ray Za Barrel is a
mobile suit pilot assigned
to the Minerva.
 He is always calm,
possesses excellent
situational judgment, and
his mobile suit piloting
skills surpass those of
his peers Shinn and
Lunamaria. In space, he
fought evenly with Neo,
and his abilities were
recognized by those
around him to the extent
that Arthur wondered,
'Why was the Impulse
given to Shinn and not
Ray?'
 He adores Durandal, and
in his presence, his
personality changes into
that of an innocent boy.
At times, however, his
absolute trust appeared
fanatical.
 He viewed the Archangel,
which did not obey
Durandal, as an enemy,
and his conflict with
Athrun, who could not
sever his past ties with
them, deepened.

Ray Za Barrel is a
mobile suit pilot assigned
to the Minerva. Always
calm and possessing
excellent situational
awareness, his mobile suit
piloting skills surpass
those of his peers Shinn
and Lunamaria. In space,
he fought on equal
footing with Neo, and his
abilities were so highly
regarded by those around
him that Arthur wondered
why Shinn, not Ray, had
been chosen to pilot the
Impulse. He adores
Durandal like a father,
and his trust in him is
so deep that his
personality transforms
into that of an innocent
boy in Durandal's
presence. For this reason,
he views the Archangel,
which defies Durandal, as
an enemy, and his
conflict with Athrun, who
cannot sever his past
ties with them, deepens.
When Athrun attempted to
desert ZAFT, Ray pulled
the trigger without
hesitation, intending to
kill both him and Meyrin,
who had aided his escape.
When that failed, he
immediately boarded the
Legend Gundam and gave
chase. He also guided the
hesitant Shinn,
manipulating him into
shooting down Athrun. In
truth, like Rau Le
Creuset, who died in the
previous war, Ray is a
clone of Al Da Flaga. He
shares the same short
telomeres, meaning he was
not destined to live long.
During the final battle,
he was defeated by Kira
and his mobile suit was
wrecked. He barely
managed to reach Durandal
inside Messiah, but for
the sake of the 'future'
Kira spoke of, he fired a
bullet at the Durandal he
loved and revered. In his
final moments, held by
Talia, he wept, finally
finding a motherly
presence, and was
consumed by the
explosion.

Lunamaria Hawke is a
mobile suit pilot assigned

years old.
 Along with Shinn and
Ray, she achieved
excellent results at the
academy and became a
member of the elite known
as the red uniforms. She
primarily fought in a
GOUF Ignited painted in

 Together with her
younger sister Meyrin,
she took an interest in
Athrun, the hero of the
previous war, and made
various advances toward
him. However, she was
greatly shocked by a
certain action taken by
Athrun and Meyrin.

Lunamaria Hawke is a
mobile suit pilot serving
aboard the Minerva in the
ZAFT forces. She is 17
years old. Along with
Shinn and Ray, she
achieved excellent results
at the academy and
became one of the elite,
known as the Red Coats.
She primarily fought in a
GOUF Ignited painted in
her personal color, red.
Along with her younger
sister Meyrin, she was
interested in Athrun, a
hero of the previous war,
and made various advances
toward him. But when she
heard that Athrun had
deserted the military due

other's wounds, quickly

During the final battle,

the Orb memorial with

reconciles with Kira and

future.

Talia Gladys is the
captain of ZAFT's new
warship, the Minerva. She
is 29 years old.
 As befitting one of
ZAFT's rare female
captains, she excels in
situational judgment and
in managing people, and
she kept the young crew,
including Shinn and the
others, well organized.
 In the past, she and
Durandal had been lovers,
but because she could not
bear his child due to
incompatibility, she was
forced to end their
relationship. Even so, it
seems that lingering
feelings remain on both
sides.
 From the time of the
LOGOS subjugation onward,
she grew increasingly
distrustful of the
unreasonable orders and
inexplicable behavior
handed down by Durandal.

Talia Gladys is the
captain of the newly
built ZAFT warship
Minerva. She is 29 years
old. Living up to her rare
status as a female
captain in ZAFT, she
possesses excellent
situational judgment and
the ability to command
her crew's loyalty,
skillfully leading the
young crew including
Shinn. She was once in a
romantic relationship with
Durandal, but because she
could not bear his child
due to compatibility
issues, she reluctantly
ended their relationship.
However, it seems they
still harbor unresolved
feelings for each other.
From the time of the
LOGOS subjugation onward,
she grew increasingly
distrustful of the
unreasonable orders and
inexplicable actions coming
from Durandal. During the
final battle, when the
Minerva became unable to
fight, she entrusted the
crew to Arthur and
evacuated the ship,
heading to Durandal's
location to stop him.
When he fell after a
final exchange with Kira
and the others, she
watched over his final
moments and vanished with

Messiah.

Arthur Trine is the
deputy captain of ZAFT's
new warship, the Minerva.
He is 26 years old.
 Despite holding the
important post of deputy
captain, he is timid and
restless. He tends to get
carried away, and so was
frequently reprimanded by
Talia.
 He treated the veteran
crew members such as

familiarity, but he often
cast a cold eye on
Athrun, who joined
midway.

Arthur Trine is the
deputy captain of the
newly built ZAFT warship
Minerva. He is 26 years
old. Despite holding the
important post of deputy
captain, he is timid and
restless. He tends to get
carried away and was
often scolded by Talia.
He treated long-serving
crew members like Shinn

battle at Messiah, when

Meyrin Hawke is a crew

 Along with her older

 As she watches Athrun

Meyrin was a crew

 Along with her older

 As she watched Athrun

 In the epilogue added in

Yolant Kent is a

 He is a classmate and

Yolant was a mechanic
on the Minerva. He was 17
years old.
 He was a classmate and
friend of Ray and Meyrin
from the academy.
 Unlike his partner Vino,

personality. As a big

of Athrun, who was

one point he made
remarks, half joking and

Vino Duple is a mechanic
on the Minerva. He is 16

 He is a classmate and

Vino was a mechanic on

 He was a classmate and

 Unlike his partner

Alex Dino is the false

Alex Dino was the alias
Athrun used when he
defected to Orb after
the end of the previous
war.
 When going out, he wore

hard to imagine that
anyone who knew him

saw through it

Athrun Zala is one of
the figures who brought
the previous war to an

name is known to
everyone in PLANT. He is
18 years old.
 After the war, he
defected to Orb and

However, faced with the

 Riding the Saviour

 At first he sympathized

 After the war, he

 He piloted the Saviour

 Initially he sympathized

 However, his indecisive

 The hesitation he once

Athrun Zala, who escaped

existence that could be

Coordinator', born through

The representative of
the Orb Union chief
state. She is 18 years
old.
 She carries on the will
of the former
representative Uzumi,
striving to lead her
homeland and the world to
peace. However, due to
her youth and
inexperience, as well as
the covert machinations
of the Seiran father and
son, she cannot unite the
nation, and she keenly
feels her own
powerlessness.
 When Athrun, with whom

since the previous war,
left Orb, he gave her a

for the reason of
'unifying the nation,' she
reluctantly decided to
marry Yuna, and she cut
off her feelings. But
during the wedding
ceremony, she was taken
away by her twin brother
Kira's Freedom Gundam,
and the marriage was
ruined.

 During the battle at

at one point consumed by
a dark hatred of
Coordinators. Yet as she
came to learn the hidden
side of the war, she grew
mentally and fought
through to the end of
the conflict. After the
war's conclusion, she
traveled the world as a
battlefield journalist,
camera in hand,
photographing and
witnessing wars across
the globe. Combined with
her own past experiences,
she grieved for a world
stained by conflict, but
when the Archangel
launched once more, she
boarded the ship again to
fight alongside it. After
Cagalli rose as head of
state, she was formally
incorporated into the Orb
military.

Miriallia is a member of
the Archangel's crew
responsible for
communications control.
She is 18 years old.
Originally nothing more
than an ordinary student,
she was drawn into the
military in the previous
war. Having lost her lover
Tolle on the battlefield,
she was for a time
consumed by a dark
hatred of Coordinators.
But as she learned of the
war's hidden truths, she
grew emotionally and
fought through to the
war's end. After the war,
she worked as a
battlefield journalist,
photographing and
witnessing wars around
the world with camera in
hand. Combined with her
own past experiences, she
grieved for a world
stained by conflict, but
when the Archangel
launched, she boarded
again to fight alongside
them. Regarding Dearka,
who had harbored
unrequited feelings for
her, things apparently did
not work out. When she
happened to run into
Athrun on a street
corner and chatted with
him, she visibly grimaced
at the mention of
Dearka's name, suggesting
that there was some
decisive factor in why
the two never became
lovers.

An idol who was once
called the 'Songstress of
PLANT.' 18 years old. Her
presence and charisma
were immense, and in the
previous war she pointed
the way for Kira, Athrun,
and others, gathering
those who shared her
convictions, becoming a
great driving force that
led the conflict to its
end. After the previous
war, she crossed to Orb
together with Waltfeld,
Murrue, and her lover
Kira, who had fought
alongside her. There she
lived quietly with
Reverend Malchio, Kira's
adoptive mother Caridad,
and a group of orphans,
but learned that her
brief peace had been
shattered by the
appearance of those who
sought to assassinate
her. With the emergence
of the fake Meer as well,
her suspicions toward
Durandal deepened.
Resolving to return to
the public stage, Lacus
boarded the Archangel
together with Kira.

Lacus was once called
the 'Songstress of PLANT'
and is an idol-like figure.
She is 18 years old. Her
presence and charisma are
immense, and in the
previous war she guided
the paths of Kira and
Athrun, gathered those
who shared her ideals,
and was a major driving
force in bringing the
conflict to an end. After
the previous war, she
went to Orb with

with Reverend Malchio,
Kira's adoptive mother

her brief peace was
shattered by the
appearance of those who
sought to assassinate

deepened. Resolving to
return to the public
stage, she boarded the
Archangel with Kira.
Later, going into space
and learning of the
'Destiny Plan,' she
declared her opposition to

Gundams for Kira and
Athrun, she personally
boarded the Infinite
Justice Gundam (though
she mostly just rode
along) and delivered it
to Athrun. She also
worked energetically,
gathering forces from
various quarters, and
became the ideological
pillar for those who
opposed Durandal. In the
final battle, as in the
previous war, she boarded
the Eternal and stood at
the front lines, fulfilling
her role as a
standard-bearer. After
the fight with Durandal,
she was seen at Kira's
side in both public and
private matters.

Captain of the
high-speed battleship
Eternal. 32 years old. He
was originally a member
of ZAFT, a fierce warrior
feared under the epithet
'Desert Tiger.' However,
during the previous war
he defected from the
military, siding with Lacus
and helping bring the
conflict to an end. After
the previous war, he fled
to Orb together with
Kira, Murrue, Lacus, and
the others who had
fought alongside him,
enjoying a brief peace
while savoring his hobby
of coffee. While
considering a move to
PLANT, he was attacked
by a special forces unit
aiming to assassinate
Lacus, and repelled them.
Taking that as a turning
point, he resolved to
once again face the war
as a third faction. After
the Archangel launched,
he supported Murrue in a
vice-captain-like position,
and in times of crisis
sortied in a Murasame
painted in his personal
colors, displaying that his
skills had not diminished.
When Lacus later acted to
confirm the state of
PLANT, he went up into
space with her as her
escort. When the Eternal
resumed operations, he
took his old seat in its
captain's chair as in the
previous war. When forced
to fight alone, he also
sortied in the Gaia
Gundam, successor to his
former beloved machine.
After Cagalli returned to
Orb, he was formally
incorporated into the Orb
military.

Waltfeld's adjutant. He

defected together with

played a significant role,

discovering notes on the

Kojirou Murdoch is the
mechanic chief of the
Archangel. He is 33 years
old. For convenience, his
rank is listed as Sergeant
Major from his time in
the Earth Alliance Forces.
 After the end of the
previous war, he appears
to have worked at
Morgenroete, and he
single-handedly handles
the maintenance of both
mobile suits and the
Archangel, which is
convincing given his
undiminished skill.
 He is stubborn,
foul-mouthed, and gives a
rough impression from his
appearance. However, his
sense of responsibility
toward his position as a
mechanic, whose work
affects the lives of
pilots, and the feelings
he holds for his comrades
that stem from it, are
stronger than most. When
Athrun attempted to
sortie despite his
injuries, he contacted
Murrue to have her stop
him.

Mudock is the
Archangel's chief
mechanic. He is 33 years
old. For convenience, his
rank was set as Sergeant
Major from his Earth
Alliance days, but his
rank after formally being
incorporated into the Orb
military is unknown. After
the previous war, he
apparently worked at
Morgenroete and handles
all maintenance for both
mobile suits and the
Archangel, making his
undiminished skill
understandable. He is
stubborn and
foul-mouthed, and his
appearance gives a rough
impression. But his sense
of responsibility toward
his position as a
mechanic, whose work
affects pilots' lives, and
the feelings for his
comrades that stem from
it, are stronger than
most. When Athrun tried
to sortie despite his
injury, he contacted
Murrue to have her stop
him. Also, right after Mu
(Neo) returned, he was
seen smiling happily.

Yuna Roma Seiran is the
heir of the Seiran family,
one of Orb's five major
clans, and is Cagalli's
fiance. He is 22 years
old.
 In collusion with his
father Unato, he used
smooth talk to carry out
a marriage with Cagalli,
aiming to take control of
Orb in name and in fact.
During the wedding
ceremony that eventually
came, Cagalli was taken
from him by Kira's
Freedom Gundam.
Furthermore, he was
interrupted during the
subsequent battle with
the Minerva, and his pride
was thoroughly crushed on
every front.
 After sitting in the Orb
representative's seat due
to Cagalli's absence, he
went to the front lines
as the commander leading
the Orb fleet. However,
his command ability is
completely nonexistent,
being utterly childish.
Moreover, he was so
obsessed with operation
names that he cooled the
mood of those around him,
and even while other crew
members worked through
the night, he slept
soundly alone, making his
casual attitude plainly
visible.

 Collaborating with his

 After Cagalli's absence

 In reality, he had

when he was forced to

after being found out,
Orb came under a

eventually returned, he
forgot that he had
denounced her as a fake
and tried to ingratiate
himself with her, but was
promptly arrested for
high treason. He
attempted to escape in
the confusion of battle
after being deposed, but
was crushed to death by

fall on him.

Unato Ema Seiran is the
head of the Seiran family,
one of Orb's five major
clans, and Yuna's father.
 Despite holding the
position of chancellor
supporting the nation, he
plotted to dominate Orb
by having Yuna and
Cagalli marry.

Unato Emma Seiran was
the head of the Seiran
family, one of the five

 While holding the

 Behind the scenes, he

Todaka is the captain of
the aircraft carrier
Takemikazuchi belonging to
the Orb Navy. His rank is
Commander (Colonel).
 He had a warm-hearted
personality and good
sense, and he enjoyed the
deep trust of his
subordinates.
 He constantly harbored
resentment toward
unreasonable orders, such
as attacks on the
Minerva, which saved the
Earth from Junius Seven's
fall, and on the Archangel
carrying Cagalli, the head
of state. Regarding the
reckless order issued by
Yuna, who was aboard as
supreme commander, to
'attack that Cagalli
because she is a fake,'
he judged that since Orb
had already allied with
the Earth Alliance, it was
unavoidable in order to
protect Orb. Placing his
hopes on the Freedom
Gundam serving as escort,
he issued the attack
order with great
reluctance.

 He had a warm-hearted

 He constantly harbored

Ledonir Kisaka is a
soldier belonging to the
Orb Army. His rank is
Commander (Colonel).
 He is a direct
subordinate of Uzumi, the
former head of state of
Orb, and in the previous
war he also served as
Cagalli's guard. After
Uzumi's death, he
continued to watch over
her as her guardian.
 After the alliance
between the Earth
Alliance and Orb, he
infiltrated the Earth
Alliance Forces to
investigate their
movements.

Rednil Kisaka was a
soldier belonging to the
Orb Army. His rank was
Captain (Colonel).
 He was a direct
subordinate of Uzumi, the
former head of state of
Orb, and had served as
Cagalli's guard during the
previous war. After
Uzumi's death, he
continued to watch over
Cagalli as her guardian.
 After the alliance
between the Earth
Alliance and Orb, he
infiltrated the Earth
Alliance forces to probe
their movements. Along
the way, when he learned
of Athrun and Meyrin's
escape, he rescued them
after they had been shot
down and guided them to
the Archangel.
 When Cagalli insisted on
sortieing upon learning of
Orb's crisis, he entrusted
her with the Akatsuki
that Uzumi had left
behind. He himself also
sortied in a Murasame.

Durandal is the Chairman
of the PLANT Supreme
Council. He is 32 years
old.
 Unlike his predecessor,
Chairman Patrick Zala, he
is a moderate who seeks
a path of coexistence and
peace with the Naturals.
During the Junius Seven
fall incident and the
subsequent battles with
the Earth Alliance, he
consistently made calm
and precise judgments,
demonstrating excellent
leadership.
 He is also a leading
authority on genetic
research, and it is
thought that he came to
know Rau and Ray through
that connection. He also
seemed to have
anticipated from the
start that Shinn would
manifest the SEED factor.
 He promoted Meer as
Lacus in an attempt to
raise the morale of all of
PLANT. However, his
secret plot to
assassinate the real
Lacus was exposed, which
earned him the opposition
of Kira and the others.

 Unlike the previous

sought a path of
coexistence and peace
with the Naturals. During
the Junius Seven fall
incident and the

leadership.
 He was also an authority

 He propped up Meer as

boost the fighting spirit
of all of PLANT. However,
his secret plot to
assassinate the real
Lacus was exposed,

Kira and the others.
 His ultimate goal was to
construct a managed
society that controlled
humanity at the genetic

destroying LOGOS, he
declared the introduction
and implementation of the
plan to the world, but
was stopped by Kira and
the others, who rejected
a world where evolution
had ceased.
 In the end, he was shot
by Ray, whom he had
trusted like his own son.
And so, his life came to
a close in the lap of
Talia, who had once been
his lover and had
continued to hold feelings
for him even after their
separation.

Yzak is the captain of
the ZAFT Joule Team. He
is 19 years old.
 During the previous war,
he cooperated with the
Archangel and the Eternal
at the very end, and
together they contributed
to bringing the war to a
close.
 After the war ended,
with Durandal's
assistance, he returned
to ZAFT, and thanks to
his talent, he rose at a
young age to the position
of team captain. His
ability to command his
unit using his abundant
combat experience, and
his skill in battle, are
first-rate. He was active
across a wide range of
operations in space,
including helping the
Minerva prevent the fall
of Junius Seven, defending
PLANT from the Earth
Alliance's unilateral
attacks, and the
operation to destroy the
beam deflection station
when PLANT became a
target of Requiem
(though this ended in
failure).
 When he reunited with
Athrun, he strongly urged
him to rejoin the
military, showing that he
had grown beyond the
petty rivalry he once
clung to.

 After successfully

Dearka belongs to ZAFT
and serves as the
adjutant and
second-in-command of the
Joule Team, led by his
best friend Yzak. He is
19 years old.
 He was also a member of
ZAFT during the previous
war, but after being
taken prisoner, he came
aboard the Archangel and
fought alongside them.
After contributing to
ending the war as part
of a third faction, he
returned to PLANT.
 Whether it is because he
was questioned about that
incident is uncertain, but
he wears the standard
soldier's uniform instead
of the red uniform that
marks an elite. However,
his skill as a pilot is in
no way diminished, and it
can be said that he has
grown into a more reliable
man, both in ability and
in mental fortitude.

A member of ZAFT,

 He belonged to ZAFT in

but after being taken
prisoner, he boarded the
Archangel and fought

 It is not certain

 It was thought he might
develop a good
relationship with Miriallia,
for whom he had
developed feelings, but
she herself confirmed

Heine is a member of
the ZAFT special forces
unit FAITH. Under
Durandal's orders, he was
transferred to the
Minerva. He is 21 years
old.
 With a bright and
friendly personality, he
had the adaptability and
sociability to immediately
blend in with the
Minerva's crew despite
joining partway through.
He particularly looked
after Athrun, admonishing
him when he saw him
troubled over battle, and
acting to close the
distance between him and
Shinn and the others, who
had their own walls.
 His mobile suit piloting
skill is also high, and his
machine was always
painted in his personal
color, orange. He
distinguished himself in
the PLANT defense battle
in a ZAKU Phantom, and in
the Battle of the
Dardanelles in a GOUF
Ignited that had been
deployed ahead of time.
 Incidentally, in German,
'Westen' means 'west' and
'fluss' means 'river'. This
naming was done as a
tribute to Heine's voice
actor, the artist Takanori
Nishikawa, who also
performed the theme song.

by Durandal, who thought
that someone was needed
to captivate the masses
as a stand-in for Lacus
after she disappeared
from the public eye. She
is 17 years old.
 Being herself a great
fan of Lacus, her figure
appealing for peace moved
the hearts of many, and
her singing voice
attracted countless
people. Thanks to plastic
surgery, her appearance
and voice were exactly

mannerisms were quite

somewhat suspicious. Even

 Whether she was
faithfully maintaining the
fiction that she was
engaged to Athrun, or
acting out of genuine
affection, she approached
him excessively and left
him bewildered.

 He is a man of many

 Beyond his un-soldierly

Despite his carefree

GUNBARRELs, and an

before, was an
acquaintance, and was

 It is believed that the
recreation of the same
circumstances as when he
lost his memories
triggered an effect

Apart from the scar on

 For Extendeds like him,

 Compared to Auel and

 In the battle over

 Just as his appearance

 For Extendeds like him,

Auel Neider was an

Gundam from ZAFT and

SEED, and in a brief

Silhouette as a

Stella Loussier was an
Extended belonging to the
Earth Alliance's special
forces unit, Phantom Pain.
She stole the Gaia
Gundam from ZAFT and
became its pilot.
 For Extends such as

 Compared to Sting and

 Reacting to Auel's words

 Their unit was a

 In the battle off the

A boy living in Urugusku

spending his days
absorbed in the online
game 'Overman Battle,' he
eventually achieved 200
consecutive wins and
obtained the champion
title of 'King.' One day,
in a prison where he was
held on false charges, he
met Gain and hitched onto
his escape. On the way,
he named the Overman he
acquired 'King Gainer,' and
showed off his game
champion skills against
the approaching Siberia
Railway guard. Then,
almost without meaning
to, he took part in the
Exodus. Because of his
past experiences, he was
initially quite introverted.
But while various feelings
- admiration for and
rebellion against Gain, his
feelings for Sara, and his
own sense of
responsibility and
potential - swirled within
him, he kept fighting, and
became a great power in
continuing the Exodus
under Yapan's ceiling. At

as a person.

ordinary
seventeen-year-old boy
living in Ugrusk, notable
only for his skill at
games. His parents were
killed by Exodusists,
leaving him with a
deep-seated hatred of
the Exodus and a

Immersing himself in the

 One day, in a prison

Overman, which he named
'King Gainer', and showed

 Due to his past
experiences, he was
initially quite introverted.
But through fighting
amidst a swirl of
emotions - admiration for
and rebellion against Gain,
feelings for Sara, his own
responsibilities and
potential - he continued
to battle, and the ceiling

source of strength for
continuing the Exodus. At
the same time, he grew
as a person.
 In a battle against
Cynthia, his game rival

Munt, he lost without
being able to fight

was also shocked by the
real combat where blood
was actually spilled, and
that opening led to her
being captured by the
Overdevil.
 To save Cynthia, he
undertook special training
to face both his game
rival and a real enemy
simultaneously. After a
hard-fought struggle, he
achieved victory and
succeeded in surpassing
his former self. Bearing
the new title of 'King',
he headed to Cynthia, and
although he was absorbed
by the Overdevil along
the way, he succeeded in
freeing her with the
support of Sara and Gain.

An Exodus contractor
who designs the Exodus
of Urugusku. Twenty-eight
years old. A master
sniper whose shots from
his beloved sniper rifle
'Angerma Tsaiza' never
miss. He is known by the
alias 'Black Southern
Cross' for firing six
cross-shaped bullet marks
into his targets, and has

shooting enemies who flee

whenever he gets the
chance and says things

character that hates
dishonesty. Moreover, he
is quick-witted, skilled in
hand-to-hand combat, and
shows excellent talent in
handling silhouette
machines and Overmen. In
any case, he is a reliable
man no matter what you
ask of him, and those
who know his true nature
place immense trust in
him. Though he does not
show it, he bears many
painful pasts, including
tragedies experienced in
his birthplace and the
death of his lover. The
name Gain also seems to
be an alias.

master sniper whose shots

rifle 'Angerma Zaisa'

is known by the epithet
'Black Southern Cross' for

bullet scars into his

opponent who turns his

 He often tries to charm

machines and Overmen. He

 His current name is a

the Ugrusk Exodus, it

28 years old. He masters
a suspicious technique
called 'Yapan Ninpo,' and
his combat abilities, from
physical arts (ninjutsu)
to piloting Silhouette
Machines, are extremely
high. Normally, he has a
warm and gentle
personality, but his true
nature is that of an
Exodus supremacist. For
the sake of carrying out
the Exodus, he does not
choose his means or ends,
and at times he resorts
to merciless methods. In
fact, it was Gauli who
killed Gainer's parents,
but he continued to
regret that act, harboring
a sentimentality that
could not fully commit to
ruthlessness. Because of
this, he feels conflict
over his position. He was
once taken in by
Desnetta due to this
weakness being exploited,
but was rescued by
Gainer, who was inwardly
conflicted upon learning
the truth. In the final
battle against the
Overdevil, he was
Overfrozen and lost his
sentimentality and
conflict, becoming an ice
demon who sought only to
use his combat abilities
for destruction and
slaughter. However,
receiving the desperate
kiss of Adette, who was
in love with Gauli, he
thawed the darkness in
his heart.

Adette Kistler is a
member of the Siberian
Railway Guard, aged 25.
She has a caring,
big-sisterly personality,
and was respected by
Kejinan and Enge as 'big
sis' and by Jaboli as
'older sister.' She
frequently clashed with
the people of Yapan's
ceiling, such as fighting
Gainer to stop the
Exodus, infiltrating alone
to seize Princess Ana,
and engaging in
hand-to-hand combat with
Gain.

Adette Kistler is a
member of the Siberia
Railway Guard. She is 25
years old. She has a
caring, big-sisterly
nature and is respected
by Enge and Kejinan as
'Big Sis' and by Jaboli as
'Lady.' She frequently
clashed with the people
of the ceiling of Yapan,
such as fighting Gainer
to prevent the Exodus, or
infiltrating alone to seize
Princess Ana and engaging
Gain in hand-to-hand
combat. After failing to
attack Yassaba and
breaking off, she was
left behind on the ceiling
of Yapan and lost her
destination. Later, while
participating in events
like the sports day, she
ended up joining the
Exodus by circumstance.

Adette, who quit the
Siberian Railway and
became a teacher at the
school Gainer attends.
Due to the circumstances
that led her there, she
had no place to live and
forced her way into
Gainer's room as a live-in
guest. Initially, she
caused problems such as
helping herself to the
students' lunches, but
with her innate
adaptability, she quickly
settled into Yapan's
ceiling. Gainer, who lived
with her, described her
as 'a clumsy, rough,
selfish, and truly
hopeless person.' When
the people of Domepolis
Gangaran established a
self-defense group, her
combat abilities caught
their eye and she was
chosen as captain,
forming 'Adette Squad.'
She stole a Dobek from
the Siberian Railway as a
substitute for her
severance pay and
deployed it to the squad,
and though her methods
remained as ever, she
displayed a captaincy
worthy of her drive and
leadership. She is only
interested in strong men,
and gave Gainer individual
training to toughen him
up. During her Siberian
Railway days, her interest
was in Yassaba, but now
it seems to be in Gauli.

Having quit the Siberia

Gainer attends. Having
arrived at this state by
circumstance, she had no

her way into Gainer's
room as a freeloader.
Initially, she caused
problems like helping

polis Gangaran established

Squad.' She stole a
Dobeck from the Siberia

Gainer. During her Siberia

was in Yassaba, but now
it seems to be in Gauli.
When Gauli was
manipulated by the
Overfreeze, she kissed
him without regard for
the danger and succeeded
in restoring his sense of
self.

Ana Medal is the
daughter of the Medail
duke family of Domepolis
Wulgusk, aged 8. She was
taken as a nominal
hostage for carrying out
the Exodus by Gain and
Gainer, who accompanied
him. With her abundant
curiosity, she joins the
Exodus while enjoying
herself. She has an
innocent personality
befitting her age, but at
times displays mature
thinking and speech. When
taken hostage by Asuham,
she sternly condemned his
actions with a composed
attitude.

Ana Medaiyu is the
daughter of the Medaiyu
ducal family of Domepolis
Wulgusk. She is eight
years old. She was taken
as a nominal hostage for
carrying out the Exodus
by Gain and the Gainer
that accompanied him.
Thanks to her vigorous
curiosity, she accompanies
the Exodus while enjoying
herself.
 While she has a guileless
personality befitting her
age, she sometimes shows
adult-like thinking and
speech. When taken
hostage by Asuham, she
criticized his actions with
a resolute attitude.
 After defeating the
Overdevil, she performed
the monkey dance familiar
from the opening.

Links is Ana's pet,
consisting of three
creatures: Link, Linna,
and Lins. They look
similar, but each has
distinct features such as
the color of their back
or tail and their gaze.
However, only a few
people, including Ana, can
tell them apart. They are
extremely active, always
moving around and often
riding on someone's head
or shoulders. Along with
their owner Ana, they
have become a mascot
presence in Yapan's
ceiling. 'Links' means
'wildcat' in English.

Mamadou Azaf, a
mechanic for the Gauli
squad and a history
teacher at the school
attended by Gainer and
the others, is 42 years
old. He once served as
Gainer's tutor in the
past, and even now he is
always finding something
to nag about.

Mamadou Azaf is the
mechanic for the Gauli
squad and also a history
teacher at the school
Gain and the others
attend. He is 42 years
old. He once served as
Gain's tutor, and even
now he finds excuses to
grumble at him. Also,
when the two are alone,
he calls Gain by his real
name, 'Shalle-sama.'
 Eventually he fell in
love with Lyubov, who was
young enough to be his
daughter.

Lyubov Smetana, a tutor
and caretaker for Ana, is
20 years old. She gives
an impression of being
intellectual and quiet, but
she does not hesitate to
put herself in danger for
Ana's sake. Furthermore,
when Gainer appeared at
the Medaiyu residence,
she took the initiative to
introduce herself,
revealing that she is in
fact an active and bold
character.

Lyubov Smetana is Ana's
tutor and caretaker. She
is 20 years old. Though
she gives an impression
of being intelligent and
quiet, she does not
hesitate to put herself
in danger for Ana's sake.
Furthermore, when Gain
appeared at the Medaiyu
residence, she took the
initiative to introduce
herself, revealing that
she is actually an active
and bold person.
 She once fought with
Kona over Gain, but in
the end she became
romantically involved with
Mamadou.

Gacha Winger is one of
the Five Sages of Uruksuk
and their leader, at 75
years old. Since he runs
a silhouette mammoth
maintenance factory, he
provided the silhouette
mammoth for the Exodus.

Gacha Winger is one of

and their leader, at 75
years old. Since he runs
a silhouette mammoth
maintenance factory, he
provided the silhouette
mammoth for the Exodus.

Perha Pei is one of the
Five Sages of Uruksuk, at
61 years old. She works
as a doctor at a small
clinic, but her hand
movements are quite
unsteady and her skill is
not very good.

Perha Pei is one of the

clinic, but her hand
movements are quite

Sitron Bi is one of the
Five Sages of Uruksuk, at
48 years old. He controls
the restaurant district
and himself runs numerous
drinking establishments.
His power seems to remain
intact even after the
Exodus.

Sitron Bi is one of the

48 years old. He controls
the restaurant district
and himself runs numerous
drinking establishments.
His power seems to remain
intact even after the
Exodus.

Mannan Doutton is one
of the five sages of
Wulgusk. He is 54 years
old. He served as a close
aide to Duke Medaiyu, but
he was the one who
carried out the Exodus.
He has a timid and
worrisome personality, and
is always trembling
nervously.

Mannan Doutton is one
of the five sages of

old. He served as a close

he was the one who
carried out the Exodus.
He has a timid and
worrisome personality, and
is always trembling
nervously.

Meeya Raujin is a singer
who bears the same name
as the legendary first
Meeya, who was once one
of the five sages. She is
20 years old. She enjoys
immense popularity
everywhere, and she sings
and dances her way
toward Yapan.

Miia Lauzin is a singer
who bears the same name
as the first Miia, one of
the Five Sages of legend.
She is 20 years old. She
enjoys tremendous
popularity everywhere,
aiming for Japan while
singing at the 'Ceiling of
Japan' at one time and
dancing along the Siberian
Railway at another.
 During the final battle
against the Overdevil, she
sang before the King
Gainer and sent cheers of
support.

Lubu Won Dara is
Meeya's manager. She is
36 years old. Though
considerably older in age,
she insists she is the
same generation as Meeya.
Having become the manager
because she judged Meeya
would be a source of
money, she is a shrewd
businesswoman who even
pitches Meeya to the
Siberian Railway.

Lubul Wong Dara is
Miia's manager. She is 36
years old. Though
considerably older in age,
she insists she is from
the same generation as
Miia.
 She became the manager
because she judged Miia
would be a source of
money, and she is a
commercially shrewd woman
who even pitched Miia to
the Siberian Railway.
 When they reached the
Riman coast leading to
Japan and Miia ran out
into the sea, she scolded
her not for the act
itself but for getting her
costume wet.

Duke Medaiyu is Ana's
father and the lord of
the domed city Wulgusk.
He is 51 years old.
Because he collects
numerous art pieces and
furnishings in his castle,
he is known as the 'Art
Duke.' The King Gainer
was one of those
collectibles. He has a
gentle disposition, and his
governance was without
issue; he was loved by
his subjects as a person.
When Ana first made
contact after the Exodus,
he showed a father's
kindness by disowning her
in order to avoid the
danger that would
threaten Ana's life, who
had said she intended to
return to Wulgusk.

Medaiyu is Ana's father
and the lord of the
domed city of Wulgusk. He
is 51 years old. Known as
the 'Art Duke' for the
large collection of
artworks and furnishings
he has gathered in his
castle, the King Gainer
was one of those pieces.
He has a gentle
personality, his
administration is without
problems, and he was
beloved by his subjects
as a person. When Ana
made her first contact
after the Exodus and said
she intended to return to
Wulgusk, he showed a
father's kindness by
disowning her to protect
her from danger. When the
battle against the
Overdevil caused the King
Gainer to boil the whole
world, he ran out
shouting that he would
follow Ana in the Exodus.

Kona Madaya is the
mechanic chief who leads
the mechanics of Gauli's
team. She is 27 years
old. Inside the Bach Cron,
which also serves as a
mobile repair plant, she
is in charge of
maintaining machines such
as the Panther and the
King Gainer. She was also
the one who performed
the assembly work on the
Emperanza. She is
small-statured and
baby-faced, and the word
tomboy fits her
perfectly; though she
does not look it, she is
a full decade older than
Gainer and the others.
She seems to have
feelings for Gain, and
because of that she is
often talked around by
him.

She seems to have

Yassaba Jin was the
captain of the Siberian
Railway Guard. He was 32
years old.
 He devoted himself
wholeheartedly to stopping
the Exodus and rooting
out Exodus sympathizers,
and he would stop at
nothing to accomplish
those goals. Yet his
character was more that
of a warrior than a
soldier; he showed a
willingness to admit
defeat with grace, and
occasionally revealed a
gentleness toward those
without power.
 He persistently attacked
the 'Yapan Ceiling,' but
each time he was
thwarted by King Gainer,
suffering defeat after
defeat. Though he was
once taken prisoner, he
escaped by seizing an
opportunity, and during
his flight he encountered
the fortune-telling girl
Eifa. He rescued the girl,
who had been mistreated
by her boss, but in the
ensuing battle he was
defeated once again.
 With his options
exhausted, Yassaba
carried out the Exodus
together with Eifa. But
during their escape they
encountered a Golem, and
he was struck by gunfire,
after which his fate
became unknown.

Yassaba Jin is the
captain of the Siberian
Railway Guard. He is 32
years old. He devotes
himself fully to stopping
the Exodus and rooting
out Exodus sympathizers,
and he will use any means
to accomplish these goals.
However, he is more of a
warrior than a soldier by
nature, and he sometimes
shows a willingness to
accept defeat with grace
and kindness toward those
without power. He
repeatedly assaults the
'Ceiling of Yapan,' but
each time he is thwarted
by the King Gainer and
suffers defeat after
defeat. He was once
taken prisoner but
escaped through a gap in
the watch, and during his
flight he met the
fortune-telling girl Eifa.
He rescued the girl, who
was being mistreated by
her master, but he
suffered yet another
defeat in the battle that
followed. With his options
exhausted, Yassaba
carried out the Exodus
together with Eifa. But
during their escape they
encountered a Golem, and
he was struck by gunfire,
leaving his fate unknown.
Later, however, he was
confirmed to be
continuing the Exodus
with Eifa.

Kejinan Dadd was a
member of the Siberian
Railway Guard. He was 31
years old.
 He had a simple,
easy-to-read
personality: he fawned
over the strong and was
overbearing toward the
weak.
 When his captain Yassaba
lost his Overman, he tried
to have him killed and
take over as captain
himself, and when he
found himself in a
position superior to
Adette, he took advantage
of it to press a marriage
proposal. Regardless of
who he was dealing with,
his actions remained
consistent. In a sense,
one could say he was a
man of unwavering
character to the core.

Kejinan Dad is a member
of the Siberian Railway
Guard. He is 31 years old.
He has a simple
personality: fawning
before the strong and
being oppressive toward
the weak. When his
captain Yassaba lost his
Overman, he tried to have
him killed and claim the
captaincy himself, and
when he saw himself in a
position above Adette, he
used the opportunity to
press a marriage proposal
- his conduct is
consistent no matter who
he deals with. In a sense,
one might say he is a
man of steadfast
character. After Yassaba
vanished and Kashmar
died, he lost his
superiors one after
another and came under
the direct command of
the Kizz. There he
obtained a promise, albeit
verbal, of a promotion of
46 ranks to become Vice
President of the Siberian
Railway. It seemed the
path to advancement had
finally opened, but in the
end he had to settle for
remaining a 'self-styled'
Vice President.

Enge Gam was a member
of the Siberian Railway
Guard. He was 30 years
old.
 With his stern face and
eyepatch, he gave the
impression of a tough,
rugged man, but inwardly
he had a somewhat
pessimistic disposition.
 He subscribed to the
idea of being number two
rather than number one,
and always yielded the
initiative to Kejinan, with
whom he always acted in
concert. However, this
was largely a means of
avoiding responsibility
when trouble arose. And
beneath it all, he
harbored a dark cunning,
ready to discard Kejinan
at any moment if the
need arose.

Enge Gam is a member of
the Siberian Railway
Guard. He is 30 years
old. With his fierce looks
and eyepatch he gives an
impression of toughness,
but inside he has a
somewhat pessimistic
personality. He thinks of
himself as number two
rather than number one,
and he always yields the
initiative to Kejinan, with
whom he acts in concert.
But this is largely to
avoid responsibility when
trouble arises. He also
harbors a dark cunning,
ready to abandon Kejinan
at any moment if the
need arises. It was later
revealed that his
eyepatch was a mere
decoration.

Jaboli Mariera was a
member of the Siberian
Railway Guard. He was 23
years old.
 He was born and raised
in the countryside and
carried a deep inferiority
complex about it. He felt
a strong admiration for
Saint Reigan of London
IMA, which seemed to
embody the city, and
especially for Asuham,
whom he adored and
addressed as 'Lady White
Lily.' Asuham called him
the 'Man of the Wild
Rose,' but in truth it
seemed he was regarded
as little more than a
convenient pawn.
 He handled Silhouette
Machines and Overmen
competently, but since he
had never shot anyone, he
was poor at using
firearms, revealing a side
of him unaccustomed to
violence.

Jaboli Mariera is a
member of the Siberian
Railway Guard. He is 23
years old. He was born
and raised in the
countryside and carries a
strong inferiority complex
about it. He admires Saint
Reigan of London IMA, a
city that represents
urban sophistication, and
especially Asuham, whom
he adored as 'Lady White
Lily.' Asuham called him
the 'Wild Rose,' but in
truth she seems to have
thought of him as nothing
more than a convenient
pawn. He handles
silhouette machines and
Overmen competently, but
he showed a side
unaccustomed to violence,
being poor with firearms
since he had never shot a
person. When he worked
alongside the Kizz, in
contrast to Kejinan who
was carried away by the
promise of promotion, he
lamented their low
standing in the ranks -
among the Siberian
Railway troops, he was
quite a man of
conscience.

Kashmar Bare was the
operations director of
the Siberian Railway. He
was 39 years old.
 He hated nothing more
than having the railway
timetable disrupted, and
his ruthlessness in
maintaining the schedule
at any cost earned him
the nickname 'the Ice
Operations Director.'
 He was dispatched as
captain of the Railway
Guard to fill the gap
left by the vanished
Yassaba, and above all to
stop the Exodus of the
'Yapan Ceiling,' the very
source of the timetable
disruptions.
 He spoke in a feminine
manner, wore purple
lipstick and a mohawk,
and favored psycho
Overmen that sowed
unease or read minds.
Both in appearance and in
substance, he was a
thoroughly unmanly figure.
 Aside from timetable
disruptions, what he
hated most was healthy
relationships between men
and women, and that had
once proven to be his
undoing.

Kashmar Barre is the
operations chief of the
Siberian Railroad. He is 39
years old. He detests any
disruption to the
railroad's timetable above
all else, and his
ruthlessness in
maintaining the schedule
by any means necessary
has earned him the
nickname 'the Ice
Operations Chief.' He was
dispatched as the captain
of the railroad security
force to fill the hole
left by the vanished
Yassaba, and above all to
stop the Exodus of the
'Yapan Ceiling,' the very
source of the timetable
disruptions. He speaks in
an effeminate manner,
wears purple lipstick and
a mohawk, and favors
psycho Overmen that
stoke anxiety or read
minds - both in
appearance and in
substance, he is not a
manly man. Aside from
timetable disruptions,
what he dislikes is
healthy male-female
relationships, and that
once proved to be his
undoing. In the end, he
launched an attack with
an Overman that
projected terror, but
because it touched Gain's
inviolable domain, it
ignited his anger, and he
was blown to death as
the black Southern Cross
baptism struck his back.

Asuham Boone is the
captain of the special
forces unit 'Saint Reigan'
of the London IMA police
organization that governs
Domepolis. His rank is
special lieutenant, and he
is 28 years old. He is an
elite with handsome looks
and high practical ability,
expected to have a bright
future. His refined
demeanor strongly
attracted Jaboli. However,
he actually has a sociable
but easily excitable
personality, and to
achieve his goals he will
calmly resort to
treachery and taking
hostages. He is not
merely a handsome face
but, in a sense, a man
full of human warmth. He
ostensibly uses the
prevention of the Exodus
as his reason, but more
than that, he devotes
himself to capturing
Gainer, repeatedly
launching attacks on the
ceiling of Yapan. The
reason was that Gainer
had previously laid hands
on Asuham's sister Karin
and then left her, so
Asuham was trying to
bring him back. Later, in
order to corner Gainer,
he voluntarily removed
himself from the elite
course and transferred to
the Siberian Railway
Guard.

Asuham Boone is the
captain of the Asuham
Boone special forces unit
of 'St. Reigan,' the police
organization of the
London IMA that
administers Domepolis. His
rank is special lieutenant.
He is 28 years old. He is
an elite with handsome
looks and high practical
ability, expected to have
a bright future. His
refined demeanor strongly
attracted Jaboli. In
truth, however, he has an
impulsive and easily
enraged personality, and
he will calmly commit vile
acts such as betrayal or
taking hostages to
achieve his goals. He is
not merely a handsome
face but, in a sense, a
man full of humanity. He
nominally cites stopping
the Exodus as his reason,
but above all he devotes
himself to capturing Gain,
repeatedly attacking the
Yapan Ceiling. The reason
is that Gain had
previously made advances
on Asuham's sister Karin
and then left her, and
Asuham sought to bring
him back. Later, he
deliberately left the elite
course to corner Gain and
transferred to the
Siberian Railroad security
force. He tried to use
Cynthia and the Kizz
there, but his true goal
was not achieved. Then,
after the battle with the
Overdevil, Karin, who had
reunited with him, told
him she had no intention
of settling down with
Gain, and he was
dumbfounded to learn that
all his efforts had been
in vain.

Zacky Bronco is the
deputy captain of the
Asuham Boone special
forces unit of Saint
Reigan. He is 24 years
old. He possesses ability
befitting his position, and
expertly pilots
Golem-type Overmen. He
obediently follows
Asuham's orders, but
behind the scenes there
was a side of him that
quietly mocked Asuham,
who pursued Gainer with
blatant personal motives.
When heading for the
castle of Kizz Munt, he
was attacked and shot
down by Cynthia's
Dominator, and sank to
the bottom of Lake
Baikal.

Zacky Bronco is the
deputy captain of Asuham
Boone's special forces
unit in St. Reigan. He is
24 years old. He
possesses ability
befitting his position and
handles Golem-type
Overmen with ease. Though
he follows Asuham's
orders obediently, he
privately holds a measure
of contempt for Asuham,
who pursues Gain with
undisguised personal
motives. When they made
for the castle of Kizz
Munt, he was attacked
and shot down by
Cynthia's Dominator,
sinking to the bottom of
Lake Baikal. However, in
the epilogue it was
revealed that he had
actually survived.

Karin Boone is Asuham's
beloved younger sister.
Gainer had previously laid
hands on her, and a child
was conceived at that
time. When she eventually
gave birth to a girl,
Asuham found himself
fighting desperately to
bring Gainer back.

Karin Boone is Asuham's
beloved younger sister.
Gain had previously made
advances on her, and a
