enters battle he coldly
destroys enemies like a
combat machine. In that
state, he prioritizes
defeating the enemy above
all else and does not balk
at accepting some
casualties. This imbalance
sometimes leads him to
hurt others without
realizing it. However,
through his interactions
with Eiji, who is his
complete opposite, he
comes to recognize what
he lacks and begins to
suffer over it.

Pilot of the Gran
Kaiser, and also serves
as the main pilot during
the Unite into God
Gravion, Sol Gravion, and
Ultimate Gravion. 17 years
old. During his childhood
in an orphanage, his
strong G Factor was
recognized, and he was
adopted by Sandman. Since
then, he has undergone
repeated combat training
at Saint-Germain Castle
to become the Gran
Kaiser's pilot. As a
result, his personality
has become quite detached
from the everyday world.
Normally gentle and
personable, once on the
battlefield he fells
enemies with the coldness
of a combat machine. In
this state, he prioritizes
destroying the enemy
above all else and does
not balk at some
casualties. This imbalance
sometimes wounds others
without his being aware
of it. When he revealed
Leele's past, which
everyone had tried to
keep hidden, and shocked
her, he showed a fragile
side, disappearing in a
daze. However, through his
interactions with Eiji, his
exact opposite, he came
to recognize what he
lacked and began to
suffer. Finally, he
realized that the
warrior's path lies not in
fighting to destroy the
enemy, but in fighting to
protect what is precious.
Afterward, his emotions
became richer, and when
he learned that Eina,
thought dead, was alive,
he wept tears of joy.

Eiji Shigure is the pilot
of G Attacker, which
forms the right leg of
God Gravion. He is 17
years old. His surname is
read 'Shigure'. He has an
intense sister complex,
valuing Ayaka, the sister
who raised him since
childhood, above all else.
When she went missing, he
infiltrated St. Germain
Castle alone to search
for her. By chance, he
boarded the G Attacker,
and that became the
catalyst for him becoming
a pilot. His personality is
hot-blooded, and he is a
constant troublemaker,
with ignoring orders and
going out without
permission being routine.
To Touga, he is truly a
bad influence, filling the
naive boy's head with all
sorts of knowledge and
dragging him into reckless
situations. On the other
hand, Eiji has also
boarded the Gran Kaiser
out of rivalry with
Touga. However, he
frequently clashed with
Touga, angered by his
willingness to accept
sacrifices in battle and
his attitude of
disregarding others'
feelings.

Pilot of the G Attacker,
which forms the right leg
of God Gravion, and of
the Geo Mirage, which
forms the chest and head

old. His surname is read
'Shigure.' Since childhood,

When she went missing, he
infiltrated Saint-Germain

During the final battle
against Zeravire, he was

complaint.

Runa Gusuku is the pilot

face harsh battles
without fear. Since
meeting Touga at St.
Germain Castle as a child,

her there, she has
harbored a budding
romantic feelings for him.
As a result, she is
jealous of Eiji, who
appeared later and grew
close to Touga despite
being another boy. This is
one reason the two are
constantly fighting, but
through their repeated
squabbling, it seems she
has also begun to take
some interest in Eiji. She
deeply respects her late
father, and she joined
the Grand Knights to
carry on his will, which
he had reported the
discovery of Zeravire at
the cost of his life.

Pilot of the G Driller,

A pilot of the G

The lord of Saint

commander. However, his
past and true identity

 He possesses his own
unique aesthetic, and is a
flawless individual who
carries out anything he
does in a stylish manner.
He has many fans even
among the maids working
at Saint Germain Castle.

Sandman is the lord of
Saint-Germain Castle and
a world-class tycoon.
With his knowledge and
wealth, he organized
Earthgertz and, as its
supreme commander,
protects the peace of
Earth. However, his past
and background remain

Castle. Yet, because he

Sandman is a false
name; his real name is
'Zig Ehrlichmeyer'. A
scientist from the planet
Lambias, he developed the
Genesis machine 'Gran
Sigma', capable of
destroying or even
creating planets, in order
to save his dying
homeworld. However, a
difference of opinion
brought him into conflict
with his brother-in-law
Hyugi, and as a result,
Lambias collapsed. He
escaped Lambias in the
'Gran Sigma' and
eventually reached Earth.
Over the long years that
followed, he built the
Proto Grandiva, God
Gravion, and other
machines to protect Earth
from his brother-in-law,
who would one day come
seeking revenge. By using
the G Factor within his
body as a metabolic
function, his hair turned
purple, and he became
immortal and ageless.
However, because he
boarded the 'Gran Sigma'
and released his G Factor
in order to fight, he has
reverted to his original
blond hair.

The combat commander of
Earthgertz. He always

permission. He possesses

situation. In an

precise orders to the
Gran Knights and the

Sandman's absence.
Because of this position,

the others go on
vacations or to hot
springs, a fact that

also in charge of training
the Gran Knights, and he
is particularly hard on
Eiji. When the Zeravire
began their full-scale
invasion, he removed his
mask in order to spur on
Sandman, who was cowering
in fear of Hyugi's shadow,
using his own voice and
words.

Raven is the combat
commander of Earthgertz.

behind a mask, which
cannot be removed without
Sandman's permission. He
possesses a strong will,
always maintaining the
composure to correctly
assess situations. When
an emergency occurs, he
gives precise orders to
the Grand Knights and
the combat maid unit. He

trust and becomes the
highest authority in his
absence. Because of this

the Grand Knights is also

removed his mask to
rouse Sandman, who was
cowering in fear of Hugi's
shadow, with his own
voice and words. His true
identity is Eiji's sister,
Ayaka. 'Raven' was the
name of a young man who
served as Sandman's
assistant on the planet
Lambias, and since then,
it has been customary for
those who assist Sandman
to inherit that name.
Before Ayaka, Runa's
father held the mask. The
mask stores the memories
of all previous Ravens,
and inheriting them allows
one to draw out the
necessary abilities. In
addition, it is a product
of terrifying technology
that can change not only
one's body shape but even
their gender.

Faye Xin Lu is the
captain of the G Soldier

absolute obedience, into
Eder, and through it he
controlled her actions
while in the form of Jee.
Eder did not know she
was an artificial human
until her final moments,
and when she learned the
truth, she completely lost
her reason and fell into
a state of rampage.

Dr. Jie is the true
identity of Eder Bernal,
and the man who created
the android Eder Bernal.
He has succeeded in
limited control of the
power of the Origin Law,
and he uses that power
to act on his own
desires. His principle of
action is summed up in
the phrase 'As long as
it's interesting!' and he
enjoys the existence of
the multi-dimensional
world born from the
space-time vibration bomb
more than anyone else. By
applying the power of the
Origin Law, he integrates
the abilities of multiple
selves existing between
parallel worlds, surpassing
ordinary humans in every
respect. Furthermore, he
is liberated from concepts
such as ethics and
morality, and is driven by
desires that others find
difficult to understand,
making his intentions and
actions hard to predict.

The true form of Doctor
Jee, and the man who
created the artificial
human Eder Bernard. The
name Ji Eder Bernard is
also a convenient alias;
his real name exists
separately. He has
succeeded in the limited
control of the power of
origin (Origin Law), and
uses that power to act
as his desires dictate.
His principle of action is
the single phrase, 'If it's
interesting, it's good!'
and he enjoys the
existence of the
multi-dimensional world
born from the temporal
oscillation warheads more
than anyone else. Through
the application of the
power of origin, he
integrates the abilities
of multiple selves
existing between parallel
worlds, surpassing
ordinary humans in every
respect. He is also freed
from concepts such as
ethics and morality, and
is driven by desires that
others find difficult to
understand, making his
intentions and actions
hard to read. The process
by which he unraveled the
power of origin remains
shrouded in mystery.

An elderly scientist who
serves Edel Bernal. His
specialties are mechanical
engineering and
time-space control
technology, and he
develops mobile weapons
for the Chimera. He
always overwhelms those
around him with his high
energy, and he is very
fond of Brigadier General
Edel.

An elderly scientist
serving Eder Bernard. His
specialties are mechanical
engineering and temporal
control technology, and he
develops mobile weapons
for Kaimera. He always
overwhelms those around
him with his high tension,
and he greatly adores
Brigadier General Eder.
His true identity is the
Black Charisma, Ji Eder
Bernard, the creator of
the artificial human Eder
Bernard. For his own
pleasure, Ji Eder
deliberately took the
form of Jee and served
under Eder.

A soldier of the New
Earth Federation military.
He is the captain of
Chimera First Squad, with
the rank of lieutenant.
He fights to reform the
New Earth Federation
military and to establish
order across the
multi-dimensional world. He
is a serious, honest, and
pure young man, but he
has a tendency to be
afraid of women. He and
Lieutenant Schlan of
Chimera Second Squad are
close friends.

A soldier of the New
Earth Federation Forces.
He is the captain of the
Kaimera First Unit under
Eder's direct command,
with the rank of captain.
He is close friends with
Captain Shuran of the
Kaimera Second Unit. He
believes in Eder Bernard's
ideals and fights to
reform the New Earth
Federation Forces and
establish order in the
multi-dimensional world.
During infiltration
operations, he feigns the
persona of a earnest and
pure good young man to
put opponents off guard.
However, his true
personality is hysterical
and self-centered, and he
goes beyond having a
phobia to actually hate
the existence of women.
The sole exception to his
misogyny is Eder, and he
openly declares that he
would give even his life
for her sake.

A soldier of the New
Earth Federation military.
He is the captain of
Chimera Second Squad
under Edel's direct
command, with the rank of
lieutenant. He shows his
true worth in rear-area
missions such as
maintaining public order
and information warfare.
Because he is calm and
composed and never loses
his cool demeanor no
matter the situation, he
sometimes gives others a
cold impression. He and
Raven are close friends.

A soldier of the New
Earth Federation Forces.
He is the captain of the
Kaimera Second Unit under
Eder's direct command,
with the rank of captain.
He demonstrates his true
worth in rear-area
missions such as
maintaining public order
and information warfare.
He enjoys watching
situations fall into chaos
due to his own plans and
openly states this,
showing a malicious side.
His calm composure and
cool demeanor in any
situation give others a
cold impression, but that
is a pose to hide his
inner anxiety. He himself
wishes to live by his
emotions, and for that
reason he both hates and
is strongly drawn to the
impetuous Raven.

A mysterious woman who
cooperates with Asakim.
She pilots the mobile
weapon Eliphas and
appears in various
situations. She always
wears a bewitching smile,
but she has a fierce and
radical personality and
shows no mercy to those
who oppose her.

Tsuine Espio is a
military officer of the
New Earth Federation
Army. As captain of the
Kaiymera Third Platoon
directly under Edel, she
also served as the liaison
between Kaiymera and
Asakim, accompanying him
in his activities. Having
been present at the
detonation of the
time-space oscillation
bomb, she lost her
subordinates in the
resulting displacement and
was condemned to a harsh
life across the
multi-dimensional worlds.
For this reason, she
hated chaos and took
part in Edel's plan to
govern Earth, while also
serving Ji-Edel as a free
existence who could
rescue her from her
trauma. However, she
could not keep up with
his extreme personality
and gradually found
herself drawn to Asakim.

A young man in black
robes, shrouded entirely
in mystery. His purpose is
unknown, but he acts
under an unwavering
conviction. He pilots the
jet-black humanoid mobile
weapon Shurouga,
appearing like a swift
wind.

Asakim Dowen is a young
man who, having committed
a great sin in the past
and being forbidden even
to die, wanders through
various times and spaces
together with Shurouga.
To escape this fate, he
wishes to obtain the
power of the Taikyoku,
and he himself
participates in the
battles among the owners
of the Spheres, which are
fragments of Taikyoku's
will.

An institute that researches every matter
relating to space and UFOs. Its director is Dr.
Genzo Umon, an authority on space science.
 When the Vegan invasion of Earth began, it
became the base for Grendizer and the Spazer,
and stood against the great evil from space.

An institute that researches every matter
relating to space and UFOs. Its director is Dr.
Genzo Umon, an authority on space science.
 When the Vegan invasion of Earth began, it
became the base for Grendizer and the Spazer,
and stood against the great evil from space.

An underground nation ruled by the Reptilian
Humanoids, reptiles that evolved into a humanoid
race. Led by Emperor Gore, who worships the
great demon god Yura, they launched an invasion
to seize the surface world.
 The Reptilian Humanoids once ruled the surface,
but they could not withstand the Getter Rays
that suddenly rained down from space, and were
driven into the magma layers deep underground.
For that reason they were obsessed with
destroying Getter Robo, which draws its power
from Getter Rays.
 In their final operation they sent out the
Invincible Battleship Dai, mightiest of all the
Mechasaurus. But Musashi Tomoe rammed it in a
Command Machine loaded with explosives, and Dai
went out of control. Gore was caught in the
destruction and died, and the Dinosaur Empire was
annihilated.

The military of Planet S-1, also called the
Aldebaron Army.
 Following Gattler, who rebelled against the
emperor and seized control of the nation, they
set out to invade Earth as their new homeland.
Their supreme commander is Rosa Aphrodia.
 They possess technology that lets them pass in
and out of subspace at will, and confounded
Earth's forces with operations that struck from
nowhere.
 Their headquarters is the subspace fortress
Algol, where great numbers of S-1 natives sleep
in cryogenic capsules, awaiting the time of their
awakening.

A layer of distortion lying above the world that
formed when parallel worlds overlapped. Space-time
within the layer is unstable and cannot be
crossed, so passage between space and the
surface is impossible.
 Because this layer exists, a greenhouse effect
has driven surface temperatures up, causing
serious damage.
 The term also refers to the merged world itself,
born from the effects of the space-time
oscillation bomb.

A people of advanced science and technology who
live in domed cities called Points. They supply the
Civilians with Walker Machines and buy up the Blue
Stone they mine.
 Their ancestors were the humans who fled into
space to escape the great upheaval that struck
Earth. When they returned long afterward, what
they found was the ravaged land of Zora - a
world turned so hostile that a few hours in the
open air meant death for them.
 So they created a new race suited to Zora's
environment, the Civilians, as the heirs who would
carry on their civilization. They also succeeded in
building an economy on trade in Blue Stone,
worthless to the Innocent themselves, and in
instilling order through the Three Day Law.
 As the Civilians rose, Kashim King feared the
Innocent would lose their dominion over Zora, and
cracked down on the resistance again and again to
hold them in check. But Jiron and his companions
threw off even that oppression, and at last the
rule of the Innocent was overturned.

The Innocent are humans possessing advanced
science and technology who live in domed cities
called Points. They give Walker Machines to the
Civilians and purchase the Blue Stones they mine.
Their ancestors were humans who fled into space
to escape the great catastrophe that struck
Earth. When they returned after time had passed,
what they saw was the ruined land of Zora. It
had become an infinitely dangerous planet for
them, where exposure to the outside air for even
a few hours meant death. So they created the
new humanity, the Civilians, adapted to Zora's
environment, as successors to carry on their
civilization. They also succeeded in teaching them
economics through trade in Blue Stones, which
were worthless to the Innocent, and order through
the Law of Three Days. Fearing that the rise of
these Civilians would cost the Innocent their
dominance over Zora, Kasim King repeatedly
suppressed them through resistance organizations.
But Jiron and the others, who overcame even that
crisis, finally overturned the Innocent's system of
rule. The Innocent seemed destined for extinction,
but through research they developed technology
that allowed them to live outside the domes as
well. From then on, both peoples came to live
together hand in hand.

The supreme head of the Innocent. His full name
is Arthur Rank, a name handed down through
generations of Innocent leaders.
 He was confined at Point Yop by his aide Kashim
King. Rescued by Jiron and the others, he saw
promise in them and entrusted Zora's future to
them.
 Later, to save Elchi after Kashim's mind was
transplanted into her, he had Kashim's
consciousness transferred into himself instead. It
turned his character violent, but he wrung out
the last of his strength and leapt from the Iron
Gear together with a bomb.

Arthur is the supreme leader of the Innocent.
His full name is Arthur Rank, a name passed down
through generations of Innocent leaders. He was
confined to Yop Point by his aide Kasim King.
When Jiron and the others rescued him, he saw
potential in them and entrusted them with Zora's
future. Later, to save Elchi, who had been
implanted with Kasim's consciousness, he
transferred Kasim's consciousness into himself.
This transformed him into a ferocious personality,
but he summoned his Final Power and leaped from
the Iron Gear with a bomb, dying in the
explosion... or so it seemed, but in the theatrical
version he revived as if nothing had happened
after everything was over, sending his guard into
raptures.

The most powerful figure among the Innocent.
 He clung to the conviction that Zora should be
ruled by the Innocent themselves and not by the
new race. To that end he imprisoned his lord
Arthur and sought to control the Civilians as he
pleased and rule Zora.
 But he met the resistance of the Civilians led
by Jiron and his companions, and died in the
decisive battle at X Point. With that battle the
Innocent lost their dominion over Zora.

The most powerful figure among the Innocent.

A special forces unit of the Earth Federation
Forces, made up of elites born on Earth. Its
current commander is Jamitov Hymem.
 It was established in U.C. 0083 to keep watch on
the Spacenoids, prompted by the colony drop
operation 'Stardust' carried out by remnants of
the Principality of Zeon. In truth, however, it
was formed to oppress the Spacenoids, and would
not stop short of massacring colony residents
with poison gas. Its soldiers grew drunk on that
power, sinking into an arrogance that had them
boasting the Titans stood 'two grades above
ordinary officers and men'.

The Titans are a special forces unit of the
Earth Federation Forces composed of elites from
Earth. The current commander-in-chief is Jamitov
Hyman. They were established in U.C. 0083 for the
purpose of monitoring Spacenoids, following the
Zeon remnant force's colony drop operation
'Stardust'. In reality, however, they were an
organization created to oppress Spacenoids, and
would not hesitate to commit mass murder of
colony residents with poison gas if necessary. The
soldiers belonging to it were intoxicated by their
power, and became steeped in arrogance, boasting
things like 'The Titans outrank regular soldiers by
two grades'. But after repeated conflicts with
the AEUG and Axis, the organization's upper
echelons were annihilated, and it was effectively
dissolved. The war between the AEUG and the
Titans that took place in U.C. 0087 is called the
'Gryps Conflict'.

A military organization formed to oppose the
tyranny of the Titans, centered on Brigadier
General Blex Forer, who is also a member of the
Earth Federation Assembly. Its formal name is the
'Anti Earth Union Government'.
 Supplied with mobile suits by its sponsor Anaheim
Electronics, it resists the Titans' oppression of
the Spacenoids. Many who share its cause have
joined besides career soldiers, but the AEUG is
ultimately an organization within the Earth
Federation Forces. For that reason some hold that
the fighting between them is no more than an
internal military insurrection.
 It keeps a cooperative relationship with Karaba,
the anti-Earth Federation organization on Earth,
and their joint operations dealt heavy blows to
the Titans' ground forces.

The AEUG is a military organization formed
around Major General Blex Forer, who was also a
member of the Earth Federation Congress, to
oppose the tyranny of the Titans. Its official
name is 'Anti Earth Union Government'. Receiving
Mobile Suit supplies from its sponsor, Anaheim
Electronics, it resisted the Titans who oppressed
Spacenoids. Many people other than soldiers
participated, sharing the same ideals, but the
AEUG was, after all, an organization within the
Earth Federation Forces. For this reason, some
viewed the conflict between the two as nothing
more than an internal rebellion within the
military. It held a cooperative relationship with
the Earth-based anti-Federation organization
Karaba, and joint operations by the two dealt
heavy blows to the Titans' ground forces. After
Blex was assassinated, Quattro Bageena, otherwise
known as Char Aznable, rose as their leader and
exposed the Titans' misdeeds at the Dakar
Federation Congress.

A support organization for the AEUG on Earth,
formed by Hayato Kobayashi. Its flagship is the
Garuda-class large transport aircraft 'Audhumla'.
 Moving in step with the AEUG, it fought the
Titans alongside them from North America through
to East Asia.
 Amuro Ray, a hero of the One Year War, later
joined, and the group went on to build up its
strength further, even developing the Dijeh on its
own.

 Amuro Ray, a hero of the One Year War, later

A colony cluster in the L2 region on the far
side of the Moon, also known as Munzo. It is the
Side farthest from Earth, the place where Zeon
Zum Deikun, who advocated Contolism, once lived,
and the stronghold of the Principality of Zeon
during the One Year War.
 With its ruling Zabi family wiped out to the last
in the One Year War, the Principality of Zeon has
since been reborn as the Republic of Zeon. In the
Gryps Conflict, however, it has been forced into
cooperating with the Titans.

The doctrine that by moving the foundations of
their lives into space, humankind can attain the
'Newtype' - a new innovation of the species
adapted to space.
 Advocated by Zeon Zum Deikun, this thinking
spread widely among the Spacenoids who resented
the Earth Federation government. Zeon then had
Side 3 declare independence as the Republic of
Zeon in order to put Contolism into practice.
 But as it merged with 'Elezm', which held that
humans should live in space and revere Earth as a
holy land, and with 'Sidezm', which held that
colonies should be recognized as nations Side by
Side, it drew still greater resentment from the
Earthnoids living on Earth. The pressure on the
Spacenoids grew harsher as a result, and the two
came to stand on the brink of open conflict.
 Even so, Zeon sought a settlement through
dialogue with the Federation government - only to
die with his work half done. After his death the
Zabi family twisted Contolism into the claim that
'the Spacenoids are the chosen people', renamed it
'Zeonism', and used it in the One Year War that
broke out against the Earth Federation.

The politician who advocated Contolism - that
humankind should advance into space - and who
led the Spacenoids. He later had Side 3 declare
independence as the Republic of Zeon. He is also
the father of Char Aznable, known as Quattro
Bajeena.
 He foresaw the birth of the 'Newtype', humans
adapted to the space environment, and kept up
patient negotiations with the Earth Federation to
protect Earth's environment and realize that
innovation. But those around him grew impatient
with the high-handed attitude of the Earth
Federation government, and came to believe the
Spacenoids' long-held wish should be made known
to the world by force.
 It was then that Zeon died suddenly, and his
hardline aide Degin Sodo Zabi became his
successor. Degin turned the Republic into the
Principality of Zeon and declared war on the
Earth Federation, placing his kin in the military's
key posts. From this, the prevailing theory is
that Zeon's death was an assassination by the
Zabi family.

The armed forces held by the Inglessa and
Borjarno territories. They are called by the name
of the territory they belong to, as in the
'Inglessa Militia'.
 Until direct negotiations with the Moonrace
began, they possessed only weapons that recalled
the age of the Industrial Revolution, such as
biplanes and cannon. But ever since the Turn A
Gundam emerged from the White Doll, they have
unearthed mobile suits one after another from the
Mountain Cycles and strengthened their armament.

Ghingnham is a dome city on the Moon that
serves as the capital of the Moonrace's living
sphere. It was built by the Ghingnham family, who
continue to serve as the city's guardians.
 The palace of Queen Dianna Soreil, the 'White
Palace,' and the 'Winter Palace,' a facility for
the cryogenic hibernation of countless citizens,
are also located here.

Gendarme is a dome city on the lunar surface,
serving as the capital of the Moonrace's living
sphere. The Ghingnham family built it and also
serves as its guardian. The White Palace, the
castle of Queen Dianna Soreil, and the Winter
Palace, an artificial hibernation facility where
many citizens sleep, are also located here. In
addition, records of the Dark History remain
beneath the Winter Palace, and it was here that
the threat of civilization's collapse by the M-Fly
was made clear.

An autonomous city in the northern part of the
North American continent, governed by Mayor
Nomoa Long. It is protected by a civilian defense
force centered on Carris Nautilus, an artificial
Newtype created by Nomoa.
 In truth, Nomoa was Dr. Dorat of the Space
Revolutionary Army in disguise, and Fort Severn
was built as a cover to restore the giant
Newtype-exclusive mobile armor Patulia, in order
to complete 'Operation Lilac,' a plan that had
been foiled by the Federation forces during the
Seventh Space War. Nomoa activated Patulia with
Carris as its pilot, but his ambitions were
destroyed along with him thanks to Freeden's
efforts and Carris's resolve.
 Afterward, the city was rebuilt around Carris
and given a fresh start as a truly autonomous
city.
 Incidentally, a real city of the same name exists
in Canada.

A term for human beings born naturally, without
genetic adjustment. The designation came into use
after the emergence of Coordinators, humans
whose genes had been adjusted.
 Many Naturals feel jealousy or hostility toward
Coordinators, who possess superior abilities. At
the same time, no small number of Coordinators
look down on Naturals, flaunting their gifts. As a
result, some Naturals openly advocate opposition
to Coordinators, the foremost of whom are Blue
Cosmos.

 Many Naturals feel jealousy or hostility toward

the same time, no small number of Coordinators
look down on Naturals, flaunting their gifts. As a
result, some Naturals openly advocate opposition
to Coordinators, the foremost of whom are Blue
Cosmos.

A general term for human beings whose genes
were adjusted at the fertilized egg stage to
grant them heightened intelligence and a robust
body. Their existence became known to the world
in C.E. 15, when George Glenn, the First
Coordinator, made a worldwide confession
broadcast.
 Coordinators are born with many superior traits,
both physical and mental. However, whether or not
those abilities blossom depends heavily on the
environment in which they are raised.
 Most Coordinators live on the PLANTs, though
there are exceptional places, such as the neutral
nation of Orb or lunar cities, where they coexist
with Naturals (ordinary humans who have not
undergone genetic adjustment).
 Those born to Natural parents through genetic
adjustment are called 'First-Generation
Coordinators,' while children born between two
Coordinators are called 'Second-Generation
Coordinators.' However, the birth rate has been
declining year by year, and this has become a
major social problem.

A general term for human beings whose genes
were adjusted at the fertilized egg stage to
grant them heightened intelligence and a robust
body. Their existence became known to the world
in C.E. 15, when George Glenn, the First
Coordinator, made a worldwide confession
broadcast.
 Coordinators are born with many superior traits,
both physical and mental. However, whether or not
those abilities blossom depends heavily on the
environment in which they are raised.
 Most Coordinators live on the PLANTs, though
there are exceptional places, such as the neutral
nation of Orb or lunar cities, where they coexist
with Naturals (ordinary humans who have not
undergone genetic adjustment).
 Those born to Natural parents through genetic
adjustment are called 'First-Generation
Coordinators,' while children born between two
Coordinators are called 'Second-Generation
Coordinators.' However, the birth rate has been
declining year by year, and this has become a
major social problem.

A political organization known for its extremism.
All of its members are Naturals, and under the
slogan "For a Pure and Blue World," it seeks the
eradication of Coordinators. Even among Naturals
who have not joined Blue Cosmos, many regard
Coordinators with suspicion - a result of the
organization's manipulation of public opinion.
 However, the political front is only a facade.
Behind the scenes, Blue Cosmos hides its true
nature as a secret society acting as the hands
and feet of LOGOS in pursuit of the total
eradication of Coordinators. This is possible
because its members have infiltrated deep into
the core of the Earth Alliance and the Earth
Alliance Forces.
 After its leader Muruta Azrael died in the
Second Battle of Jachin Due in C.E. 71, the
organization kept a low profile for a time. But
once Lord Djibril took over as its new leader, it
once again began manipulating public opinion
through the Atlantic Federation and the media,
working to drag the Earth Alliance and the PLANTs
back into war.

A military-industrial complex said to have
existed since the dawn of recorded history,
wielding powerful influence over politics. It is
made up of merchants of death who have secretly
manipulated wars and postwar reconstruction alike
to reap enormous profits.
 LOGOS is the backer of Blue Cosmos and has
guided public opinion to provoke war between the
Earth Alliance and the Coordinators. Both Muruta
Azrael, Blue Cosmos's former leader, and Lord
Djibril, its current leader, are members of LOGOS.
For LOGOS, the true goal is to keep profiting by
continuing the war; the fact that Blue Cosmos
champions the eradication of Coordinators owes
much to the personal feelings of these two men.
 Since it possesses no military force of its own,
LOGOS moved the Earth Alliance Forces to attempt
to annihilate the Coordinators during the previous
war. After the war, it organized Phantom Pain to
wield power more directly.

A military-industrial complex said to have
existed since the dawn of history, holding strong
power to intervene in politics. It is composed of
merchants of death who have manipulated war and
reconstruction from behind the scenes and amassed
enormous profits.
 It is the support base of Blue Cosmos, and it
guided public opinion to provoke wars between the
Earth Alliance and Coordinators. Muruta Azrael,

Djibril, the current leader, are also members of
LOGOS. For LOGOS, the goal is to continue war
and pursue profit; the fact that Blue Cosmos
advocates the extermination of Coordinators is
largely due to the personal feelings of these two
men.
 Because they possess no military strength of
their own, in the previous war they attempted to
annihilate Coordinators by moving the Earth
Alliance Forces. And after the war, they organized
Phantom Pain to exercise power more directly.
 Later, because their existence and deeds were
exposed by Durandal, most of their members were
arrested or died from lynchings due to riots of
angry citizens. Djibril, who survived to the very
end, had his trump card, Requiem, taken away, and
was shot down along with his fleeing ship.

A term referring to the new generation of space
colonies inhabited by Coordinators, their collective
grouping, and the Coordinator nation itself. The
name is an abbreviation for 'Production Location
Ally on Nexus Technology,' and it doubles as a
reference to a 'large-scale production base.'
 As a nation, the PLANTs are administered by the
PLANT Supreme Council. In the past, the Earth
Alliance sought to prevent the PLANTs' autonomy
and independence by imposing heavy taxes and
pressure on them, which became one of the
triggers of the previous war.
 As a residential zone, the PLANTs are
concentrated at L5, one of the Lagrange points
where Earth's and the Moon's gravity balance.

The highest authority of the PLANT Supreme
Council, the PLANTs' foremost decision-making
body. Since the signing of the Junius Treaty,
Gilbert Durandal has held the post.
 Patrick Zala once held this post concurrently
with that of Chairman of National Defense, and it
was his hatred and madness that dragged the war
into a quagmire. In reflection of that, holding
both posts simultaneously is forbidden today.

A special unit of ZAFT, its name an abbreviation
for 'Fast Acting Integrated Tactical
Headquarters.'
 Only those whose character and combat record
are recognized as truly exceptional are admitted,
with the approval of both the Chairman of
National Defense and the Chairman of the PLANT
Council. Members are given a silver badge as proof
of their status, and its bearers always command
the respect and envy of those around them.
 Despite being called a special unit, its members
do not belong to any single unit; they are
permitted to act and give orders based on their
own judgment. Their authority is considerable,
extending even to giving orders to field
commanders.

The PLANTs' military organization, its name an
abbreviation for 'Zodiac Alliance of Freedom
Treaty.'
 Its roots lie in a political society formed
chiefly by Siegel Clyne and Patrick Zala, and it is
made up of volunteer soldiers drawn from the
Coordinator populace. All members are trained to
fight on land, at sea, and in the air without
distinction, and the most outstanding soldiers are
granted the uniform known as the 'Red Coat.'
 ZAFT has no ranks like those of a conventional
military; instead, units are named directly after
their commanders. Supreme command authority rests
with the Chairman of National Defense of the
PLANT Council.

A military PLANT held by ZAFT in the L4 region.
 It was developing the 'Second Stage' mobile

A military PLANT that ZAFT maintains in the L4

 It was developing the 'Second Stage' mobile

 However, on the day of the Minerva's launch

The capital of the PLANTs, located in the L5

The capital of PLANT, located in the L5 sphere.
 At the end of the war, it was made the target
of the large strategic beam cannon 'Requiem' by
the madness-consumed Djibril. However, thanks to
the efforts of the Joule team, the line of fire
was deflected and it avoided annihilation.
Nevertheless, the surrounding PLANTs suffered
severe damage.

An international body established primarily by
nations opposed to the PLANTs and by former
PLANT-affiliated member states.
 After the previous war ended, under the
leadership of the Atlantic Federation - its
strongest military power - the Earth Alliance
used the Earth Alliance Forces to militarily annex
pro-PLANT nations one after another. Only a
handful of nations, such as the Orb Union and the
Kingdom of Scandinavia, remained unaffiliated and
neutral.
 Triggered by 'Break the World,' the incident in
which Coordinators caused Junius Seven to fall to
Earth, the Earth Alliance once again marched down
the road to war with the PLANTs. Behind the
scenes, it appears Blue Cosmos and LOGOS were
involved.

The Orb Union. A small nation in the Pacific
Ocean made up of several islands.
 It is a rare place where Naturals and
Coordinators coexist peacefully, and it has
declared a neutral stance, siding with neither the
Earth Alliance nor ZAFT. It is home to the
state-run Morgenroete Inc.
 Orb declared neutrality during the previous war
as well, but its land was scorched by war when
the Earth Alliance invaded. Though its
infrastructure has since been rebuilt, the loss of
many talented people as a result of the war
remains a headache for its current chief
representative, Cagalli Yula Athha.
 Despite her title, the young Cagalli finds it
difficult to seize the initiative, and within the
government the ambitions of the Five Great Clans
that guide the nation are in constant conflict.
Chief among them is Unato, head of the Seiran
family and serving as prime minister, whose lust
for power drives him to scheme to marry his son
Yuna to Cagalli in order to seize control of the
nation's government.

The United Emirates of Orb. A small nation
located in the Pacific Ocean, composed of several
islands.
 It is a rare place where Naturals and
Coordinators coexist peacefully, and it declares a
stance of neutrality, aligning with neither the
Alliance nor ZAFT. It maintains Morgenroete, Inc.
as a public enterprise.
 It also declared neutrality in the previous war,
but its homeland was scorched by war due to the
Earth Alliance's invasion. Although its means of
living were rebuilt after the war, the fact that a
large number of skilled people left due to the
war's effects is a headache for the current
representative head of state, Cagalli Yula Athha.
 Even so, it is difficult for the young Cagalli to
seize the initiative, and the schemes of the five
great families that lead the nation are in
disarray within. In particular, the head of the
Seiran family, the chancellor Unato, is strongly
power-hungry, and plots to have his son Yuna
marry Cagalli to control the government as he
pleases. Furthermore, he conspired with LOGOS,
abandoned the ideal of neutrality, and concluded
an alliance with the Earth Alliance.
 But that honeymoon was also brought to an end
by Cagalli, who returned with the Archangel, and
Orb returned once again to its former neutral
state.

Uzumi Nara Athha. The chief representative of
Orb two generations before the present, and
adoptive father of the current chief
representative, Cagalli Yula Athha.
 A shrewd and capable politician known as the
'Lion of Orb' for his resolute manner and
uncompromising integrity.
 During the previous war, he tried to maintain
neutrality, submitting to neither the Earth
Alliance nor ZAFT. But the Earth Alliance launched
an invasion to annex Orb and seize its mass
driver.
 Though he resisted to the very end, the tide of
battle turned decisively against him. Entrusting
the future to Cagalli and the Archangel, he
evacuated the citizens and then destroyed both
the mass driver and Morgenroete Inc. by his own
hand, sharing the fate of his burning nation.

A state-run company of the Orb Union with a

the variable-type mass-production mobile suit that
serves as the mainstay of Orb's forces.
 It also has deep ties to the Archangel, which it
once helped develop, and it secretly carries out
the ship's refits and resupply.

A term for the fighting during the previous war
that began with the Earth Alliance's invasion of
Orb.
 Seeking to seize the 'Kaguya,' the mass driver
(a large-scale mass-projection device) essential
for contesting ZAFT's control of space, the Earth
Alliance deployed its new 'GAT-X' series mobile
suits. Orb's forces met them with the secretly
developed mass-production mobile suit 'M1 Astray,'
but were ultimately forced into defeat by
overwhelming numbers.
 The Archangel, having broken away from the
military, also joined the defense, but was forced
to withdraw from the battle line after Uzumi
entrusted it with the world's future.
 This two-day battle came to an end when Uzumi
vanished into the flames along with a key
facility.

A term for the battle fought in the final stage
of the previous war, in the region of Jachin Due,
ZAFT's space fortress. Many officers and soldiers
on both sides, including Mwu La Flaga, Muruta
Azrael, and Patrick Zala, were killed or went
missing.
 In this battle, the 'GENESIS,' ZAFT's ultimate
weapon - an enormous gamma-ray laser cannon -
was fired twice, and the Earth Alliance Forces
lost more than 40 percent of their space fleet
along with the Ptolemaeus base on the Moon.
 The First Battle of Jachin Due, meanwhile, refers
to the fighting that broke out between the Earth
Alliance Forces and ZAFT immediately after the
outbreak of war, when the Alliance attempted to
strike the PLANT homeland. This battle was the
catalyst for converting Jachin Due, then still only
a resource satellite, into a space fortress.

Rau Le Creuset. A capable ZAFT commander. In
truth he was a Natural, but he concealed this
fact when he enlisted with ZAFT.
 He was born as a clone of Al Da Flaga, Mwu's
father, but because his telomeres, which govern
lifespan, were shorter than those of an ordinary
person, he was treated as a defective product.
 Learning this truth, he came to hate the very
world that had produced a being like himself. He
eventually leaked operational details and handed
over military secrets in an attempt to bring
about the mutual destruction of both ZAFT and
the Alliance. As a result, his scheme had very
nearly succeeded by the time of the Second
Battle of Jachin Due. However, he was defeated in
battle against the Freedom, and vanished cursing
the world into the light of the runaway GENESIS.
 Perhaps because of a special drug he took
regularly to slow his aging, he was occasionally
seen suffering from side effects. It is thought
that he always hid his face behind a mask to
conceal features aged beyond his years, along
with the dark ambition he kept hidden within.

Rau Le Creuset. An excellent military officer who
serves as a commander in ZAFT. In truth, he is a
Natural, but he concealed this fact and enlisted
in ZAFT. He was born as a clone of Mu's father,
Al Da Flaga, but because the telomeres that
govern lifespan were shorter than normal, he was
treated as a defective product. Upon learning of
this fact, he came to despise the world itself
that had produced a being like himself. Eventually,
in order to bring both ZAFT and the Alliance to
mutual destruction, he leaked operation plans and
transferred military secrets. As a result, his
schemes had reached the brink of success by the
time of the Second Battle of Yakin Due. However,
he was defeated in battle against the Freedom,
and, cursing the world, vanished into the light of
the runaway Genesis. Because he regularly used a
special drug that slowed aging, he was
occasionally seen suffering from side effects. It
is thought that he always hid his face behind a
mask in order to conceal a face that had aged
beyond his years, along with his hidden dark
ambitions. He came to know Ray Za Burrel, who
was also a clone of Al Da Flaga, through his old
friend Durandal, and took it upon himself to act
as Ray's guardian.

A wartime treaty concluded between the Earth
Alliance and the PLANTs on March 10, C.E. 72, the
year after the previous war ended. It takes its
name from the fact that it was signed at Junius
Seven, where the scars of the previous war still
ran deep.
 Its main purpose was to limit armaments,
establishing an upper limit on the number of
mobile suits each side could hold and banning the
use of Neutron Jammer Cancellers.
 It also included provisions for restoring national
borders, and nations such as the Orb Union, which
had been annexed by the Earth Alliance during the
war, regained their independence.

A wartime treaty concluded between the Earth
Alliance and PLANT on March 10, C.E. 72, the year
after the previous war ended. It was signed at
Junius Seven, where the scars of the previous war
remained deep, and so it received this name. Its
main purpose was the limitation of armaments,
establishing caps on the number of mobile suits
possessed and prohibiting the use of Neutron
Jammer Cancellers. It also included the restoration
of border lines, and nations that had been
annexed by the Earth Alliance during the war,
such as the Orb Union of Chiefdoms, recovered
their independence. However, since each faction
was secretly developing weapons that violated the
treaty, it could be said that, at least in military
terms, it had become a dead letter.

Enhanced humans developed by the Earth Alliance
under Blue Cosmos's direction. They were deployed
on the mission to seize the 'Second Stage Series'
at Armory One.
 They resolved the emotional instability that
plagued the earlier generation of enhanced humans,
the 'Biological CPUs,' successfully retaining the
ability to fight Coordinators on equal or superior
terms while also gaining enough cooperative
capacity to work as a team.
 However, if an Extended hears the Block Word
set as a safety measure, they fall into an
extremely unstable mental state.
 Additionally, maintenance using an adjustment
device called a 'cradle' is essential for them
after combat.

Enhanced humans developed by the Alliance under
the leadership of Blue Cosmos. They were deployed
on the mission to seize the 'Second Stage Series'
at Armory One. They improved upon the problems
of the earlier enhanced humans, the 'Biological
CPUs,' who had been emotionally unstable, and
succeeded in maintaining abilities capable of
fighting on par with or above Coordinators while
also granting them enough coordination to operate
as a team. However, if they hear a block word
set as a safety device, they fall into an
extremely unstable mental state. Furthermore,
after combat, maintenance using an adjustment
machine called the 'Cradle' is indispensable. The
'Cradle' also possesses a memory adjustment
function, and it was used to erase the memories
of Stella, who had become MIA, from the other
two.

A mental restraint imposed on the Extended, the
enhanced humans developed by the Earth Alliance.
 Though the Extended are more mentally stable
than earlier generations of enhanced humans,
hearing the assigned word instantly throws them
into confusion and robs them of the ability to
act calmly. Although it was set as a kind of
safety mechanism, it carries numerous problems,
including the risk of an Extended going berserk
simply by speaking the word themselves.

The fossil of a gigantic creature with a bizarre
shape that can only be described as "a whale
with wings."
 It was discovered by George Glenn, the First
Coordinator, in a meteorite near Europa during a
visit to Jupiter, and it is currently kept in the
PLANT homeland.
 It is said to be evidence of extraterrestrial
life, but no new evidence has been found to
support this theory.

Leaving one's current Domepolis to escape to a
region with a milder climate.
 In the story, humanity is forced to live in
Domepolis, a collection of city units set up in
harsh environments, ostensibly to protect the
environment. But many of the People (as
Domepolis citizens are called) sense that this is
merely a pretext used by the Siberian Railway,
which holds a monopoly on the procurement of
supplies, to pursue its own profit. As a result,
People who dream of living somewhere better and
carry out an Exodus are never in short supply.
 However, Exodus is banned by the Siberian
Railway and is treated as a serious crime that
can be punished by death in the worst cases.
Because of this, there exists a profession known
as Exodus contractors, who smuggle people past
the eyes of the Siberian Railway Security Force
to their destination.

The sole transportation network across the land
of Siberia. It is managed and operated by the
Siberian Railway Corporation (commonly known as
the Sibetetsu), headed by President Kizz Munt.
Its headquarters are located in Liman Megalopolis.
 Because it supplies the resources, food, and
other lifelines that the Dome Polises along its

effect, the ruler of the Dome Polises.
 Under its umbrella is the infamous armed
organization known as the Siberian Railway
Security Force. It also maintains close ties with
the international monitoring body known as 'London
IMA.'

 At the start of the story, Gainer achieves 200

Rock formations that rise up in scab-like
(scub) layers. They were given this name
because their colorful appearance resembles coral.
They are sometimes simply called Scub.
 Because they can occur anywhere, human
settlements drive massive stakes called 'pile
bunkers' deep into the ground to prevent the
formations from rising.
 Buried beneath the Scub Coral are the archetypes
of LFOs and KLFs. Because of this, many
excavators are said to keep digging deep

colorful appearance resembles coral, and so it
received this name. It is also simply called 'Scub.'
Because it occurs in all sorts of places, in human
living areas, giant piles called 'Pile Bunkers' are
driven deep into the earth to prevent uplifting.
Beneath the scab, archetypes of LFOs and KLFs
are buried. For this reason, many excavators
continue to dig deep underground. Eventually, Dr.
Bear puts forth the hypothesis that the Scub
Coral is a sentient being, and this turns out to
be true. And what the Scub Coral sent as a
messenger to humanity was the humanoid Coralian,
which was the hope for humanity and the Scub
Coral to coexist.

An abbreviation for 'Transparent Light Particle.'
Trapar refers to mysterious, invisible particles
that erupt from Scub Coral and drift through the
air. Sky Fish, creatures of unknown origin, gather
at points where Trapar is dense.
 Trapar is used as an energy source in power
plants and has already become indispensable to
people's lives. Lift boards are able to fly by
reflecting these particles.
 But Trapar is not merely convenient; it can
also turn against humanity. In the past, a
phenomenon known as the Summer of Love, in which
Trapar erupted abnormally, drove the world to the
brink of destruction. It was the hero Adroc
Thurston who saved the world from that crisis.

A sport in which riders use a lift board fitted
with a wheel to ride the waves of Trapar drifting
through the air. It is not limited to humans -
even LFOs and KLFs can Ref if they use a
suitably large lift board.
 Its defining feature is the ability to pull off
three-dimensional tricks unlike anything possible
on a skateboard or surfboard. Many are captivated
by the green trails drawn across the sky, and
Ref is quite a major pastime within the world of
the story. Those who Ref are called lift boarders.
 Incidentally, a lift board is able to fly because
a reflection film that reflects Trapar is attached
to its underside.

A special forces unit of the Tower State
Federation Forces. It officially operates the
blue-painted Terminus type R505. Holland, Eureka,
Charles, and Ray all once served in its ranks.
 SOF was also involved in the massacre of
Vodarac believers at their holy site, an incident
that became the catalyst for Holland's desertion
from the military.

Eureka, and Charles and Ray were all members at

A religion whose teachings center on living in
harmony with the Scub Coral.
 Because of terrorism carried out by some of its
more radical members, the Tower State Federation
marks it as an anti-government organization. The
general public's view is not far off, either;
anyone found to be a believer is instantly
regarded with suspicion.
 Ciudad del Cielo, the faith's holy site, was once
a beautiful town celebrated as a city in the sky.
But it was utterly destroyed in the SOF massacre,
and today lies in ruins.

battle, but the incident ultimately strengthened

An abbreviation for 'Universal Network.'
 It is commonly pronounced 'U.N.'
 An information network established by the New
Earth Federation with the aim of centralizing and
sharing information across the many parallel
worlds.
 Anyone with a terminal can browse or post
information. In major metropolitan areas, it is not
unusual for a connection to reach every
household, but the further one gets from urban
centers, the lower the rate of adoption becomes.
 It serves as both a valuable source of
information for citizens and an entertainment
medium, making it an extremely important piece of
infrastructure across the many parallel worlds.

Federation Forces' lunar garrison.

testing and shakedown of new-model units, and its
members possess exceptional piloting skills.
 Its current mission is testing next-generation
standard-issue production units and their onboard
armaments, as well as researching applied combat
tactics.

A super robot developed by the Beal aliens to
fight the Gaizock.
 Three mechs - Zambird, forming the head and
chest; Zambull, forming the arms and abdomen;
and Zambase, forming the waist and legs - combine
into a giant robot embodying justice and mystery
with the call, "Zambot Combination In!"
 Combining activates its ion engine, generating
power truly worthy of the name 'Invincible
Superman.' Its main weapons include the 'Zambot
Grap,' a trident blade extending from its arms, the
cross-shaped shuriken 'Zambot Buster' on its knees,
and the 'Buster Missile,' fired from that same
shuriken's spikes. Its ultimate finishing move, the
'Zambot Moon Attack,' fires a crescent-shaped
energy bolt from the horn on its head, and it has
several different signature poses for using it.

energy bullet from the horns on its head, and
several different poses are used when performing
it. In the final battle, Zambull and ZamBase were
destroyed without a trace due to a suicidal charge.
Such a depiction of the main mecha was the first
in the history of robot anime.

A Drifand used by Emaan. It can be equipped with
the same type of Missile Gun and missile pack used
on the Orguss, and it saw extensive use in
Manisha's unit as well.
 Emaan devices are fitted with an Inertial Control
System capable of negating the mass of matter.
This eliminates the effects of gravity, allowing for
easy rapid acceleration, sudden stops, and sharp
turns, while also reducing the G-forces exerted on
the pilot to almost nothing. Thanks to this benefit,
the machine can operate under nearly any
conditions, so long as air resistance is taken into
account.
 As various manipulators were developed to improve
work efficiency and combat capability, this
eventually led to the arms it carries today. This
is why it is called a Drifand, short for 'Drift
Hand.'

The most advanced large Walker Machine created by
the Innocent. After losing the Xabungle, Jiron
seized this unit and operated it aboard the Iron
Gear from then on.
 While matching the Xabungle in mobility, it is
improved across the board in maneuverability, armor,
and firepower. The combination mechanism that was
the Xabungle's greatest weak point has been
greatly simplified in this unit, resulting in an
all-around machine with excellent maintainability as
well.
 Its firepower is high, thanks to dedicated weapons
such as the Boomerang Idiom and a five-tube rocket
launcher, along with a Bazooka wrested away from
the female warrior Tron. It also possesses powerful
hover capability, allowing for standalone flight,
though not with complete freedom of movement.

A mass-production mobile suit developed by
Anaheim Electronics for the AEUG.
 Developed as an evolution of the GM II,
improvements to overall performance and the use of
Gundarium gamma armor give it combat capability
equal to or exceeding the Marasai. Production
efficiency is improved by reusing the Rick Dias's
beam saber and the GM II's beam rifle.
 With no specialized equipment, it is easy for
ordinary soldiers to handle, and as the AEUG's main
mass-production unit, it supported the AEUG and
Karaba through the end of the Gryps Conflict.

 The fact that it drove Kamille's Gundam Mk-II to

Titans.
 Large jet engines on the shoulders and waist allow
it to fly independently within an atmosphere. To
reduce air resistance during flight, all of its
armaments, including beam sabers and mega particle
cannons, are built into its arms.
 Swapping its thrusters allows for further
increased acceleration and operation in space.

The third mobile suit developed by Scirocco aboard
the Jupitris.
 Designed for search and reconnaissance, its

 Its combat ability is by no means low either;
numerous vernier thrusters throughout its body give
it mobility greater than its appearance suggests.
Its armaments are distinctive as well, including a
beam tomahawk and a shield that can also function
as a beam gun.

A large mobile suit developed by Scirocco aboard
the Jupitris.
 Its frame is equipped with reaction attitude

excellent responsiveness. Despite the sluggish
impression its appearance gives, it possesses
top-class mobility and maneuverability.
 Its armaments are equally formidable, including a
large beam rifle uniquely modified by Scirocco
himself, and hip-mounted sub-manipulators (Arms)
that wield beam sabers. It can rightly be called
one of the strongest mobile suits of the Gryps
Conflict.

A mobile suit that emerged from the White Doll,
an object enshrined at the foot of Mountain Cycle
in the Inglessa territory of Vicinity.
 At first it had almost no armaments, fighting in
melee with its bare hands or a beam saber. Later,
a rifle, shield, hammer, and other equipment were
excavated, and equipping these steadily improved its
combat power.
 It operates via the I Field Beam Drive (IFBD),
which spreads an internally generated I Field across
the airframe's surface and controls the machine by
manipulating it. Since it carries no generator, its
internal structure has ample room to spare, and the
Multi-Purpose Silo (a general-purpose weapons
cache) installed in its chest can be loaded with a
variety of armaments as needed. Loran in fact used
it to carry all manner of things, from nuclear
missiles to cattle.
 Its nanomachine-coated armor has self-repair
capability, and given enough time it can even
regenerate missing parts.
 The Moonlight Butterfly (M-Fly) system,
arguably Turn A Gundam's greatest feature,
scatters nanomachines carried on an I Field, and is
said to have destroyed the scientific civilization
of the previous century.
 The cockpit in the waist can separate and
transform into the Core Fighter. It has almost no
combat power of its own, but it is an indispensable
part for properly using the Moonlight Butterfly
system.
 Only a few characters in the story call it
"Gundam" - Loran and most others instead call it
the 'White Doll' or the 'White Mustache.'

color, a large Minchi Drill diverted from an Eagail,
a Wodom's severed arm rigged to fire as a Rocket
Punch, and finally a set of horn ornaments added
to its head.

A mobile suit developed by the former Federation
Forces during the Seventh Space War.
 With its Flash System, capable of controlling bit
mobile suits, and its Satellite Cannon, powerful
enough to destroy a colony, it becomes the
strongest weapon of all in the hands of a Newtype
pilot.
 The unit piloted by Garrod is one of several
produced. Unlike the Gundam Airmaster and Gundam
Leopard developed around the same time, it requires
a G Controller - doubling as both the right control
lever and the Satellite Cannon's firing trigger - to
be attached before it can be activated.

A machine reinforced and modified by Kid, using
"some amazing parts he'd kept in reserve," to
compensate for the firepower shortfall of the
Gundam X after its Satellite Cannon was destroyed
in the battle with the Vertigo.
 Though it has lost the Satellite Cannon, equipping
the Divider for which it is named allows it to
maintain stable performance even without the moon
in the sky.
 The Divider, also known as the Harmonica Cannon,
combines the functions of a multi-barrel beam
cannon, a deployable shield, and propulsion verniers.
It is a versatile weapon that provides a range of
benefits, from offense and defense to improved
mobility.

A machine that was actually reinforced and
modified after Kid, upon seeing the Gundam Leopard
heavily damaged in battle with the New Federation
Forces, declared, "A full overhaul would be faster
than fixing it."
 The machine's color was changed from green to a
red-based scheme, further boosting its already high
firepower.
 Many of its originally solid-round-heavy weapons
were replaced with beam weapons. In particular, the
inner-arm gatling gun on its right arm was replaced
with twin beam cylinders mounted on both arms,
converting it from a solid-round weapon to a beam
weapon and doubling the number of barrels,
resulting in more than twice its effective
firepower.
 Combining with the G Falcon finally made possible
the aerial operation Roybea had long wished for.
However, the battlefield shifted to space
immediately afterward, so it was never put to use
in actual combat.

Based on the Gundam X, this mobile suit was
developed by the Government Reconstruction
Committee with the aim of creating 'a new Gundam
possessing tremendous power as a symbol.'
 Its base was the unit Jamil piloted during the
Seventh Space War, but so much cutting-edge
technology has been incorporated internally that it
can fairly be called an entirely new model. Katock,
however, calls it "a fifteen-year-old ghost."
 The Satellite Cannon, the Gundam X's greatest
feature, has been doubled into the Twin Satellite
Cannon. Its output has more than doubled as well,
making it powerful enough to destroy even the
artificial island Zonder Epta or a Colony Laser.
 Not only the Satellite Cannon but the unit's
output, mobility, and maneuverability have all seen
dramatic improvements across the board. In its
first battle, despite fighting alone and without
even a rifle, it shot down as many as eight
Varients, a testament to its outstanding
performance.
 However, the dedicated Buster Rifle is no longer
integrated with the shield, and this has proven a
drawback in terms of durability, leading to it being
destroyed on several occasions. Because of this,
the pilot was once forced to borrow a rifle from
the Gundam Airmaster to keep fighting.

A mobile suit created by upgrading the Gundam
Vassago for space combat.
 Modifications extend down to the smallest details,
including reinforcement of the Strike Claw's attack
power and shock-absorption capacity, and removal
of the inner frame's armor.
 The Mega Sonic Cannon, its greatest feature, has
gained an additional two barrels on the chest to
become the Triple Mega Sonic Cannon, further
sharpening its already fearsome destructive power
to match its menacing appearance. The chest armor,
shaped to resemble a face, opens when the Triple
Mega Sonic Cannon is fired, embodying the unit's
name, Chest Break.
 The Satellite Launcher, used together with the
Gundam Ashtaron HC, requires successful control of
the Satellite System, but its power rivals that of
the Twin Satellite Cannon.

A unit created by upgrading the Gundam Ashtaron

mechanism for morphing into mobile armor form,

also its mobility in mobile armor form is high
enough to rival the G-Falcon both within and

A high-mobility mobile armor developed by the New
Federation Forces.
 With a fighter-jet-like form, a cockpit resembling
a mobile suit's head, and a beam rifle gripped at
the barrel by a manipulator, its shape stands out
considerably compared to other mobile suits and
mobile armors.
 Designed with the goal of securing air superiority,
it moderately damaged the Gundam Airmaster in an
aerial battle against it.

The Gadeel is a high-mobility mobile armor
developed by the New Federation Forces. Its form -
a fighter jet silhouette with a cockpit resembling a
mobile suit's head and a beam rifle gripped by
manipulators - stands out considerably compared to
other mobile suits and mobile armors. It was
designed to secure air supremacy, and in an aerial

A mobile suit developed by the New Federation

 The Wired Beam Rifles mounted on both arms can

initially read this as a close-combat weapon,
believing that "if he kept his distance, he wouldn't
be hit." But this assumption was quickly
overturned, putting him in a tight spot on one
occasion.
 Some units instead carry a standard beam rifle.

A type of unmanned mobile suit known as a Bit
Mobile Suit, controlled via brainwaves transmitted
from a Gundam equipped with the Flash System.
Because it corresponds to a Gundam, it is called a
G Bit.
 Normally, a G Bit exists for each Gundam that
serves as its host, but this particular unit was
instead controlled via Psycommu by D.O.M.E. on the
moon. Armed with a beam bazooka capable of
downing even a Crouda in a single shot, and
possessing maneuverability on par with Gundam-type
units, it served as the defense system for a
microwave transmission facility.

A new-model Aquarion jointly developed by the New
United Nations Forces and DEAVA, using Futaba, a
wing of paired Shadow Angel wings. Known as the
Assault-type Aquarion, a considerable number have

not found in the original, the Assault-type
Aquarion can also transform into 'Assault Walker
Mode,' which enables high-speed ground movement
and retains flight capability, or 'Armageddon Mode,'
a multi-legged gun-platform form.

Devitt Wayne is a pilot
candidate for the World
Federation Blue Fixer
special combat unit.
 He came to the Blue
Fixer base as the second
pilot of the New
Palsaburn.
 His nihilistic air and
provocative tone easily
invite misunderstanding,
but in essence he is a
hot-blooded man who
would not hesitate to
throw away his life for a
goal.
 He is Quinstein's former
student and has harbored
romantic feelings for her
since his school days.
However, knowing those
feelings will never be
requited, he is tormented.
 To destroy the satellite
Ganymede, which Aldebaron
had moved to block
sunlight, he volunteered
to board the suicide
weapon Fixer 1 in Marin's
place. His motive was not
to protect Earth but to
protect only Quinstein,
just one person.
 On the night before
sortie, he confessed his
feelings to Quinstein and
had his wish to spend the
night together accepted.
When he visited her room
at the appointed time,
however, he was satisfied
that she had accepted
him, and sortied without
seeing her, as if cutting
off his feelings. By the
time he headed toward
Ganymede, not a trace of
regret remained in his
heart.
 His looks and manner of
death made him a
character of considerable
popularity during the
original broadcast. In the
later theatrical version,
he was treated quite
favorably, even boarding
Baldios albeit temporarily.

A murderer clad in a red
raincoat. He awoke from a
container discarded
beneath a marshaling yard
and, using a handgun,
killed one after another
the people who had
recalled memories from
over 40 years ago. His
motive was orders he
heard from the moment of
his awakening. The face
beneath his hood was
that of an android
closely resembling
Dorothy. The R stood for
'RED,' and the D for
'DESTINY.' When he aimed
his gun at Roger to kill
him as Roger investigated
the case, he was caught
between the fist of the
Big O, which rose up from
underground, and the
ceiling, and was
destroyed.

William Wallace Fitzgerald
is the supreme commander
of the Earth Federation
Government EFA, holding
the office of President.
He was capable and frank
in personality, and
handled government
affairs without issue, but
was hard-pressed by the
sudden appearance of
Zeravire. Then, too
fixated on his pride as
supreme leader, he took
an uncooperative attitude
toward Sandman, who
possessed the power of
Gravion.
 In order to repel
Zeravire with EFA alone,
he had Gran Troopers
developed, using data that
Mizuki had gathered as a
reference. However, once
it became clear that
nothing but Gravion could
oppose Zeravire, he came
to cooperate fully with
Sandman.

A first-class Element
attending the Element
School. Age 14.
 She is a princess of the
old Kingdom of Alisia,
carrying the bloodline of
Apollonius and Celian. She
has the ability to emit
psychokinesis by gathering
ki in her left arm,
allowing her to lift or
bend any object.
 Perhaps because she lost
her parents at a young
age, she harbors an
abnormal affection for
her older brother Sirius.
As a result, she is wary
of all women who approach
Sirius, and especially
harbors hostility toward
Reika. She inherits the
past life of Celian, and
was convinced that the
reincarnation of her
former lover 'Solar Wing'
was Sirius. However, when
faced with the fact that
the wild child Apollo, who
suddenly appeared one
day, might actually be
the 'Solar Wing,' she
stubbornly refused to
accept it. But with the
help of her own past life
memories, she gradually
came to acknowledge it.

past life of Celian and
was convinced that the
reincarnation of her
former lover, the 'Solar
Wing,' was Sirius. However,
when faced with the fact
that Apollo, a wild child
who suddenly appeared one
day, might actually be
the 'Solar Wing,' she
stubbornly refused to
accept it. But aided by
her own memories of her
past life, she gradually
came to acknowledge it.
Along with Sirius, she
bears a Shadow Angel wing
deeply connected to her
past life on her left arm,
hidden beneath her
wristband. After Sirius
defected to the Shadow
Angels' side, she too
received an invitation
from her brother.
However, upon hearing
Apollo's words, she
decided to live as a
human and refused Sirius's
invitation. When the end
of the world arrived
after the final battle,
she made Apollo and
Sirius, who continued to
fight, and Toma (Toma)
aware of the existence of
light born from darkness
through the memories of
Celian. Though she was
ultimately separated from
Apollo, with whom she had
connected emotionally in
both her past life and
the present, she was
certain that he would
someday return to this
planet.

A political organization known for its extremism.
All of its members are Naturals, and under the
slogan 'For a blue and pure world,' they aim to
exclude Coordinators. Among Naturals, there are
many who, even if they do not participate in Blue
Cosmos, view Coordinators with suspicion. This is
also a result of their manipulation of
consciousness.
 However, the political organization is only a
public face; in the shadows, they conceal their
aspect as a secret society that acts as the
agent of LOGOS in order to achieve the
extermination of Coordinators. This is possible
because their members have infiltrated even the
upper echelons of the Atlantic Federation and the
Earth Alliance Forces.
 After the death of their leader Muruta Azrael in
the Second Battle of Jachin Due in C.E. 71, they
lay low for a while. But when Lord Djibril assumed
the position of new leader, they once again
manipulated public opinion by moving the Atlantic
Federation and the mass media to lead the Earth
Alliance and PLANT into war.
 However, due to Durandal's accusation, the
organization's upper echelons were destroyed along
with LOGOS. Their activities were forced into a
large-scale reduction.

Chairman of National Defense on the PLANT
Supreme Council during the previous war. Athrun's
father.
 He lost his wife in the Earth Alliance's surprise
attack on Junius Seven, the incident that
triggered the previous war. This filled him with
intense hatred for Naturals, and he advocated
all-out resistance against the Earth Alliance. He
later drove out the moderate former PLANT Council
Chairman Siegel Clyne and his faction, seizing the
chairmanship for himself.
 In the Second Battle of Jachin Due, he
attempted to annihilate the Naturals with the
'GENESIS,' an enormous gamma-ray laser cannon
capable of devastating Earth's environment, but
was shot dead by an aide who feared for the
PLANTs' future.
